TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en:
Tag value of the resource tag. Up to 3 tag values can be specified for each tag key. If this parameter is not provided, all resources associated with all tag values under the specified tag key will be queried. If multiple tag values are specified for the same tag key, the query returns the set of resources associated with each tag value.
> If this parameter is provided, TagFilters.N.Key must be specified first.

AclName.description_en: Name of the access control policy group.

Description.description_en:
Description of the access control policy group.

* Cannot start with http:// or https://
* Must start with a letter or Chinese character; can include numbers, English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
* Length must be between 1 and 255 characters
* If not specified, defaults to the original Description
Description.example_en: This is an access control list

Description.description_en: CA Certificate Description

CertificateName.description_en:
Certificate name

* Cannot start with http:// or https://
* Must start with a letter or Chinese character; can include numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

Description.description_en: Certificate Description

CustomizedCfgContent.description_en:
Content of the customized configuration items to be modified. The specific rules are as follows:

* Maximum length is 4096 characters; separate different configuration items with ";".
* Currently supported configuration items include ssl_protocols, ssl_ciphers, client_max_body_size, keepalive_timeout, proxy_request_buffering, proxy_connect_timeout, add_header, client_header_timeout, proxy_read_timeout, proxy_send_timeout, client_body_timeout, send_timeout, and ssl_verify_depth. For details, see **Customized Configuration Item Content** at the end of this document.

Description.description_en:
Description of the customized configuration.

* Cannot start with http:// or https://
* Must start with a letter or Chinese character; can include numbers, English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
* Length must be between 1 and 255 characters
* If not specified, defaults to the original Description

HealthCheckTemplates.N.Description.description_en:
Health check description

* Cannot start with http:// or https://
* Must start with a letter or Chinese character; can include numbers, English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
* Length must be between 1 and 255 characters
* If not specified, defaults to an empty string

HealthCheckTemplates.N.HealthCheckDomain.description_en:
Health check domain name

* This parameter is only effective when HealthCheckProtocol is set to HTTP
* Requirements:
   * Must contain at least one '.' and cannot start or end with '.'
   * Each string can contain letters, numbers, '-', and '.'; '-' cannot be at the beginning or end
   * Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
   * If not specified, this parameter is empty; load balancer will use the private IP address of each backend server for health checks by default

HealthCheckTemplates.N.HealthCheckHttpCo.description_en:
Healthy HTTP status codes for health checks

* Separate multiple status codes with commas; this parameter is only effective when HealthCheckProtocol is set to HTTP
* Valid values:
   * http_2xx
   * http_3xx
   * http_4xx
   * http_5xx

HealthCheckTemplates.N.HealthCheckHttpVe.description_en:
Health check HTTP protocol version

* This parameter is only effective when HealthCheckProtocol is set to HTTP
* Valid values:
   * HTTP1.0
   * HTTP1.1

HealthCheckTemplates.N.HealthCheckInterv.description_en: Interval for performing health checks. Value range: 1-300s

HealthCheckTemplates.N.HealthCheckMethod.description_en:
Health check method

* This parameter is only effective when HealthCheckProtocol is set to HTTP
* Valid values:
   * GET
   * HEAD

HealthCheckTemplates.N.HealthCheckPort.description_en:
Health check port. Valid values:

* 0: Use the backend server port for health checks
* 1-65535: Use the specified port for health checks

HealthCheckTemplates.N.HealthCheckProtoc.description_en:
Health check protocol. Valid values:

* HTTP
* TCP

HealthCheckTemplates.N.HealthCheckTempla.description_en:
Health check template name

* Cannot start with http:// or https://
* Must start with a letter or Chinese character; can include numbers, period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-)
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

HealthCheckTemplates.N.HealthCheckTimeou.description_en: Health check response timeout. Value range: 1-60s

HealthCheckTemplates.N.HealthCheckURI.description_en:
Health check path

* This parameter is only effective when HealthCheckProtocol is set to HTTP
* Requirements:
   * Must start with '/'
   * Can only contain letters, numbers, '-', '_', '/', '.', '%', '?', '#', '&', '='
   * Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
   * If not specified, defaults to '/'

HealthCheckTemplates.N.HealthyThreshold.description_en: Healthy threshold for health checks. Value range: 2-10 times

HealthCheckTemplates.N.UnhealthyThreshol.description_en: Unhealthy threshold for health checks. Value range: 2-10 times

AccessLogRecordCustomizedHeadersEnabled.description_en:
Whether to enable the function to record custom headers in access logs for this listener. The values are as follows:
* on: enabled
* off: disabled

AclIds.N.description_en:
ID of the access control policy group bound to the listener

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the access control policy group, with a maximum of 5
* Separate multiple access control policy group IDs with “&”
* When the AclStatus parameter is set to on, both AclType and AclIds.N are required

AclStatus.description_en:
Enable access control

* Values:
   * on: Enable
   * off: Disable
* Leave blank to keep current access control settings
* Configuring this parameter will clear the existing AclType and AclIds parameters
* If you change this parameter from on to off, the values of AclType and AclIds will be cleared
* If you change this parameter from off to on, you must also set the values for AclType and AclIds

AclType.description_en:
Access control mode. Values:

* white: Allowlist mode. The listener only forwards requests from IP addresses or ranges specified in the selected access control policy group. If no IP is added to the selected policy group, the listener will not forward any requests
* black: Denylist mode. The listener only blocks requests from IP addresses or ranges specified in the selected access control policy group. If no IP is added to the selected policy group, the listener will forward all requests
  When the AclStatus parameter is set to on, both AclType and AclIds.N are required

CACertificateId.description_en: CA certificate ID associated with the listener. You must specify this parameter when modifying the CA certificate of an HTTPS listener and CACertificateSource is alb.

CACertificateSource.description_en:
Source of the CA certificate associated with the listener.
This parameter is only valid for HTTPS listeners and is used for mutual authentication.
When modifying the CA certificate, you must specify this parameter; otherwise, the default value alb is used. Supported values:

* alb: Certificate uploaded via ALB. Standard ALB instances do not support certificates from this source.
* pca_root: Private root CA certificate purchased or uploaded via BytePlus Certificate Center.
* pca_sub: Private subordinate CA certificate purchased or uploaded via BytePlus Certificate Center.

CertCenterCertificateId.description_en:
Certificate Center certificate ID
When modifying the server certificate for an HTTPS listener and the certificate source is cert_center, you must specify this parameter

CertificateId.description_en: Certificate ID managed by ALB. You must specify this parameter when modifying the server certificate of an HTTPS listener and the certificate source is alb.

CertificateSource.description_en:
Source of the default certificate. Values:

* alb: Certificate uploaded via ALB. [Standard ALB instances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/Comparison-between-instance-editions) do not support this value
* cert_center: SSL certificate purchased or uploaded via BytePlus Certificate Center

When modifying the default certificate, always specify this parameter. Otherwise, the default value is alb and the system will process it as an alb certificate

ClientAddressTransmissionProtocol.description_en:
Protocol used by the backend to obtain the real client IP and VIP.

* Supported values:
   * off: Disable all CIP and VIP protocols.
   * ProxyProtocolV2: Valid only for TCP protocol.
   * Xoa: Valid for both TCP and UDP protocols.
* Default for UDP is off; default for TCP is ProxyProtocolV2. For TCP, if not specified and ProxyProtocolDisabled is off, the value is ProxyProtocolV2.

CustomizedCfgId.description_en:
Bind personalized configuration.

* Only personalized configurations in Active status can be bound.
* To delete a personalized configuration, set this field to an empty string. If this parameter is not provided, no changes will be made.

Description.description_en:
Description of the listener

* Cannot start with http:// or https://
* Must start with a letter or Chinese character. Can include numbers, English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
* Length must be between 1 and 255 characters

DomainExtensions.N.Action.description_en:
Operation for the specified extended domain name.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the domain sequence number. An HTTPS listener can associate up to 20 extended domain names.
* Supported values:
   * create: Create
   * modify: Modify
   * delete: Delete

DomainExtensions.N.CertCenterCertificate.description_en:
Server certificate used by the domain name.

* When modifying an extended certificate and the certificate source is cert_center, this parameter must be specified.
* Parameter - N: Indicates the domain sequence number. A single HTTPS listener can be associated with up to 20 extended domain names, values range from 1 to 20.

DomainExtensions.N.CertificateId.description_en:
Server certificate used for the domain name

* When modifying an extension certificate and the certificate source is alb, you must specify this parameter
* Parameter - N: Indicates the domain name sequence number. A single HTTPS listener can be associated with up to 20 extension domain names

DomainExtensions.N.CertificateSource.description_en:
Source of the server certificate used by the domain name.

* Values:
   * alb: Certificate uploaded via ALB. [Standard ALB instances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/Comparison-between-instance-editions) do not support this value.
   * cert_center: SSL certificate purchased or uploaded via Volcengine Certificate Center.
* Parameter - N: Indicates the domain sequence number. A single HTTPS listener can be associated with up to 20 extended domain names, values range from 1 to 20.
* When modifying the default certificate, be sure to specify this parameter; otherwise, the default value is alb and the system will process it as an alb certificate.

DomainExtensions.N.Domain.description_en:
Domain name.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the domain sequence number.
* A single HTTPS listener can be associated with up to 20 extended domain names.
* Format specifications are as follows:
   * Usually cannot be empty. However, if the instance supports automatic selection of extended certificates (i.e., `SniAutoMatch` is `on`), then `DomainExtensions.N.Domain` must be set to an empty string.
   * Must contain at least one '.', and cannot start or end with '.'.
   * Only lowercase letters, numbers, '.', '-', and '*' are allowed.
   * Length limit: 1 to 128 characters.
   * Wildcard domain: Use '*' to replace one or more characters.
      * '*' must be at the beginning or end of the domain name.
      * '*' cannot appear twice in the same domain name.
      * There must be no characters other than '.' before or after '*'.
      * Valid examples: *.com, www.test.*.
      * Invalid examples: *aaa.com, www.*.com
   * Exact domain: An exact domain name that meets domain specifications, e.g., www.test.com.
   * Domain names under the same HTTPS listener cannot be duplicated.
   * Domain name matching is case-insensitive.

DomainExtensions.N.DomainExtensionId.description_en:
Extension domain name ID. Only required for deletion and modification

* Parameter - N: Indicates the domain name sequence number
* A single HTTPS listener can be associated with up to 20 extension domain names

DomainExtensions.N.PcaLeafCertificateId.description_en:
Server certificate used by the domain name

* Valid only when the certificate source is pca_leaf.
* Parameter - N: Indicates the domain sequence number. An HTTPS listener can associate up to 20 extended domain names, with values from 1 to 20.

EnableHttp2.description_en:
HTTP 2.0 feature switch. This parameter is only valid for HTTPS listeners. Values:

* on: Enable
* off: Disable

EnableQuic.description_en:
QUIC feature switch. This parameter is only valid for HTTPS listeners. Values:

* on: Enable
* off: Disable
   Only Standard ALB instances support QUIC. To use QUIC, please contact your account manager

Enabled.description_en:
Enable or disable the listener. Values:

* on: Enable.
* off: Disable.

ListenerName.description_en:
Listener name

* Cannot start with http:// or https://
* Must start with a letter or Chinese character and can include numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

PcaLeafCertificateId.description_en: Certificate ID associated with the listener. You must specify this parameter when modifying the server certificate of an HTTPS listener and the certificate source is pca_leaf.

PcaRootCACertificateId.description_en: CA certificate ID associated with the listener. You must specify this parameter when modifying the CA certificate of an HTTPS listener and CACertificateSource is pca_root.

PcaSubCACertificateId.description_en: CA certificate ID associated with the listener. You must specify this parameter when modifying the CA certificate of an HTTPS listener and CACertificateSource is pca_sub.

ProxyProtocolDisabled.description_en:
Whether to disable passing the client source address to the backend server via Proxy Protocol. Supported values:

* off: Do not disable
* on: Disable

ServerGroupId.description_en: Default server group ID associated with the listener.

XRealIpEnabled.description_en:
Enable or disable the X-real-ip Header for the listener. The values are as follows:
* on (default): enabled
* off: disabled

DeleteProtection.description_en:
ALB deletion protection feature.

* off: Disabled
* on: Enabled

Description.description_en:
Description of the ALB instance.

* Cannot start with http:// or https://
* Must start with a letter or Chinese character and can include numbers, English commas (,), periods (.), underscores (_), spaces ( ), equal signs (=), hyphens (-), Chinese commas (，), and Chinese periods (。).
* Length must be between 1 and 255 characters.

GlobalAccelerator.Weight.description_en: Traffic distribution weight for the endpoint. Value range: 1 - 100.

LoadBalancerId.description_en: ALB Instance ID

LoadBalancerName.description_en:
Name of the ALB instance.

* Cannot start with http:// or https://
* Must start with a letter or Chinese character and can include numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.

ModificationProtectionReason.description_en:
Enter the reason for enabling instance modification protection.

* Must start with a letter or Chinese character and can include numbers, English commas (,), periods (.), underscores (_), spaces ( ), equal signs (=), hyphens (-), Chinese commas (，), and Chinese periods (。).
* Length must be between 0 and 128 characters.

* The ModificationProtectionReason parameter is valid only when the ModificationProtectionStatus parameter is set to ConsoleProtection.
* When ModificationProtectionStatus is set to NonProtection, any previously configured ModificationProtectionReason will be cleared.

ModificationProtectionStatus.description_en:
Enable instance modification protection. Options:

* NonProtection: Disabled
* ConsoleProtection: Enabled. When enabled, you cannot modify instance configuration via the ALB console; you can only modify it through the API.

ProxyProtocolEnabled.description_en:
ALB supports Proxy Protocol and records the client's real IP address
- Off: Disable Proxy Protocol
- On: Enable Proxy Protocol

WafInstanceId.description_en: The WAF security instance ID bound to the ALB instance

WafProtectedDomain.description_en:
WAF protection domain name.

* When WafProtectionEnabled is set to on, this parameter is optional. When WafProtectionEnabled is set to off, this parameter is invalid.
* Supports exact domain names and wildcard domain names.

WafProtectionEnabled.description_en:
WAF protection switch.

* off: Disabled
* on: Enabled

LoadBalancerId.description_en: ALB Instance ID

Type.description_en:
Type of ALB instance. Valid values:

* public: Change to public ALB instance
* private: Change to private ALB instance

ZoneMappings.N.EipType.description_en:
Type of public IP.

* Empty: Public IP
* anycast: Anycast public IP. Currently, the Anycast Elastic Public IP type requires allowlist access in both Anycast Public IP and ALB products before use.

ZoneMappings.N.PopLocations.description_en:
When binding the Anycast public IP type, you can specify access points.

* Separate multiple access points with commas (,)
* You can use the Anycast API [DescribeAnycastPopLocations (visible to allowlist accounts)](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6978/158179) to query valid access point information.

ZoneMappings.N.ZoneId.description_en:
Availability zone ID of the ALB instance.

* You can call the [DescribeZones](../6406/145473) API to get information about the availability zone corresponding to the zone ID.

LoadBalancerId.description_en: ALB Instance ID

ZoneMappings.N.SubnetId.description_en: Subnet ID. The private IP address of the ALB instance in this zone will be allocated from this subnet range.

ZoneMappings.N.ZoneId.description_en:
Zone ID of the ALB instance.

* You can call the [DescribeZones](/docs/6406/145473) API to get the zone IDs available for ALB instance deployment.
* `SubnetId` and `ZoneId` must match.

Rules.N.Description.description_en:
Description of the forwarding rule.
- Cannot start with http:// or https://.
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character; can include numbers, English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。).
- Length limit: 1 to 255 characters.
- - N: indicates the forwarding rule index, value range 1 to 20.
- Use '&' to separate multiple forwarding rules.

Rules.N.ForwardGroupConfig.ServerGroupTu.description_en:
(Basic Edition) ID of the backend server group to forward to.
- The first N: indicates the forwarding rule index, with a value range of 1 to 20. When the forwarding rule action is empty, meaning forwarding to a server group, you must fill in either this parameter or `Rules.N.ServerGroupId`. This parameter has higher priority than `Rules.N.ServerGroupId`. If this parameter is not empty, `Rules.N.ServerGroupId` will be ignored.
- The second N: indicates the index of the server group to forward to, with a value range of 1 to 5.

(Basic Edition) Weight of the backend server group to forward to.
- The first N: Indicates the forwarding rule number, range 1–20.
- The second N: Indicates the server group number to forward to, range 1–5.
- Value range: 0–100. If there is only one server group and this parameter is not specified, the default is 100.

Rules.N.ForwardGroupConfig.StickySession.description_en:
(Basic Edition) Enable session persistence between server groups. Values:
- **on**: enabled
- **off**: disabled

(Basic Edition) Component session persistence timeout. Unit: seconds
- Value range: **1-86400**
- Default value: **1000**

Rules.N.Priority.description_en: (Standard Edition) Forwarding rule priority. Value range: 1-10000

Rules.N.RedirectConfig.RedirectDomain.description_en:
(Basic Edition) Domain name after redirection; only exact domain names are supported.
- Parameter N: Indicates the sequence number of the domain name, value range 1–20.
- Use '&' to separate multiple domain names.
- Specific requirements:
	- Must contain at least one '.' and cannot start or end with '.'.
	- Only letters, numbers, '.', and '-' are allowed.
	- Length limit: 1–128 characters.
	- Exact domain name: An exact domain name that meets domain name specifications, e.g., www.test.com.
- When the forwarding rule action is Redirect, if this parameter is not specified, it will be assigned the default value (empty), so the redirected domain name will be the same as the request domain name.

Rules.N.RedirectConfig.RedirectHttpCode.description_en:
(Basic Edition) Redirect status code. Supports 301 (default), 302, 307, 308.
- Parameter-N: indicates the serial number of the domain name. Range: 1–20.
- If RuleAction is set to Redirect, this parameter must be provided every time you call the API, regardless of whether the redirect status code is modified. Otherwise, it defaults to 301 and results in an API error

Rules.N.RedirectConfig.RedirectPort.description_en:
(Basic Edition) Redirect port.
- Value: 1–65535.
- Parameter-N: indicates the sequence number of the domain name, value range 1–20.
- When the forwarding rule action is Redirect, if this parameter is not specified, it will be assigned the default value (empty), resulting in the port matching the request port.

Rules.N.RedirectConfig.RedirectProtocol.description_en:
(Basic Edition) Redirect protocol.
- Parameter N: indicates the sequence number of the domain name, value range 1–20.
- Values:
	- HTTP
	- HTTPS
- Each time you call this API, if RuleAction is set to Redirect, this parameter must be provided regardless of whether the redirect protocol is modified. Otherwise, the default value (HTTPS) will be assigned, resulting in an error returned by the API.

Rules.N.RedirectConfig.RedirectUri.description_en:
(Basic Edition) Redirected URI.
- Parameter N: indicates the domain name index, with a value range of 1 to 20.
- Specifications:
	- Must start with a forward slash '/'.
	- Only the following characters are allowed: letters, numbers, '-', '_', '/', '.', '%', '?', '#', '&', '='.
	- Length limit: 1 to 128 characters.
- When the forwarding rule action is Redirect, if this parameter is not specified, it will be assigned the default value (empty), resulting in the redirected URI being the same as the request URI.

Rules.N.RewriteConfig.RewritePath.description_en:
(Basic Edition) Rewritten path.
- Parameter N: Indicates the rule number, range 1–20.
- Specifications:
	- Must start with a forward slash “/”.
	- Only letters, numbers, '-', '_', '/', '.', '%', '?', '#', '&' are allowed.
	- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.
	- Supports regex replacement. The rewritten path must include one or more of ${1}, ${2}, ${3}, and these variables cannot be replaced by other characters.

Rules.N.RewriteEnabled.description_en:
(Basic Edition) Forwarding rule rewrite configuration switch
- This parameter can only be configured and take effect when RuleAction is empty (i.e., forwarding to a server group).
- Values:
	- on: Enable
	- off: Disable
- When modifying rewrite-related settings for forwarding rules, note the following:
	- The rewrite modification feature is only available to allowlist users. Submit an application to use this feature.
	- If this field is left blank, rewrite-related information will not be modified.
	- After configuring this field, ALB will clear the previously configured rewrite path Rules.N.RewriteConfig.RewritePath.
	- If this change switches the rewrite configuration switch from enabled (on) to disabled (off), ALB will clear the previously configured rewrite path Rules.N.RewriteConfig.RewritePath.
	- If this change switches the rewrite configuration switch from disabled (off) to enabled (on), you must specify at least one item in the rewrite configuration for it to take effect, such as Rules.N.RewriteConfig.RewritePath.

Rules.N.RuleAction.description_en:
(Basic Edition) Forwarding rule action.
- If empty: defaults to forwarding to server group
- Redirect: performs a redirect
- This parameter must be provided every time you call the API, regardless of whether Action is modified. Otherwise, it defaults to forwarding to the server group

Rules.N.RuleActions.N.CorsConfig.AllowCr.description_en:
(Standard Edition) Whether to allow credentials. Values:
- on: Yes
- off: No

Rules.N.RuleActions.N.CorsConfig.AllowHe.description_en:
(Standard Edition) Set headers allowed for cross-origin access, in addition to browser built-in basic headers.
- You can configure the wildcard `*`, or multiple values separated by commas, up to 32 values.
- Each value can only contain uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and `-` or `_` not at the beginning or end, with a maximum length of 32 characters.

Rules.N.RuleActions.N.CorsConfig.AllowMe.description_en:
(Standard Edition) Select HTTP methods allowed for cross-origin access.
Values: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS, PATCH. Cannot be empty.

Rules.N.RuleActions.N.CorsConfig.AllowOr.description_en:
(Standard Edition) Configure sites allowed to access server resources via browser
- Supports wildcard '*' and multiple values separated by commas, up to 32 values

- Each value must start with http:// or https://, followed by a domain name or a single-level wildcard domain (*.test.abc.example.com)

- Each value can specify a port, port range is 1–65535

Rules.N.RuleActions.N.CorsConfig.ExposeH.description_en:
(Standard Edition) Response headers accessible by browsers and JavaScript scripts.
- You can configure the wildcard "*", or multiple values separated by commas, up to 32 values.
- Each value can only contain uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and "-" or "_" not at the beginning or end, with a maximum length of 32 characters.

Rules.N.RuleActions.N.CorsConfig.MaxAge.description_en:
(Standard Edition) Maximum cache duration for preflight requests in the browser, in seconds
- Range: -1–172800
- Both -1 and 0 mean no caching

Rules.N.RuleActions.N.FixedResponseConfi.description_en: (Standard version) Response body. Maximum 1024 characters; only UTF-8 characters are supported

(Standard Edition) Response body type. Values:
- text/plain
- text/css
- text/html
- application/javascript
- application/json.

(Standard Edition) HTTP response code.
Only supports numeric strings in the format 2xx, 4xx, 5xx, where x can be any digit from 0 to 9

Rules.N.RuleActions.N.ForwardGroupConfig.description_en:
(Standard Edition) Whether to enable session persistence between server groups. Value options:
- on: enabled
- off: disabled

(Standard Edition) Timeout for session persistence between server groups.
- The first N: indicates the sequence number of the forwarding rule. Value range: 1–10000
- The second N: indicates the sequence number of the forwarding action. Value range: 1–5
- Value range: 1–86400. Default: 1000. Unit: seconds

(Standard version) ID of the backend server group to which the request is forwarded.
- The first N: indicates the serial number of the forwarding rule. Value range: 1–10000.
- The second N: indicates the serial number of the forwarding action. Value range: 1–5.
- The third N: indicates the serial number of the server group. Value range: 1–5

(Standard version) Weight assigned to the backend server group for forwarding.
- The first N: indicates the serial number of the forwarding rule. Value range: 1–10000.
- The second N: indicates the serial number of the forwarding action. Value range: 1–5.
- The third N: indicates the serial number of the server group. Value range: 1–5.
- Value range: 0–100. If there is only one server group and this parameter is not specified, the default value is 100

Rules.N.RuleActions.N.InsertHeaderConfig.description_en:
- Length: 1–40 characters. Supports uppercase and lowercase letters a–z, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
- Field names must be unique
- Regardless of case, the following header keys are not supported: x-real-ip, x-forwarded-for, x-forwarded-proto, x-alb-waf-requestid, x-alb-waf-real-port, upgrade, connection, x-vport, x-vip, x-real-ip, x-clb-cluster, x-toutiao-lb-ip, x-vni, content-length, transfer-encoding, keep-alive, host, cookie, authority

Inserted header field content.
- When ValueType is set to SystemDefined, the following values are used (these values are displayed in Chinese on the frontend):
	- $remote_addr: Client IP address.
	- $remote_port: Client port.
	- $scheme: Protocol used for the client request (HTTP or HTTPS).
	- $load_balancer_id: Application load balancer instance ID.
	- $vport: Application load balancer instance listening port.
	- $endpoint_id: Endpoint ID (allowlist must be enabled)
- When ValueType is set to UserDefined: You can customize the header field content. The length is limited to 1–128 characters. Wildcard asterisk (*) and half-width question mark (?) are supported, as well as printable characters within the ASCII code range `ch >= 32 && ch < 127`. '$' and '"' are not supported. The header cannot start or end with a space. The header cannot end with '\'.

Header field content type. Options:
- UserDefined: Custom header field content
- SystemDefined: System-defined header field content

Rules.N.RuleActions.N.RedirectConfig.Hos.description_en:
(Standard Version) Redirected domain name
- The first N: indicates the forwarding rule number. Value range: 1~10000.
- The second N: indicates the forwarding action number. Value range: 1~5.
- The specified domain name must meet the following requirements:
	- Only English letters, numbers, periods (.), and hyphens (-) are allowed.
	- Must contain at least one period (.), but cannot start or end with a period (.).
	- Each domain label cannot start or end with a hyphen (-).
	- Maximum 128 characters allowed.
	- Must be a valid, exact domain name, such as www.test.com.
If you do not specify a domain name, the redirected domain name will be the same as the requested domain name.

Rules.N.RuleActions.N.RedirectConfig.Htt.description_en:
(Standard version) Redirect status code.
- The first N: indicates the serial number of the forwarding rule. Value range: 1–10000.
- The second N: indicates the serial number of the forwarding action. Value range: 1–5.
- Value range:
	- 301
	- 302
	- 307
	- 308

Rules.N.RuleActions.N.RedirectConfig.Pat.description_en:
(Standard version) Redirect path.
- The first N: indicates the serial number of the forwarding rule. Value range: 1–10000.
- The second N: indicates the serial number of the forwarding action. Value range: 1–5.
- The specified path must meet the following requirements:
	- Must start with a forward slash (/)
	- Maximum of 128 characters allowed
	- Can only contain English letters, numbers, and the following special characters: - _ / . % ? # & =. Forward slashes (/) cannot be used consecutively
- If you do not specify a path, the redirect path will be the same as the request path

Rules.N.RuleActions.N.RedirectConfig.Por.description_en:
(Standard Version) Redirected port
- The first N: indicates the forwarding rule number. Value range: 1~10000.
- The second N: indicates the forwarding action number. Value range: 1~5.
- Value range: 1~65535.
- If you do not specify a port, the redirected port will be the same as the requested port.

Rules.N.RuleActions.N.RedirectConfig.Pro.description_en:
(Standard Edition) Protocol used for redirection.
- The first N: indicates the sequence number of the forwarding rule. Value range: 1–10000
- The second N: indicates the sequence number of the forwarding action. Value range: 1–5
- Value options:
	- HTTP
	- HTTPS

Rules.N.RuleActions.N.RedirectConfig.Que.description_en:
(Standard Edition) Query string for redirection.
- The first N indicates the serial number of the forwarding rule. Value range: 1–10000.
- The second N indicates the serial number of the forwarding action. Value range: 1~5.
- The specified query string must meet the following requirements:
	- Maximum of 128 characters allowed.
	- Spaces and #[]{}\|<>" are not supported. If letters are used, they must be lowercase.
- If you do not specify a query string, the redirected query string will be the same as the request query string.

Rules.N.RuleActions.N.RewriteConfig.Host.description_en:
(Standard Version) Rewritten domain name
- The first N: indicates the forwarding rule number. Value range: 1 ~ 10000.
- The second N: indicates the forwarding action number. Value range: 1 ~ 10.
- If not specified, defaults to the original request domain name.
- The specified domain name must meet the following requirements:
	- Hostname length must be 3–128 characters. Supports lowercase letters a–z, numbers, hyphens (-), periods (.), wildcard asterisks (*), equals signs (=), tildes (~), underscores (_), plus signs (+), backslashes (\), carets (^), exclamation marks (!), dollar signs ($), ampersands (&), vertical bars (|), parentheses (), brackets ([]), and question marks (?).

	- Hostname must contain at least one period (.), and periods (.) cannot appear at the beginning or end.

	- The rightmost domain label can only contain letters and wildcards; it cannot contain numbers or hyphens (-). The leftmost domain label may be an asterisk (*).

	- Hyphens (-) cannot appear at the beginning or end of other domain labels. Wildcard asterisks (*) and question marks (?) can appear anywhere within domain labels.

Rules.N.RuleActions.N.RewriteConfig.Path.description_en:
(Standard Edition) Rewritten path.
- The first N: indicates the sequence number of the forwarding rule. Value range: 1–10000
- The second N: indicates the sequence number of the forwarding action. Value range: 1–5
- The specified path must meet the following requirements:
	- Path length must not exceed 128 characters
	- Path must start with a forward slash (/)
	- Path can only contain English letters, numbers, and the following special characters: - _ / . % ? # & =. Forward slashes (/) cannot be used consecutively
	- If you use a regular expression in the forwarding condition path and create capture groups with parentheses (), you can reference the captured content in the forwarding action path using variables like ${1}, ${2}, ${3}. Example: If the forwarding condition path is /volc/(.*)/(.*)/aaa and the forwarding action path is /${1}/${2}, when the request path is /volc/ccc/bbb/aaa, the path will be replaced with /ccc/bbb

Rules.N.RuleActions.N.TrafficLimitConfig.description_en:
(Standard Edition) Rate limit value.
- The first N: indicates the sequence number of the forwarding rule. Value range: 1–10000
- The second N: indicates the sequence number of the forwarding action. Value range: 1–5
QPS, representing queries per second. Value range: 100–100000. "Rate limit" must be used together with "forwarding action". To configure "Rate limit", it must be set as the first forwarding action.

Rules.N.RuleActions.N.Type.description_en:
(Standard version) Types of forwarding actions
- The first N: Indicates the sequence number of the forwarding rule. Value range: 1–10000
- The second N: Indicates the sequence number of the forwarding action. Value range: 1–5
- Available values:
	- ForwardGroup: Forward group. ALB forwards the request to the backend server group you specify
	- Redirect: Redirect. ALB redirects the request
	- Rewrite: Rewrite. ALB rewrites the request path and requests content from the backend server under the new path
	- TrafficLimit: Rate limiting. When the number of requests exceeds the configured QPS, ALB discards new requests
	- FixedResponse: Return fixed content. Customize the response status code and response content
- The 'Rate limiting' and 'Rewrite' forwarding actions must be used in conjunction with the 'Forward group' forwarding action. 'Rate limiting', 'Rewrite', and 'Forward group' can also be used together. When multiple forwarding actions are combined, their relationship is 'AND'

Rules.N.RuleAuthEnabled.description_en: Enable authentication policy for the forwarding rule. Value: on: Yes. off: No.

Rules.N.RuleAuths.N.APIKeyConfig.Values..description_en:
(Standard Edition) Configuration for APIKey authentication.
- The first N indicates the serial number of the forwarding rule. Value range: 1–10000.
- The second N indicates the serial number of the authentication policy. Value range: 1~1
- The third N indicates the serial number of the APIKey. Value range: 1–5.

Rules.N.RuleAuths.N.Type.description_en: Authentication type for the forwarding rule. Value: APIKey.

Rules.N.RuleConditions.N.CookieConfig.Va.description_en:
(Standard Edition) Cookie key
- Supports 1–100 characters
- Supports visible characters, wildcard asterisk (*), and question mark (?). Letters must be lowercase
- Spaces and ;#[]{}\|<>&" are not supported

(Standard Edition) Cookie value
- Supports 1–128 characters
- Supports visible characters, wildcard asterisk (*), and question mark (?). Letters must be lowercase
- Spaces and ;#[]{}\|<>&" are not supported

Rules.N.RuleConditions.N.HeaderConfig.Ke.description_en:
(Standard Edition) Key of the HTTP header in the forwarding condition
- The first N: indicates the sequence number of the forwarding rule. Value range: 1-10000
- The second N: indicates the sequence number of the forwarding condition. Value range: 1-10
- The third N: indicates the sequence number of the key. Value range: 1-10
- Keys cannot be duplicated within the same forwarding rule. The specified key must meet the following requirements:
	- Can only contain English letters, numbers, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
	- Cannot be Cookie or Host
	- Maximum of 40 characters allowed

Rules.N.RuleConditions.N.HeaderConfig.Va.description_en:
(Standard Edition) Value of the HTTP header for forwarding conditions.
- The first N: indicates the sequence number of the forwarding rule. Value range: 1–10000.
- The second N: indicates the sequence number of the forwarding condition. Value range: 1–10.
- The third N: indicates the sequence number of the value. Value range:
- Each key can correspond to multiple values, which are in an 'or' relationship. The specified values must meet the following requirements:
	- Printable ASCII characters, asterisk (*) and question mark (?) are allowed.
	- Cannot start or end with a space.
	- Up to 128 characters allowed.

Rules.N.RuleConditions.N.HostConfig.Valu.description_en:
(Standard Edition) Domain names for forwarding conditions.
- The first N: indicates the serial number of the forwarding rule. Range: 1–10000.
- The second N: indicates the serial number of the forwarding condition. Range: 1–10.
- The third N: indicates the serial number of the domain name. Range: 1–10.
- Use the & symbol to separate multiple domain names. If you specify multiple domain names, the relationship between them is 'or'.
- Basic input specifications:
	- Only English letters, numbers, and the following special characters are allowed: . - _ *
	- Must contain at least one period (.), but cannot start or end with a period (.)
	- Maximum: 128 characters
	- Domain names are case-insensitive
- Domain name types:
	- Exact domain name: must comply with domain name specifications
	- Wildcard domain name
	  - Asterisk (*) can replace one or more characters
	  - Asterisk (*) must be at the beginning or end of the domain name
	  - Only one asterisk (*) is allowed in a domain name
	  - No characters except period (.) are allowed before or after the asterisk (*)
- Domain name examples:
	- Valid examples: www.test.com, *.com, www.test.*
	- Invalid examples: *aaa.com, www.*.com

Rules.N.RuleConditions.N.MethodConfig.Va.description_en:
(Standard Edition) HTTP request methods.
- The first N: indicates the rule sequence number. Value range: 1–10000.
- The second N: indicates the condition sequence number. Value range: 1–10.
- The third N: indicates the key sequence number. Value range: 1–10.
- Values: HEAD, GET, POST, OPTIONS, PUT, PATCH, DELETE.

Rules.N.RuleConditions.N.PathConfig.Valu.description_en:
(Standard Edition) Path for forwarding conditions.
- The first N: Indicates the forwarding rule number. Range: 1–10000.
- The second N: Indicates the forwarding condition number. Range: 1–10.
- The third N: Indicates the path number. Range: 1–10.
- Use the & symbol to separate multiple paths. When you specify multiple paths, these paths are in an 'or' relationship.
- Only absolute paths are supported. ALB allows you to specify paths using either non-regex or regex. To use regex for path specification, please submit a ticket to apply.
- The specified path must meet the following requirements:
	- Non-regex:
	  - Must start with a forward slash (/).
	  - Only English letters, numbers, and the following special characters are allowed: - _ / . % ? # & =. Forward slashes (/) cannot be used consecutively.
	  - Maximum 128 characters allowed.
	- Regex:
	  - Must start with a tilde (~), and the tilde (~) can only appear once.
	  - Only English letters, numbers, and the following special characters are allowed: . - _ / = ? ~ ^ * $ : ( ) [ ] + |.
	  - ~ at the start means case-sensitive. ~* at the start means case-insensitive.
	  - Maximum 128 characters allowed.

Rules.N.RuleConditions.N.QueryStringConf.description_en:
(Standard Edition) Query string key for forwarding condition.
- Length: 1–100 characters.
- Supports visible characters, wildcard asterisks (*) and question marks (?). If letters are used, they must be lowercase. Spaces and #[]{}\|<>&" are not supported.

(Standard Edition) Query string value for forwarding condition.
- Length: 1–128 characters.
- Supports lowercase letters, visible characters, wildcard asterisks (*) and question marks (?). Spaces and #[]{}\|<>&" are not supported.

Rules.N.RuleConditions.N.SourceIpConfig..description_en:
(Standard Edition) Only requests matching sourceIP can be forwarded.
- Only IPv4 addresses/IPv4 address ranges are supported, and IP addresses must include a subnet mask.
- Address ranges of the type 0.0.0.0/x, where x is any number, are not supported.
- If SourceIP is included in the forwarding condition, only requests originating from the SourceIP address range or address will match this rule.
- A SourceIP condition in a rule supports up to 5 values.

Rules.N.RuleConditions.N.Type.description_en:
(Standard Edition) Type of forwarding condition
- The first N: indicates the sequence number of the forwarding rule. Value range: 1–10000.
- The second N: indicates the sequence number of the forwarding condition. Value range: 1–10.
- Forwarding condition types:
	- Host: Domain name
	- Path: Path
	- Header: HTTP header
- Each forwarding condition can be configured individually or in combination. When multiple forwarding conditions are combined, they are connected by 'AND'.
- Multiple values can be configured under the same forwarding condition, and these values are connected by 'OR'.

Rules.N.RuleId.description_en:
Forwarding rule ID.
- Parameter N: indicates the sequence number of the forwarding rule, value range 1–20.
- Use '&' to separate multiple forwarding rules.

Rules.N.ServerGroupId.description_en:
(Basic Edition) ID of the backend server group to forward to

- Parameter N: Indicates the sequence number of the forwarding rule, value range 1–20.
- Use '&' to separate multiple forwarding rules.
- When the forwarding rule action is empty (i.e., forwarding to the server group), this parameter is required.

Rules.N.TrafficLimitEnabled.description_en:
(Basic Edition) QPS throttling switch:
- Values:
	- on: enabled
	- off: disabled
- Notes:
	- If this field is not filled, it means no changes to throttling-related information.
	- After configuring this field, ALB will clear previously configured throttling values Rules.N.TrafficLimitQPS.
	- If this change switches the throttling from enabled (on) to disabled (off), ALB will clear the previously configured throttling values Rules.N.TrafficLimitQPS.
	- If this change switches the throttling from disabled (off) to enabled (on), you must also fill in Rules.N.TrafficLimitQPS to set the specific throttling value.

Rules.N.TrafficLimitQPS.description_en:
(Basic Edition) Rate limit value.
This parameter is valid only when Rules.N.TrafficLimitEnabled is set to on. Indicates requests per second. Value range: 100–100000.

CrossZoneEnabled.description_en:
Enable cross-zone load balancing for the server group

* Available values:
   * on: Enable
   * off: Disable
* If you do not enable this feature, the server group can only be associated with Standard Edition ALB instances

Description.description_en:
Description of the backend server group

* Cannot start with http:// or https://
* Must start with a letter or Chinese character and can include numbers, English commas (,), periods (.), underscores (_), spaces ( ), equal signs (=), hyphens (-), Chinese commas (，), and Chinese periods (。)
* Limited to 1–255 characters

HealthCheck.Domain.description_en: Health check domain name. Must be set to the actual address that provides services on the backend server. This parameter is only effective when HealthCheck.Protocol is set to HTTP

HealthCheck.Enabled.description_en:
Whether the listener enables the health check feature. Values:

* on: Enabled
* off: Disabled

HealthCheck.HealthyThreshold.description_en:
Health check threshold

* Indicates the number of consecutive health checks that must pass for the backend server to be considered healthy
* Unit: times; range: 2–10; default value is 3

HealthCheck.HttpCode.description_en:
Healthy HTTP status codes for health checks. Separate multiple codes with a comma ",". This parameter is effective only when HealthCheck.Protocol is set to HTTP. Values:

* http_2xx
* http_3xx
* http_4xx
* http_5xx

HealthCheck.HttpVersion.description_en:
HTTP protocol version for health checks. This parameter is effective only when HealthCheck.Protocol is set to HTTP. Values:

* HTTP1.0 (default value when using API)
* HTTP1.1

HealthCheck.Interval.description_en: Health check interval in seconds. Range: 1–300 seconds; default: 2 seconds

HealthCheck.Method.description_en:
Health check method. This parameter is only effective when HealthCheck.Protocol is set to HTTP. Available values:

* GET: The server must support the GET method
* HEAD: The server returns only HEAD header information, which can reduce backend resource usage. The server must support the HEAD method

HealthCheck.Port.description_en:
Health check port. Values:

* 0: Use the backend server port for health checks
* 1–65535: Use the specified port for health checks

HealthCheck.Timeout.description_en:
Health check response timeout.

* If the backend server does not respond correctly within the specified time, it is considered unhealthy.
* Unit: seconds; Range: 1–60; Default: 2

HealthCheck.URI.description_en: Health check path. Configure the actual externally accessible path on the backend server. Default is "/". This parameter is effective only when HealthCheck.Protocol is set to HTTP.

HealthCheck.UnhealthyThreshold.description_en:
Unhealthy threshold for health checks.

* Indicates that if the specified number of consecutive health checks result in abnormal status, the backend server will be considered unhealthy.
* Unit: times; Range: 2–10; Default: 3

Scheduler.description_en:
Scheduling algorithm. Available values:

* wrr: Weighted round robin
* wlc: Weighted least connections
* sh: Source address hash

ServerGroupId.description_en: Backend server group ID

ServerGroupName.description_en:
Name of the backend server group

* Must start with a letter or Chinese character and can include numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
* Limited to 1–128 characters
* If this parameter is not provided or no value is entered, the backend server group ID is used by default

SlowStartConfig.SlowStartDuration.description_en: Slow start duration. Unit: seconds. Value range: 30–900.

SlowStartConfig.SlowStartEnabled.description_en:
Whether to enable slow start. Valid values:

- on: Enabled
- off: Not enabled

StickySessionConfig.Cookie.description_en:
Session persistence cookie name for the service configuration. Only valid when session persistence is enabled and cookie overwrite is selected. Specific rules:

* Cookie name length: 1–200 characters
* Name can only contain ASCII letters and numbers; cannot contain half-width commas (,), half-width semicolons (;), or spaces, and cannot start with a dollar sign ($)
* When StickySessionConfig.StickySessionEnabled is on and StickySessionConfig.StickySessionType is server, this parameter is required
* When StickySessionConfig.StickySessionEnabled is on and StickySessionConfig.StickySessionType is insert, this parameter is invalid

StickySessionConfig.CookieTimeout.description_en:
Session persistence cookie timeout. Only effective when session persistence is enabled and cookie insertion is selected. Unit: seconds. Specific rules are as follows:

* Timeout value range: 1–86400. Default value: 1000
* When StickySessionConfig.StickySessionEnabled is on and StickySessionType is insert, this parameter is required
* When StickySessionConfig.StickySessionEnabled is on and StickySessionType is server, this parameter is invalid

StickySessionConfig.StickySessionEnabled.description_en:
Enable session persistence. Available values:

* on: Enable
* off: Disable

ToolPath.description_en: Tool access path for mcp-type server groups. The specific rules are as follows: * Must start with a slash (/), and only one leading slash is allowed. * Path segments can only consist of English letters (A–Z, a–z) and digits (0–9); segments are separated by a single slash (/). * Empty segments or consecutive slashes are not allowed (for example, //, /path//to). * The trailing slash is optional (both /path and /path/ are supported). * The root path (/) is a valid value. * Case-sensitive: uppercase and lowercase letters are strictly distinguished (A and a are different). * The following characters and any other non-alphanumeric characters are not allowed: space, period ., hyphen -, underscore _, equals sign ＝, question mark ?, tilde ~, caret ^, asterisk *, dollar sign $, colon :, parentheses (), brackets [], plus sign +, vertical bar |, etc. * Maximum length: 1024 characters

ServerGroupId.description_en: Backend Server Group ID

Servers.N.Description.description_en:
Backend server description

* Parameter-N: Indicates the sequence number of the backend server. Value range: 1 to 20
* Must start with a letter or Chinese character and can contain numbers, English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equal sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
* Length limit: 1 to 255 characters

Servers.N.InstanceId.description_en:
Backend instance ID
* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the backend server
* When ServerType is ecs or eni, this parameter is the resource ID of Ecs or Eni
* When ServerType is ip, this parameter is the IP address

Servers.N.Ip.description_en:
Specify IP address
* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the specified IP

Servers.N.Port.description_en:
Port number on which the backend server receives requests

* Value range: 1-65535
* Parameter-N: Indicates the sequence number of the backend server. Value range: 1 to 20

Servers.N.ServerId.description_en:
Backend server ID

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the backend server. Value range: 1 to 20
* Use '&' to separate multiple backend server IDs
* If you specify the backend instance using parameters such as InstanceId, this parameter can be omitted

Servers.N.Type.description_en:
Backend server type
- Valid values: ecs, eni, ip
- Parameter N: Indicates the sequence number of the backend server

Servers.N.Weight.description_en:
Backend server weight, value range: 0 to 100

* If the weight is set to 0, requests will not be forwarded to this backend server
* Parameter-N: Indicates the sequence number of the backend server. Value range: 1 to 20

Entries.N.description_en:
IP entry address range.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the IP entry, with a maximum of 50 entries.
* Use “&” to separate multiple IP entries.

ServerGroupId.description_en: Backend server group ID

ServerIds.N.description_en:
Backend server IDs to be deleted, identified by ServerId.

* Parameter-N: Indicates the sequence number of the backend server. Value range is 1 to 20.
* Use “&” to separate multiple backend server IDs.

CACertificate.description_en:
Certificate content. When UpdateMode is set to new, this field is required. Format:
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
Client CA public key certificate (BASE64 encoded)
-----END CERTIFICATE-----

CACertificateId.description_en: New CA certificate ID. When replacing with an existing certificate (UpdateMode is stock), this parameter is required and takes effect.

Description.description_en: Description of the certificate.

OldCACertificateId.description_en: ID of the CA certificate to be replaced.

ProjectName.description_en: Project to which the certificate belongs. This field takes effect when UpdateMode is set to new.

Tags.N.Key.description_en:
User tag key. Specific rules:

* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.
* Case sensitive.
* Cannot start with any case combination of volc: or sys:.
* Cannot start or end with a space.
* Can include characters from any language, numbers, spaces (), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), minus signs (-), and @.
* Tag keys for the same resource cannot be duplicated.

Tags.N.Value.description_en:
User tag value.

* If this parameter is provided, you must first provide Tags.N.Key.
* Specific rules:
   * Length must be between 0 and 256 characters.
   * Case sensitive.
   * Cannot start or end with a space.
   * Can include characters from any language, numbers, spaces (), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), minus signs (-), and @.

UpdateMode.description_en:
Certificate replacement mode. Options:

* new: Upload a new certificate for replacement.
* stock: Use an existing certificate for replacement.

CertCenterCertificateId.description_en:
New certificate ID from Certificate Center
When replacing with an existing certificate (UpdateMode is stock and CertificateSource is cert_center), this parameter is required and takes effect

CertificateId.description_en:
New certificate ID uploaded via ALB
When replacing with an existing certificate (UpdateMode is stock and CertificateSource is alb), this parameter is required and takes effect

CertificateName.description_en:
Certificate name

* Cannot start with http:// or https://
* Must start with a letter or Chinese character; can include numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
* If not specified, defaults to the certificate ID

CertificateSource.description_en:
Source of the new server certificate. Options:

* alb: Certificate uploaded via ALB
* cert_center: Certificate uploaded via Volcano Certificate Center

When the replacement mode is to use an existing certificate (UpdateMode is stock), this parameter is required and takes effect. If not specified, the default value is alb

Description.description_en: Certificate description

OldCertificateId.description_en: ID of the server certificate to be replaced

PrivateKey.description_en:
Certificate private key
Required and effective when UpdateMode is new; format as follows:

* Format 1:

-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
Certificate private key (BASE64 encoded)
-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----

* Format 2:

-----BEGIN EC PARAMETERS-----
Certificate private key (BASE64 encoded)
-----END EC PARAMETERS-----
-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----
Certificate private key (BASE64 encoded)
-----END EC PRIVATE KEY-----

ProjectName.description_en: Project associated with the certificate. This field takes effect when UpdateMode is set to new

PublicKey.description_en:
Certificate public key. Required and effective when UpdateMode is new; format as follows:
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
Server public key certificate (BASE64 encoded)
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
!!! No blank lines allowed in between !!!
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
Intermediate CA public key certificate (BASE64 encoded)
-----END CERTIFICATE-----

Tags.N.Key.description_en:
User tag key. Rules:

* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
* Case sensitive
* Cannot start with any case combination of volc: or sys:
* Cannot start or end with a space
* Can include characters from any language, numbers, spaces (), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and @
* Tag keys for the same resource cannot be duplicated

Tags.N.Value.description_en:
User tag value

* If this parameter is provided, Tags.N.Key must be specified first
* Rules:
   * Length must be between 0 and 256 characters
   * Case sensitive
   * Cannot start or end with a space
   * Can include characters from any language, numbers, spaces (), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and @

UpdateMode.description_en:
Certificate replacement mode. Options:

* new: Upload a new certificate for replacement
* stock: Use an existing certificate for replacement

ResourceIds.N.description_en:
Resource ID.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the resource ID; up to 50 per request
* Use & to separate multiple resource IDs

ResourceType.description_en:
Resource type. The possible values are:

* loadbalancer: Load balancer instance
* listener: Listener
* servergroup: Backend server group
* certificate: Certificate
* acl: Access control policy group
* healthchecktemplate: Health check template
* customizedcfg: Custom configuration

Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key. Rules are as follows:

* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
* Case sensitive; cannot start with any case combination of volc:
* Cannot start or end with a space
* Can include characters from any language, numbers, spaces, underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equal signs (=), plus signs (+), minus signs (-), and @
* Tag keys for the same resource cannot be duplicated

Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value. Specific rules are as follows:

* Length must be between 0 and 256 characters
* Case sensitive; cannot start or end with a space
* Can include characters from any language, numbers, spaces, underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equal signs (=), plus signs (+), minus signs (-), and @
* If this parameter is provided, Tags.N.Key must be provided first

ResourceIds.N.description_en:
Resource ID.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the resource ID. Maximum of 50 per request
* Use & to separate multiple resource IDs

ResourceType.description_en:
Resource type. Possible values:

* loadbalancer: Load balancer instance
* listener: Listener
* servergroup: Backend server group
* certificate: Certificate
* acl: Access control policy group
* healthchecktemplate: Health check template
* customizedcfg: Customized configuration

TagKeys.N.description_en:
Tag key of the label to be deleted. Specific rules:

* Cannot start or end with a space
* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key. Maximum of 50 per request. Use & to separate multiple tag keys

CACertificate.description_en:
Certificate content, format as follows:
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
Client CA public key certificate (BASE64 encoded)
-----END CERTIFICATE-----

CACertificateName.description_en:
Name of the CA certificate. Specific rules:

* Cannot start with http:// or https://
* Must start with a letter or Chinese character; can include numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
* If not specified, defaults to CA certificate ID

Description.description_en: CA Certificate Description

ProjectName.description_en: Project Name Associated with CA Certificate

Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for user label. Specific rules:

* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
* Case sensitive
* Cannot start with any case combination of volc: or sys:
* Cannot start or end with a space
* Can include characters from any language, numbers, spaces (), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equal signs (=), plus signs (+), minus signs (-), and @
* Duplicate tag keys are not allowed for the same resource

Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for user label

* If this parameter is provided, you must first provide Tags.N.Key
* Specific rules:
   * Length must be between 0 and 256 characters
   * Case sensitive
   * Cannot start or end with a space
   * Can include characters from any language, numbers, spaces (), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equal signs (=), plus signs (+), minus signs (-), and @

CertificateName.description_en:
Certificate name. Specific rules are as follows:

* Cannot start with http:// or https://
* Must start with a letter or Chinese character; can include numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
* Length limit: 1–128 characters
* If not specified, defaults to certificate ID

CertificateType.description_en:
Certificate type. Valid value:

* Server: server certificate

Description.description_en: Certificate Description

PrivateKey.description_en:
Certificate private key, formats are as follows:

* Format 1:
   -----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
   Certificate private key (BASE64 encoded)
   -----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
* Format 2:

LifecycleActivityPolicy.description_en:
Strategy executed after the instance exits the suspended state. If left blank, the strategy defined by the associated lifecycle hook will be used. Options:
- CONTINUE: Continue execution
- REJECT: Abort subsequent operations
- ROLLBACK: For scale-in activities, the ECS instance will not be released and the operation will roll back; for scale-out activities, this has the same effect as REJECT
 tip
For a detailed introduction to the instance change process after execution, see [Execution Process and Strategy](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/as/Overview-of-lifecycle-hooks#%E6%89%A7%E8%A1%8C%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B%E5%92%8C%E7%AD%96%E7%95%A5).

ClientToken.description_en:
Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a parameter value to guarantee uniqueness across requests, preventing duplicate operations if the API times out or encounters a server error and the client retries. Value requirements:
Only ASCII characters are supported, and the value must not exceed 64 characters.

LifecycleCommand.CommandId.description_en:
Cloud Assistant command ID, used to execute a Cloud Assistant command on the instance after a lifecycle hook is triggered
- If the command executes successfully, the post-suspension policy follows the CONTINUE action
- If the command fails, times out, or the lifecycle hook times out, the post-suspension policy follows the configuration of the `LifecycleHookPolicy` parameter
 tip
Before associating Cloud Assistant, create the required maintenance command and make sure the relevant instance has the Cloud Assistant client installed. For details, see [Introduction to associating Cloud Assistant with lifecycle hooks](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/as/Overview-of-lifecycle-hooks#%E7%9B%B8%E5%85%B3%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD)

LifecycleCommand.Parameters.description_en:
Parameters and values in Cloud Assistant commands
The number of parameters ranges from 0 to 60. Note the following:
- Parameter names cannot be empty strings and can contain up to 64 characters
- Values can be empty strings
- The combined length of parameters and the original command, after Base64 encoding, must not exceed 16 KB
- The set of parameter names must be a subset of those defined when creating the command. For parameters not provided, default values will be used

LifecycleHookName.description_en:
Lifecycle hook name. Cannot be changed after creation
Allowed values:
- Cannot start with a number, hyphen, or underscore
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens are allowed
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

LifecycleHookPolicy.description_en:
Strategy executed after an instance exits the suspended state. Options:
- CONTINUE: Continue execution
- REJECT: Abort subsequent operations
- ROLLBACK: For scaling in activities, ECS instances will not be released and the operation will roll back; for scaling out activities, this has the same effect as REJECT
 tip
For details on the instance change process after execution, see [Execution Process and Strategy](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/as/Overview-of-lifecycle-hooks#%E6%89%A7%E8%A1%8C%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B%E5%92%8C%E7%AD%96%E7%95%A5).

LifecycleHookTimeout.description_en: Set how long the ECS instance stays in the suspended state. When the timeout is reached, the suspended state ends automatically and scaling actions continue based on the execution policy. Please estimate the time needed for your custom operations and set an appropriate timeout. Valid values: 30–21600 seconds (up to 6 hours). The value must be an integer.

LifecycleHookType.description_en:
Type of scaling activity. When the specified scaling activity occurs, the lifecycle hook triggers and suspends the ECS instance. Options:
- SCALE_IN: Scale in activity
- SCALE_OUT: Scale out activity

ScalingGroupId.description_en: Scaling Group ID You can call [DescribeScalingGroups](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/as/DescribeScalingGroups) to query the scaling group ID

EventTypes.N.description_en:
Event notification types
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the event notification type, with values ranging from 1 to 10
- Use & to separate multiple event notification types
- Values:
    - ScaleOutSuccess: Successful elastic scaling out activity
    - ScaleInSuccess: Successful elastic scaling in activity
    - ScaleOutError: Failed elastic scaling out activity
    - ScaleInError: Failed elastic scaling in activity
    - ScaleOutWarn: Partially successful elastic scaling out activity
    - ScaleInWarn: Partially successful elastic scaling in activity
    - ScaleReject: Elastic scaling activity rejected
    - ScaleOutStart: Elastic scaling group scale-out activity started
    - ScaleInStart: Elastic scaling group scale-in activity started
    - ScheduleTaskExpiring: Periodic rule expiration reminder
