TagFilters.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key. Value range: 1–10.
* Use & to separate multiple tag keys. The relationship between multiple tag keys is logical "AND", meaning listeners with all specified tag keys are queried.

TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en:
Tag value.

* The first N indicates the sequence number of the tag key.
* The second N indicates the sequence number of the tag value. Value range: 1–3. The relationship between multiple tag values under the same tag key is logical "OR", meaning listeners with any of the specified tag values under the same tag key are queried.
* Use & to separate multiple tag values.

* If this parameter is provided, `TagFilters.N.Key` must be set first.
* Passing an empty string means querying listeners with empty tag values.

MaxResults.description_en: Number of queries; default is 10, maximum is 100

NextToken.description_en:
Pagination token used to mark the position for paginated queries.

* If not provided, the query starts from the beginning.
* If you provide the NextToken returned from a previous API call, the query continues from the position marked by that token.

ProjectName.description_en: Name of the project associated with the TLS security policy

SecurityPolicyIds.N.description_en:
TLS custom security policy ID.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the TLS custom security policy, range 1–20.
* Use & to separate multiple TLS custom security policy IDs.

TagFilters.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for the tag. When you specify multiple tag keys, the query returns NLB instances that contain all specified tag keys.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, range 1–10.
* Use & to separate multiple tag keys.

TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en: Tag value for the tag. * The first N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, range 1–10. * The second N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, range 1–3. Multiple tag values under the same tag key are treated with a logical "or (OR)", meaning resources with any of the specified tag values under the same tag key are queried. * Use & to separate multiple tag values. * If you provide this parameter, you must first provideTagFilters.N.Key. * If this parameter is provided as an empty value, it queries resources where the tag value under the specified tag key is empty.

ServerGroupId.description_en:
Server Group ID
You can call the [DescribeNLBServerGroups](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNLBServerGroups) API to query the server group ID.

InstanceIds.N.description_en:
Backend server ID

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the backend server ID, value range 1–20
* Use & to separate multiple backend server IDs

MaxResults.description_en: Number to query, default is 10, maximum is 100

NextToken.description_en: Pagination query token, used to mark the pagination position. This parameter does not need to be set during the first API call. For subsequent queries, set this parameter to the value of the `NextToken` parameter returned from the previous API call.

ProjectName.description_en: Name of the project to which the server group belongs

ServerGroupIds.N.description_en:
Server group ID

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the server group, value range 1–20
* Use & to separate multiple server group IDs

ServerIps.N.description_en:
Backend server IP address

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the backend server IP, value range 1–20
* Use & to separate multiple backend server IP addresses

TagFilters.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key. When specifying multiple tag keys, the query returns server groups that contain all specified tag keys

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, value range 1–10
* Use & to separate multiple tag keys

TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en:
Tag value

* The first N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, value range 1–10
* The second N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, value range 1–3. Multiple tag values under the same tag key are treated as logical "or (OR)", meaning the query returns resources with any of the tag values under the same tag key
* Use & to separate multiple tag values

* If this parameter is passed, you must first pass `TagFilters.N.Key`
* If this parameter is passed as an empty value, the query returns resources with empty tag values under the specified tag key

Type.description_en: Server Group Type

VpcId.description_en: Private network ID of the server

MaxResults.description_en: Number of queries; default is 10, maximum is 100

NextToken.description_en:
Pagination token used to mark the position for paginated queries

* If not specified, the query starts from the beginning
* If you provide the NextToken returned from a previous API call, the query continues from the position marked by that token

SecurityPolicyIds.N.description_en:
TLS system security policy ID

* Parameter-N: Indicates the sequence number of the TLS system security policy. Value range: 1~20
* Use & to separate multiple TLS system security policy IDs

ShowAllZonesEnabled.description_en: Whether to return all availability zones supported by NLB service

LoadBalancerId.description_en:
NLB instance ID.
You can call the [DescribeNetworkLoadBalancers](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNetworkLoadBalancers) API to obtain the NLB instance ID.

IpAddressVersion.description_en:
IP protocol version. Valid values:

* ipv4: IPv4 version
* dualstack: Dual stack, supports both IPv4 and IPv6 versions

LoadBalancerIds.N.description_en:
NLB instance ID.

* N: The sequence number of the NLB instance, value range: 1–20.
* Use & to separate multiple NLB instance IDs.

MaxResults.description_en: Rows per page for paginated queries: 1 to 20, default is 10

NextToken.description_en: Pagination token used to mark the position for paginated queries. You do not need to set this parameter when calling the API for the first time. For subsequent queries, set this parameter to the value of the `NextToken` parameter returned by the previous API call.

ProjectName.description_en:
Name of the project to which the NLB instance belongs.
If this parameter is not specified or left empty, all NLB instances across all projects are queried.

Status.description_en:
Status of the NLB instance. Valid values:

* Inactive: Stopped
* Active: Running
* Creating: Creating
* Provisioning: Provisioning. This status only appears when creating an NLB instance via API.
* Configuring: Configuring
* Deleting: Deleting
* CreateFailed: Creation failed

TagFilters.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key. When multiple tag keys are specified, only NLB instances containing all specified tag keys are queried.

* N: Sequence number of the tag key, value range: 1–10.
* Use & to separate multiple tag keys.

TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en:
Tag value.

* The first N: Sequence number of the tag key, value range: 1–10.
* The second N: Sequence number of the tag value, value range: 1–3. Multiple tag values under the same tag key are in a logical "OR" relationship, meaning resources with any of the specified tag values under the same tag key are queried.
* Use & to separate multiple tag values.

* If this parameter is specified, you must first specify `TagFilters.N.Key`.
* If this parameter is set to an empty value, resources with an empty tag value under the specified tag key are queried.

VpcId.description_en: ID of the VPC to which the NLB instance belongs.

ZoneId.description_en:
Availability zone ID.
You can call the [DescribeNLBZones](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNLBZones) API to view the availability zone IDs in the current region.

TagFilters.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key of the forwarding rule's tag
- Parameter -N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, with a value range of 1–10
- Separate multiple tag keys with &. Multiple tag keys use a logical AND relationship, meaning you can query forwarding rules that have all specified tag keys
- Duplicate tag keys are not allowed

TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en:
Label values for forwarding rule tags
- The first N indicates the label key index (range: 1–10)
- The second N indicates the label value index (range: 1–3). Multiple label values under the same label key have a logical OR relationship, meaning the forwarding rule is queried if any of the label values are added under the same label key
- Separate multiple label values with &

ServerGroupId.description_en: Backend server group ID. You can call the DescribeServerGroups API to get the backend server group ID

LoadBalancerId.description_en: The load balancer instance ID to which the backend server belongs. Call the DescribeLoadBalancers API to get the load balancer instance ID.

PageNumber.description_en: Page number of the list, default value is 1

PageSize.description_en: You can set the number of rows per page for paginated queries from 1 to 100; the default is 10.

ServerGroupIds.N.description_en: Backend server group ID. Call the DescribeServerGroups API to get the backend server group ID. Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the backend server group, ranging from 1 to 100. Separate multiple backend server group IDs with '&'.

TagFilters.N.Key.description_en: Tag key specified when querying resources by tag

TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en: Resource Tag Value

Type.description_en:
Type of backend server group. Options:
instance (default): Only primary or secondary network interfaces of cloud servers can be added as backend servers.
ip: Only IP addresses can be added as backend servers.

LoadBalancerId.description_en: Load Balancer Instance ID

DeliveryType.description_en:
Log Delivery Type

tos (Default): Disable log delivery to Object Storage Service (TOS)
tls: Disable log delivery to Log Service (TLS)

LoadBalancerId.description_en: Load Balancer Instance ID

BucketName.description_en:
The name of the object storage bucket for access logs
Required when DeliveryType is set to tos

DeliveryType.description_en:
Log delivery type. Available options:

tos (default): Disable log delivery to Object Storage Service (TOS)
tls: Disable log delivery to Log Service (TLS)

LoadBalancerId.description_en: Load Balancer Instance ID

TlsProjectId.description_en:
Log project ID
Call the DescribeProject API to query the log project ID
Required when DeliveryType is set to tls

TlsTopicId.description_en:
Log topic ID
You can call the DescribeTopic API to query the log topic ID
This parameter is required when DeliveryType is set to tls

MaxResults.description_en: Number of results per query. Default is 10, maximum is 100

NextToken.description_en: Pagination token used to mark the position for paginated queries. No need to set this when calling the API for the first time. For subsequent queries, use the value of the `NextToken` parameter returned by the previous API call

ResourceIds.N.description_en:
Resource ID

* Parameter - N: Indicates the resource ID index, range 1–20
* Use & to separate multiple resource IDs

* You can call the [DescribeNetworkLoadBalancers](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNetworkLoadBalancers) API to query NLB instance IDs
* You can call the [DescribeNLBListeners](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNLBListeners) API to query listener IDs
* You can call the [DescribeNLBServerGroups](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNLBServerGroups) API to query server group IDs
* You can call the [DescribeNLBSecurityPolicies](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNLBSecurityPolicies) API to query custom TLS security policy IDs

ResourceType.description_en:
Resource type. Valid values:

* nlb: NLB instance
* nlb_listener: Listener
* nlb_servergroup: Server group
* nlb_security_policy: Custom TLS security policy

TagFilters.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key specified when querying resources by tag

* N: Indicates the tag key index, range 1–10. Use & to separate multiple tag keys
* Specifying multiple tag keys queries resources containing all specified tag keys

If the provided `TagFilters.N.Key` does not exist, an empty string is returned

TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en:
Tag value for the resource tag

* The first N: Indicates the tag key index, range 1–10
* The second N: Indicates the tag value index, range 1–3. Multiple tag values under the same tag key are treated as logical "or (OR)", meaning resources with any of the specified tag values under the same tag key are queried
* Use & to separate multiple tag values

* If this parameter is provided, you must first provide `TagFilters.N.Key`
* If this parameter is empty, it queries resources with empty tag values under the specified tag key

TagType.description_en:
Tag type. Valid values:

* custom: User tag
* system: System tag

MaxResults.description_en: Number of items per query: default is 10, maximum is 100

NextToken.description_en: Pagination token used to mark the position in paginated queries. You do not need to set this when calling the API for the first time. For subsequent queries, set this to the value of the NextToken parameter returned by the previous API call.

ResourceIds.N.description_en: Resource ID. Parameter -N indicates the sequence number of the resource ID. Up to 50 IDs per call. Separate multiple resource IDs with &

ResourceType.description_en:
Resource type. Possible values:
CLB: Load balancer instance
acl: Access control
certificate: Certificate
listener: Listener
servergroup: Server group
rule: Forwarding rule
ec: Dedicated cluster

TagFilters.N.Key.description_en: Specify tag keys when querying resources by tag. Parameter -N indicates the tag key index; up to 10 tag keys per request. Separate multiple tag keys with '&'. When you specify multiple tag keys, only resources containing all selected tag keys are returned.

TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en: Tag values for resource tags. You can specify up to 3 tag values for each tag key. If you do not provide this parameter, the system queries CLB instances associated with all tag values under the specified tag key. If this parameter is empty, the system queries CLB instances associated with tags that have an empty value under the specified tag key. If you specify multiple tag values for the same tag key, the system queries the set of CLB instances associated with each tag value. > If you provide this parameter, you must first specify TagFilters.N.Key.

TagType.description_en: Label type. Possible values: custom—user label; system—system label. This parameter can be left empty to query all label types.

AclName.description_en:
Access Control Policy Group Name
Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Can include letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-). Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.

Description.description_en:
Description of the access control policy group
Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. May include letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space, equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
Length: 0 to 255 characters

CertificateId.description_en:
Certificate ID
You can call the DescribeCertificates API to get the certificate ID.

CertificateName.description_en:
Certificate name

Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Can include letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-). Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.

Description.description_en:
Certificate description
Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Can contain letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: English comma (,), English period (.), underscore (_), space, equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。). Length limit: 0–255 characters

AclIds.N.description_en:
Access control policy group ID bound to the listener. You can call the DescribeAcls API to obtain the access control policy group ID
Parameter - N: Indicates the index of the access control policy group. You can specify up to 5 groups
Separate multiple access control policy group IDs with '&'
Note: When the AclStatus parameter is set to on, both AclType and AclIds.N are required

AclStatus.description_en:
Enable access control?
Available values:
on: Enable
off: Disable
If you do not specify a value for this parameter, the current configuration remains unchanged and access control settings are not modified. Setting this parameter will clear the existing AclType and AclIds values.
Note: Changing this parameter from 'on' to 'off' will clear the values of AclType and AclIds. Changing from 'off' to 'on' requires you to set both AclType and AclIds.

AclType.description_en:
Access control mode. Available options:
white: Whitelist mode. The listener only forwards requests from IP addresses or ranges specified in the selected access control policy group. If no IP addresses are added to the selected policy group, the listener does not forward any requests.
black: Blacklist mode. The listener only blocks requests from IP addresses or ranges specified in the selected access control policy group. If no IP addresses are added to the selected policy group, the listener forwards all requests.
Note: When the AclStatus parameter is set to on, both AclType and AclIds.N are required.

Bandwidth.description_en:
Listener bandwidth peak, in Mbps.

Set to -1 to disable rate limiting for the listener. In this case, the listener's bandwidth peak defaults to the remaining bandwidth of the CLB instance.
The listener's bandwidth peak cannot exceed the specification bandwidth of its CLB instance. For details on CLB instance specification bandwidth, see Product Specifications.

Note
Listener rate limiting is currently in invite-only testing. To use this feature, please submit a ticket or contact your account manager to apply.

CertCenterCertificateId.description_en: Certificate ID associated with the listener. Required when modifying an HTTPS listener and the certificate source is cert_center

CertificateId.description_en: Certificate ID associated with the listener. Required when modifying an HTTPS listener and the certificate source is CLB.

CertificateSource.description_en:
Source of the certificate associated with the listener. Valid values:
- clb: Certificate uploaded via CLB
- cert_center: Certificate uploaded via Volcano Certificate Center
Parameter notes:
- This parameter is valid only for HTTPS listeners. If this parameter is provided for listeners using other protocol types, it will be ignored
- If the listener protocol is HTTPS and this parameter is not specified, the default value is clb

ConnectionDrainEnabled.description_en:
Whether to enable graceful connection interruption for the listener. Available options:

On: Enabled
Off: Not enabled

Note

Only Layer 4 listeners (TCP or UDP) support this feature.
This feature is currently in invite-only testing. To request access, please submit a ticket or contact your account manager.

ConnectionDrainTimeout.description_en:
Graceful connection timeout. Range: 0–900 seconds

Required when ConnectionDrainEnabled is set to on
Defaults to 0 when ConnectionDrainEnabled is set to off

Cookie.description_en:
Session persistence cookie name configured on the backend server
- Only letters, numbers, underscores (_) and hyphens (-) are allowed
- Length must be between 1 and 200 characters

Description.description_en:
Listener description

Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Can include letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space, equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
Length must be between 0 and 255 characters

Enabled.description_en:
Whether to enable the listener
Values:
on: Enabled
off: Not enabled

EstablishedTimeout.description_en:
Connection timeout for the listener
Valid values:
TCP protocol: 10–900 seconds
UDP protocol: 1–300 seconds
This setting only applies to listeners using the TCP or UDP protocol. If the listener uses HTTP or HTTPS, this parameter does not apply

HealthCheck.Domain.description_en: The domain name for health checks must be set to the actual service address provided by the backend server. It must contain at least one '.', and cannot start or end with a '.'. Each string can include letters, numbers, '-', and '.' characters. '-' cannot appear at the beginning or end of the string. Length must be between 1 and 128 characters. If this parameter is not provided or no value is specified, the default is blank, meaning the load balancer uses the private IP address of each backend server for health checks. Note: This parameter takes effect only when Protocol is set to HTTP or HTTPS and HealthCheck.Enabled is set to on.

HealthCheck.Enabled.description_en:
Enable health check for the listener
on: Enable (default)
off: Disable
Note: The following parameters are only available when this option is set to on

HealthCheck.HealthyThreshold.description_en: Health check threshold. A backend server is considered healthy if it passes the specified number of consecutive health checks with normal results. Range: 2 to 10; default: 3; unit: checks

HealthCheck.HttpCode.description_en:
Valid HTTP status codes for health checks:
http_2xx (default)
http_3xx
http_4xx
http_5xx
Separate multiple status codes with a half-width comma (,)
Note: This parameter takes effect only when Protocol is set to HTTP or HTTPS and HealthCheck.Enabled is set to on.

HealthCheck.Interval.description_en: Health check interval. Range: 1–300 seconds, default: 2 seconds

HealthCheck.Method.description_en:
Listener health check method. Available options:
GET (default): The server must support the GET method
HEAD: The server returns only the headers, which reduces backend load but requires the server to support the HEAD method
Note: This parameter takes effect only when Protocol is set to HTTP or HTTPS and HealthCheck.Enabled is set to on

HealthCheck.Timeout.description_en:
Health check response timeout. If the backend server does not respond correctly within the specified time, the health check status is set to "abnormal." Value range: 1–60. Default: 2. Unit: seconds
Note: The response timeout must be less than or equal to the check interval.

HealthCheck.URI.description_en: Set the health check path to the actual external service address provided by the backend server. The path must start with '/'. Only letters, numbers, '-', '_', '/', '.', '%', '?', '#', '&', and '=' are allowed. Length must be between 1 and 128 characters. If this parameter is not specified or no value is provided, the default is '/'. Note: This parameter takes effect only when Protocol is set to HTTP or HTTPS and HealthCheck.Enabled is set to on.

HealthCheck.UdpExpect.description_en:
Expected response string for health check. Only letters and numbers are allowed, with a maximum length of 64 characters
Note: This parameter takes effect when Protocol is set to UDP and HealthCheck.Enabled is set to on
HealthCheck.UdpRequest and HealthCheck.UdpExpect must either both be empty or both be non-empty

HealthCheck.UdpRequest.description_en: Health check request string. Only letters and numbers are allowed, with a maximum length of 64 characters. This parameter is active when Protocol is set to UDP and HealthCheck.Enabled is on. HealthCheck.UdpRequest and HealthCheck.UdpExpect must both be empty or both non-empty.

HealthCheck.UnhealthyThreshold.description_en: Unhealthy threshold for health checks. If a backend server fails all of the specified number of consecutive health checks, it is marked as unhealthy. Range: 2 to 10; default: 3; unit: times

KeepaliveTimeout.description_en: Persistent Connection Timeout Duration Between Client and CLB

ListenerId.description_en:
Listener ID
You can call the DescribeListeners API to get the listener ID.

ListenerName.description_en:
Listener name

Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Can include letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-)
Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

LoadType.description_en: Type of load. Only effective when Scheduler is set to wl. Options: queue—uses the total length of the Running Queue and Waiting Queue as the load for scheduling; kv-cache—uses the GPU Kv Cache usage as the load for scheduling

PersistenceTimeout.description_en:
Session persistence timeout. Valid range: 1–3600 seconds. Default: 1000 seconds
Note
This parameter takes effect when PersistenceType is set to source_ip

PersistenceType.description_en:
Session persistence type
Available values:
off (default): disables session persistence
source_ip: uses source IP address
This parameter applies only to TCP or UDP listeners
Session persistence is currently available by invitation only. To request access, contact your account manager to apply for a trial

ProxyConnectTimeout.description_en: It is recommended to set the connection establishment timeout between CLB and backend servers to be greater than the health check timeout

ProxyProtocolType.description_en:
Enable PP protocol
Options:
off (default): Disabled
standard: Enabled
Note: This setting applies only when Protocol is set to TCP or UDP

ProxyReadTimeout.description_en: CLB Read Timeout for Backend Server Response

ProxySendTimeout.description_en: Timeout period for CLB to transmit requests to the backend server

Scheduler.description_en:
Scheduling algorithm used by the listener. Available options:
wrr (default): Weighted round robin. Backend servers with higher weights are selected more frequently.
wlc: Weighted least connections. Assigns different weights to each server based on their processing capacity, so servers handle a number of requests proportional to their weight, based on the least number of connections.
sh: Source hash. Uses consistent hashing based on the source IP address. Requests from the same source IP are always routed to the same backend server.
When EnhancedSchedulerEnable is set to "on" for the listener, the above algorithms are unavailable. Available options: wlr, wlrt, wl. When set to wl, you must configure the LoadType field.

SendTimeout.description_en: Timeout for CLB to send response to client

ServerGroupId.description_en:
Backend server group ID associated with the listener.

For HTTP/HTTPS listeners, this parameter specifies the default backend server group ID. You can call the DescribeServerGroups API to get the backend server group ID.
After August 30, 2021, default backend server group functionality is available for Layer 7 listeners. When editing existing Layer 7 listeners, this parameter is required; otherwise, you cannot modify other listener properties.

WafProtectionEnabled.description_en: Enable WAF inspection submission; WAF-side service identity uses assumeRole calls; not public

AddressIpVersion.description_en:
IP address type for the load balancer instance. Options:
ipv4: Indicates that the load balancer is of IPv4 type and only forwards IPv4 requests
DualStack: Indicates that the load balancer is of dual-stack type and forwards both IPv4 and IPv6 requests
Note: Dual-stack load balancing is currently available by invitation only. To use this feature, contact your account manager to request access

BypassSecurityGroupEnabled.description_en: Do you want to enable the bypass security group feature?

Description.description_en:
Description of the load balancing instance
Must start with a letter or Chinese character. Can include numbers, English commas (,), periods (.), underscores (_), spaces, equals signs (=), hyphens (-), Chinese commas (，), and Chinese periods (。)
Length: 1–255 characters

EniIpv6Address.description_en: The private IPv6 address of the load balancer instance must be within the selected subnet’s IPv6 range and must not be in use. Note: If AddressIpVersion is set to 'DualStack' and this parameter is not provided or no value is specified, the system automatically assigns a private IPv6 address from the subnet’s IPv6 range.

LoadBalancerId.description_en:
Load Balancer Instance ID
You can call the DescribeLoadBalancers API to get the load balancer instance ID

LoadBalancerName.description_en: The name of the load balancing instance. It must start with a letter or Chinese character and may include numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The length must be between 1 and 128 characters.

LoadBalancerSpec.description_en:
Load balancer instances have different specifications. Different specifications offer different forwarding capabilities. For details, see Product Types and Specifications. Available values:
small_1: Small I
small_2: Small II
medium_1: Medium I
medium_2: Medium II
large_1: Large I
large_2: Large II
Note:
The bandwidth of the modified instance specification must be greater than or equal to the total bandwidth of all configured listeners; otherwise, you cannot change the specification.

ModificationProtectionReason.description_en:
Reason for setting modification protection status
Must start with a letter or Chinese character; numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-) are allowed
Length: 1–80 characters
Note: only valid when ModificationProtectionStatus is set to ConsoleProtection

ModificationProtectionStatus.description_en:
Modification protection status for load balancer instances
NonProtection: Disables modification protection; clears any configured modification protection reason after configuration
ConsoleProtection: Enables console modification protection; prevents modifying or deleting the instance via the console, but allows modification or deletion through the API

Type.description_en:
Type of load balancer instance. Available values:
private: Converts a public load balancer instance to a private instance. After conversion, the CLB instance and its associated public IP have independent lifecycles. You can unbind the public IP as needed.
If you do not specify this parameter or leave it empty, the load balancer instance type will not change.

ServerGroupId.description_en: Server group ID. You can call the [DescribeNLBServerGroups](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNLBServerGroups) API to obtain the server group ID.

Servers.N.Description.description_en:
Description of the backend server.

* Must start with a letter or Chinese character. Can include numbers, English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
* Length must be between 1 and 255 characters.

Servers.N.Port.description_en:
The port on which the backend server processes requests. Value range: 1–65535.

* This parameter is required if the server group does not enable all-port forwarding.
* If all-port forwarding is enabled for the server group, the default value for this parameter is 0.

Servers.N.ServerId.description_en:
Backend server ID.
You can call the [DescribeNLBServerGroupAttributes](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeServerGroupAttributes) API to obtain the backend server ID.

Servers.N.Weight.description_en:
Weight of the backend server. Value range: 0–100.

* If the weight is 0, NLB will not forward requests to this backend server.
* If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 0.

AssociateCertificateIds.N.description_en:
Extension certificate to be associated.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the extension certificate ID, with a value range of 1 to 15.
* Use & to separate multiple extension certificate IDs.

AssociateCertificateSource.description_en:
Type of extension certificate to be associated. The values are:

* SSL: SSL certificate.
* PCALeaf: PCA private certificate.

> When the AssociateCertificateSource parameter is specified, the AssociateCertificateIds.N parameter is required; otherwise, an error will occur.

DisassociateCertificateIds.N.description_en:
Extension certificate to be disassociated.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the extension certificate ID, with a value range of 1 to 15.
* Use & to separate multiple extension certificate IDs.

CACertificateId.description_en:
CA certificate associated with the TLS listener. Supports certificates from the BytePlus Certificate Center private root CA and private subordinate CA modules.
> Note:
> * This parameter is required when CAEnabled is set to true.
> * Certificate must be enabled, not expired, and not revoked.
> * National cryptography certificates are currently in beta. To request access, contact your account manager.

CACertificateSource.description_en:
Source of the TLS listener CA certificate. Available values:

* PCARoot: Private CA root certificate
* PCASub: Private CA subordinate certificate

> Note:
> * This parameter is required when CAEnabled is set to true.

CAEnabled.description_en:
Enable mutual authentication for the TLS listener. Available values:

* true: Enable mutual authentication
* false: Disable mutual authentication

> This feature is currently in beta. To request access, contact your account manager.

CertificateId.description_en:
TLS listener server certificate ID. Only BytePlus Certificate Center SSL certificates are supported
> Guomi certificates are currently available for invitation-only testing. If you wish to participate, please contact your account manager

CertificateSource.description_en:
Source of the TLS listener server certificate. Available values:

* SSL: Certificate Center - SSL certificate
* PCALeaf: Certificate Center - private CA private certificate

ConnectionTimeout.description_en:
Listener connection timeout

* When the Protocol parameter is set to TCP or TLS, the valid range is 10–900 seconds
* When the Protocol parameter is set to UDP, the valid range is 10–120 seconds

Description.description_en:
Description of the listener.

* Must start with a letter or Chinese character. Can include numbers, English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
* Length must be between 1 and 255 characters.

Enabled.description_en:
Enable the listener. Available values:

* true: Enable
* false: Disable

ListenerId.description_en:
Listener ID.
You can call the [DescribeNLBListeners](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNLBListeners) API to obtain the listener ID.

ListenerName.description_en:
Listener name

* Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Allowed special characters: period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-)
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

PCACertificateId.description_en:
TLS listener server certificate ID. Only private certificates from the BytePlus Certificate Center private CA are supported.
> Note:
> National cryptography certificates and private CA in Certificate Center are currently in beta. To request access, contact your account manager.

SecurityPolicyId.description_en:
TLS security policy ID. Supports system security policies and custom security policies

* System policy values:
   * tls_cipher_policy_1_0
   * tls_cipher_policy_1_1
   * tls_cipher_policy_1_2
   * tls_cipher_policy_1_2_strict
   * tls_cipher_policy_1_2_strict_with_1_3
* Custom security policy: Enter the custom security policy ID

You can call the [DescribeNLBSecurityPolicies](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNLBSecurityPolicies) API to query custom security policy IDs

SecurityPolicyType.description_en:
Security policy type for the TLS listener. Available values:

* custom: Custom policy
* system: System policy

ServerGroupId.description_en:
Service group ID associated with the listener.
You can call the [DescribeNLBServerGroups](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNLBServerGroups) API to query the server group ID.

* If the listener protocol is TCP, the backend server protocol must be TCP.
* If the listener protocol is UDP, the backend server protocol must be UDP.
* If the listener protocol is TLS, the backend server protocol must be TCP. The following server groups are not supported:
   * Server groups with IP address type are not supported.
   * Server groups with Proxy-Protocol enabled are not supported.

Ciphers.N.description_en:
Update the cipher suites for the TLS custom security policy. Supported cipher suites for each TLS protocol version are as follows:

* TLSv1.0 & TLSv1.1:
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA
   * AES128-SHA
   * AES256-SHA
   * DES-CBC3-SHA
* TLSv1.2:
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA256
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA384
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384
   * AES128-GCM-SHA256
   * AES256-GCM-SHA384
   * AES128-SHA256
   * AES256-SHA256
* TLSv1.3:
   * TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256
   * TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
   * TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
   * TLS_AES_128_CCM_8_SHA256
   * TLS_AES_128_CCM_SHA256
   * TLS_SM4_GCM_SM3
   * TLS_SM4_CCM_SM3

* When passing this parameter, you must provide all cipher suites to be supported. Adding or removing cipher suites individually via this API is not supported.
* If only `Ciphers.N` is provided and `TlsVersions.N` is not, validation is based on the TLS protocol versions supported by the current listener and the cipher suites provided in the request.
* If both `TlsVersions.N` and `Ciphers.N` are provided, validation is based on the TLS protocol versions and cipher suites provided in the request.
* The cipher suites TLS_SM4_GCM_SM3 and TLS_SM4_CCM_SM3 are currently in invitation-only testing. To request access, please contact your account manager.

SecurityPolicyId.description_en:
TLS custom security policy ID.
You can call the [DescribeNLBSecurityPolicies](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNLBSecurityPolicies) API to query the ID of the TLS custom security policy.

SecurityPolicyName.description_en:
Modify the name of the TLS custom security policy.

* Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. The following special characters are allowed: period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-).
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.

TlsVersions.N.description_en:
Update the TLS protocol versions for the TLS custom security policy. Valid values:

* TLSv1.0
* TLSv1.1
* TLSv1.2
* TLSv1.3

* When passing this parameter, you must provide all TLS versions to be supported. Adding or removing TLS protocol versions individually via this API is not supported.
* If only `TlsVersions.N` is provided and `Ciphers.N` is not, validation is based on the TLS protocol versions provided in the request and the cipher suites supported by the current listener.
* If both `TlsVersions.N` and `Ciphers.N` are provided, validation is based on the TLS protocol versions and cipher suites provided in the request.

BypassSecurityGroupEnabled.description_en:
Enable **bypass backend security group validation feature**. This parameter can be configured only for server-type server groups.

* true: Enable. The security group of backend servers in the server group no longer validates NLB traffic; traffic is allowed by default.
* false: Disable

ConnectionDrainEnabled.description_en:
Enable graceful connection termination.
Enter the value exactly as shown below. Do not use any other values.

* true: Enable
* false: Disable

ConnectionDrainTimeout.description_en:
Graceful connection termination timeout. Valid range: 0–900 seconds.
This parameter is required when `ConnectionDrainEnabled` changes from "false" to "true".

Description.description_en:
Server group description

* Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Allowed special characters: comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), Chinese period (。)
* Length limit: 0–255 characters

HealthCheck.Domain.description_en:
Health check domain name. Must be set to the actual address used by the server to provide external services

* Must contain at least one period (.), and cannot start or end with a period (.)
* Only uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens (-), and periods (.) are supported. '-' cannot appear at the beginning or end of the string
* Length limit: 1–80 characters
* If this parameter is not provided, the backend server's private IP address is used for health checks by default

HealthCheck.Enabled.description_en:
Enable health check for the listener.
Enter the value exactly as shown below. Do not use any other values.

* true: Enable
* false: Disable

The following parameters are valid only when this parameter is set to "true".

HealthCheck.HealthyThreshold.description_en:
Health check threshold range: 2 to 10 times
A backend server is considered healthy if it passes the specified number of consecutive health checks with a status of 'normal'

HealthCheck.HttpCode.description_en:
HTTP status codes indicating a healthy health check. Available values:

* http_2xx
* http_3xx
* http_4xx
* http_5xx

This parameter takes effect when `HealthCheck.Type` is set to "HTTP". Use commas to separate multiple status codes.

HealthCheck.Method.description_en:
Health check methods. Available values:

* GET: The server must support the GET method
* HEAD: The server returns only HEAD header information, reducing backend overhead, but must support the HEAD method

This parameter is effective when `HealthCheck.Type` is set to "HTTP"

HealthCheck.Port.description_en:
Health check port, range: 1–65535

* If the server group does not enable full port forwarding, this parameter defaults to 0, meaning the health check uses the backend server port.
* If the server group enables full port forwarding, you must specify this parameter.

HealthCheck.Timeout.description_en:
Health check response timeout range: 1 to 60 seconds.
If the backend server does not respond correctly within the specified time, the health check is marked as "abnormal."

HealthCheck.Type.description_en:
Health check types. Available values:

* TCP: Sends a SYN handshake packet to check if the backend server port is functioning properly
* HTTP: Sends a HEAD or GET request to simulate browsing behavior and verify if the backend server application is running normally
* UDP: Sends ICMP or UDP probe packets to check if the backend server is operating correctly

HealthCheck.URI.description_en:
Health check path.

* Must start with the character “/”.
* Can include letters, numbers, hyphens (-), underscores (_), slashes (/), periods (.), percent signs (%), question marks (?), hash signs (#), ampersands (&), and equal signs (=).
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.

This parameter takes effect when `HealthCheck.Type` is set to "HTTP".

HealthCheck.UdpExpect.description_en:
Expected response string for UDP health check

* Only letters and numbers are allowed, with a maximum length of 64 characters
* This parameter is effective when Protocol is set to UDP and HealthCheck.Enabled is set to on
* The values of HealthCheck.UdpRequest and HealthCheck.UdpExpect must either both be empty or both not empty

HealthCheck.UdpRequest.description_en:
UDP health check request string.

* Only letters and numbers are allowed. Maximum length is 64 characters.
* This parameter takes effect when Protocol is set to UDP and HealthCheck.Enabled is set to on.
* HealthCheck.UdpRequest and HealthCheck.UdpExpect must either both be empty or both be non-empty.

HealthCheck.UnhealthyThreshold.description_en:
Unhealthy threshold for health checks: 2 to 10 times
If a backend server returns "abnormal" for the specified number of consecutive health checks, it will be marked as unhealthy

PreserveClientIpEnabled.description_en:
Enable source IP preservation.
Enter the value exactly as shown below. Do not use any other values.

* true: Enable. NLB includes the client source IP address in packets forwarded to backend servers.
* false: Disable

ProxyProtocolType.description_en:
Enable Proxy-Protocol. Available values:

* off: Disable
* standard: Enable. NLB forwards the client source IP address to the server using Proxy-Protocol. You must also configure Proxy-Protocol on the server.

Scheduler.description_en:
Rules followed by NLB when forwarding traffic.

* wrr: Weighted round robin. Backend servers with higher weights are selected more frequently.
* wlc: Weighted least connections. Based on the least number of connections, assigns different weights to each backend server according to their processing capabilities, allowing them to handle a corresponding number of service requests.
* sh: Source address hash. Uses consistent hashing based on the source IP address; the same source address is routed to the same backend server.

ServerGroupId.description_en:
Server group ID.
You can call the [DescribeNLBServerGroups](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNLBServerGroups) API to obtain the server group ID.

ServerGroupName.description_en:
Server group name

* Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Allowed special characters: period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-)
* Length limit: 1–128 characters

SessionPersistenceEnabled.description_en:
Enable session persistence.
Enter the following values exactly as shown. Do not use other values.

* true: Enabled. Supports session persistence based on source IP address.
* false: Disabled.

TimestampRemoveEnabled.description_en:
Enable timestamp removal for TCP/HTTP/HTTPS packets
Enter the following values exactly as shown; do not use other values

* true: Enable
* false: Disable

This feature is currently in beta. To request access, contact your account manager

AccessLogEnabled.description_en:
Enable access logs

* true: Yes
* false: No

LoadBalancerId.description_en: NLB instance ID. You can call the [DescribeNetworkLoadBalancers](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNetworkLoadBalancers) API to obtain the NLB instance ID.

ProjectName.description_en: Log project ID.

CrossZoneEnabled.description_en:
Whether cross-zone forwarding is enabled for the NLB instance.
Please enter the following enumeration values exactly as shown; do not use other values.

* true: Enabled
* false: Disabled

Description.description_en:
Description of the NLB instance.

* Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Allowed special characters: comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), Chinese period (。)
* Length limit: 0–255 characters

IpAddressVersion.description_en:
IP address version.

* ipv4: IPv4 only
* dualstack: Dual stack, supports both IPv4 and IPv6

If the IPv4 NLB instance has a TLS listener, dual stack modification is not supported.

LoadBalancerId.description_en:
NLB instance ID.
You can call the [DescribeNetworkLoadBalancers](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNetworkLoadBalancers) API to obtain the NLB instance ID.

LoadBalancerName.description_en:
Name of the NLB instance.

* Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Allowed special characters: period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-)
* Length limit: 1–128 characters

ModificationProtectionStatus.description_en:
Status of modification protection for the NLB instance in the console.

* NonProtection: Disabled, allows modification or deletion of the instance via the console
* ConsoleProtection: Enabled, prohibits modification or deletion of the instance via the console

BandwidthPackageId.description_en:
Shared bandwidth package ID

* You can call the [DescribeBandwidthPackages](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/bandwidthpackage/DescribeBandwidthPackages) API to obtain the ID of shared bandwidth packages that the NLB instance can join
* You can call the [DescribeNetworkLoadBalancers](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNetworkLoadBalancers) API to obtain the ID of shared bandwidth packages already joined by the NLB instance

LoadBalancerId.description_en:
NLB instance ID
You can call the [DescribeNetworkLoadBalancers](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNetworkLoadBalancers) API to obtain the NLB instance ID

Operation.description_en:
Add or remove NLB instances from a shared bandwidth package

* add: Add to shared bandwidth package
* remove: Remove from shared bandwidth package

* When the `Protocol` parameter is set to "ipv4", the public IP associated with the NLB instance is added to or removed from the IPv4 shared bandwidth package
* When the `Protocol` parameter is set to "ipv6", the IPv6 public bandwidth associated with the NLB instance is added to or removed from the IPv6 shared bandwidth package

Protocol.description_en:
Protocol type of the NLB network address

* ipv4
* ipv6

LoadBalancerId.description_en:
NLB instance ID.
You can call the [DescribeNetworkLoadBalancers](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNetworkLoadBalancers) API to obtain the NLB instance ID.

NetworkType.description_en:
Network type after modification for the NLB instance.

* internet: public network type
* intranet: private network type

Protocol.description_en:
Protocol type for the NLB instance IP address.

* ipv4
* ipv6

ZoneMappings.N.EipId.description_en:
ID of the public IP to be associated. Each availability zone corresponds to one public IP.
* When the parameter `NetworkType` is "intranet", this parameter cannot be provided.
* Parameters `ZoneMappings.N.ZoneId` and `ZoneMappings.N.EipId` must be provided together or not at all.
* When the parameter `NetworkType` is "internet":
   * Provide an existing public IP.
   * If not provided, a new public IP will be allocated.

ZoneMappings.N.EipIsp.description_en: The IPv4 Eip ISP of specified zone mapping.

ZoneMappings.N.EipSpecificEgress.description_en: The IPv4 Eip specific egress of specified zone mapping.

ZoneMappings.N.ZoneId.description_en:
ID of the availability zone to which the public IP to be associated belongs.
* When the parameter `NetworkType` is "intranet", this parameter cannot be provided.
* Parameters `ZoneMappings.N.ZoneId` and `ZoneMappings.N.EipId` must be provided together or not at all.

LoadBalancerId.description_en:
NLB instance ID.
You can call the [DescribeNetworkLoadBalancers](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNetworkLoadBalancers) API to obtain the NLB instance ID.

SecurityGroupIds.N.description_en:
Security groups associated with the NLB instance.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the security group, with a value range of 1–4.
* Use & to separate multiple security group IDs.

AddZoneMappings.N.EipId.description_en: ID of the public IP associated with the public network NLB instance in the corresponding availability zone

AddZoneMappings.N.EipSpecificEgress.description_en: The specific egress of the eip.

AddZoneMappings.N.Ipv4Address.description_en: IPv4 private VIP address of the NLB instance in the corresponding availability zone

AddZoneMappings.N.SubnetId.description_en: Subnet ID to which the NLB instance belongs in the corresponding availability zone. You can call the [DescribeSubnets](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeSubnets) API to obtain the subnet ID.  If you specify the parameter `AddZoneMappings.N.ZoneId`, it must be provided.

AddZoneMappings.N.ZoneId.description_en: Available zone ID to be added.

DeleteZoneMappings.N.description_en: Availability zone ID to be deleted

LoadBalancerId.description_en: NLB instance ID. You can call the [DescribeNetworkLoadBalancers](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNetworkLoadBalancers) API to obtain the NLB instance ID.

Rules.N.ActionType.description_en:
Forward action
- Forward: Forward to backend server group
- Redirect: Redirect
Note:
If this parameter is not specified or is an empty string, no changes are made by default
No error is reported if the value provided matches the current value

Rules.N.Description.description_en:
Forwarding rule description. Default value is an empty string

Parameter - N: Indicates the forwarding rule number, ranging from 1 to 50
Use '&' to separate multiple forwarding rules
Specification:
Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Allowed characters include letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space, equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
Length limit: 0 to 255 characters

Rules.N.RedirectConfig.Host.description_en:
Redirect target domain name. Only exact domain names are supported.
- Parameter N: Indicates the domain name sequence number, valid range is 1–50
- Use '&' to separate multiple domain names
Requirements:
- Must contain at least one '.' and cannot start or end with '.'
- Only letters, numbers, '.', and '-' are allowed
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
- Exact domain name: A domain name that meets the format requirements, such as www.test.com
> Note:
> When `Rules.N.ActionType` is changed from `Forward` to `Redirect`, if this parameter is not specified or is set to an empty string, it will default to an empty string, and the redirect will use the request domain as the target domain.
> In other cases, if this parameter is not specified, it will remain unchanged by default; if set to an empty string, it will be updated to an empty string.

Rules.N.RedirectConfig.Path.description_en:
Redirect destination path
- Parameter N: Indicates the port number; valid values are 1–50
- Use '&' to separate multiple ports
- Port value range: 1–65535
> Note:
> When `Rules.N.ActionType` is changed from `Forward` to `Redirect`, if this parameter is not specified or is an empty string, it defaults to an empty string, making the redirect path match the request path
> In other cases, if this parameter is not specified, the default is no change; if an empty string is provided, it will be set to an empty string

Rules.N.RedirectConfig.Port.description_en:
Target port for redirection
- Parameter N: Indicates the domain sequence number; valid values are 1–50
- Separate multiple domains with “&”
- Port range: 1–65535
> Note:
> When `Rules.N.ActionType` changes from `Forward` to `Redirect`, if this parameter is not specified or is an empty string, it defaults to an empty string, and the port will be set to the same as the request port
> In other cases, if this parameter is not specified, it remains unchanged by default; if an empty string is provided, it will be set to an empty string

Rules.N.RedirectConfig.Protocol.description_en:
Redirect protocol
- Parameter - N: Indicates the rule sequence number, ranging from 1 to 50
- Use '&' to separate multiple forwarding rules
- Valid values: HTTP, HTTPS (default)
> Note:
> When `Rules.N.ActionType` changes from `Forward` to `Redirect`, if this parameter is not specified or is an empty string, HTTPS is used by default
> In other cases, if this parameter is not specified or is an empty string, no changes are made by default

Rules.N.RedirectConfig.StatusCode.description_en:
Redirect status code
- Parameter N: Indicates the sequence number of the status code, valid values are 1 to 50
- Separate multiple status codes with “&”
- Valid values: 301 (default), 302, 307, 308
> Note:
> If `Rules.N.ActionType` changes from `Forward` to `Redirect` and this parameter is not specified or is an empty string, the default value is 301
> In other cases, if this parameter is not specified or is an empty string, the value remains unchanged by default

Rules.N.RuleId.description_en:
Forwarding rule ID
Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the forwarding rule, with a value range of 1 to 50
Use '&' to separate multiple forwarding rules

Rules.N.ServerGroupId.description_en:
Backend server group ID
Parameter - N: Indicates the forwarding rule index, ranging from 1 to 50
Separate multiple forwarding rules with '&'

Description.description_en:
Description of the backend server group

Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. May contain letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: English comma (,), English period (.), underscore (_), space, equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
Length: 0 to 255 characters

ServerGroupId.description_en: Backend server group ID. You can call the DescribeServerGroups API to obtain the backend server group ID.

ServerGroupName.description_en:
Backend server group name

Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Can include letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-)
Length: 1–128 characters

Servers.N.Description.description_en:
Backend server description

Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the backend server. Valid values are 1 to 20
Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Can include letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space, equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
Length must be between 0 and 255 characters

Servers.N.Port.description_en:
Port number for backend server to receive requests, valid range: 1–65535
Parameter - N: indicates the backend server index, valid range: 1–20

Servers.N.ServerId.description_en:
Backend server ID. You can call the DescribeServerGroupAttributes API to obtain the backend server ID.

Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the backend server. Valid values are 1 to 20.
Separate multiple backend server IDs with '&'.

Servers.N.Weight.description_en:
Backend server weight, value range: 0 to 100

If the weight is set to 0, requests will not be forwarded to this backend server
Parameter - N: the index of the backend server, value range: 1 to 20

Entries.N.description_en:
The address range for IP entries.
Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the IP entry (valid values: 1 to 50)
Separate multiple IP entries with '&'.
When deleting IP entries, any invalid or non-existent entries will be automatically ignored.
Entries.N.example_en:
Entries.1=192.XX.XX.7/16&Entries.2=172.XX.XX.0/24

Note

Invalid or non-existent IP entries are automatically ignored when deleted

ServerGroupId.description_en:
Server group ID.
You can call the [DescribeNLBServerGroups](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNLBServerGroups) API to obtain the server group ID.

ServerIds.N.description_en:
Backend server ID.
You can call the [DescribeNLBServerGroupAttributes](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeServerGroupAttributes) API to obtain the backend server ID.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the backend server. Value range: 1 to 20.
* Use & to separate multiple backend server IDs.

ServerGroupId.description_en: Backend server group ID. You can call the DescribeServerGroups API to get the backend server group ID

ServerIds.N.description_en:
Backend server IDs to delete, identified by ServerId. You can call the DescribeServerGroupAttributes API to obtain backend server IDs

Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the backend server. Valid values are 1 to 20
Separate multiple backend server IDs with '&'

LoadBalancerId.description_en:
Load Balancer Instance ID
You can call the DescribeLoadBalancers API to get the load balancer instance ID

Period.description_en:
Duration for yearly/monthly subscription billing type
* If PeriodUnit is set to Month, valid values are 1–9, 12, 24, and 36
* If PeriodUnit is set to Year, valid values are 1–3
 tip
Note
If this parameter is not provided or no value is specified, the default is 1

PeriodUnit.description_en:
Duration unit for subscription billing. Options:
Month (default): Billed monthly
Year: Billed yearly

LoadBalancerId.description_en: Load balancer instance ID. You can call the DescribeLoadBalancers API to get the load balancer instance ID

RemainRenewTimes.description_en: Number of auto-renewals. Valid values: -1 and 1–100. Default is -1, which means unlimited auto-renewals. Note: Effective only when RenewType is set to 2

RenewPeriodTimes.description_en:
Duration of each automatic renewal, in months. Available values: 1–3, 6, and 12; default is 1
Note: Effective only when RenewType is set to 2

RenewType.description_en:
Renewal type for load balancing instance. Options:
1: Manual renewal (default)
2: Automatic renewal

ResourceIds.N.description_en:
Resource ID.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the resource ID, range: 1–20.
* Separate multiple resource IDs with &.


* You can call the [DescribeNetworkLoadBalancers](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNetworkLoadBalancers) API to query the ID of an NLB instance.
* You can call the [DescribeNLBListeners](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNLBListeners) API to query the ID of a listener.
* You can call the [DescribeNLBServerGroups](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNLBServerGroups) API to query the ID of a server group.
* You can call the [DescribeNLBSecurityPolicies](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/clb/DescribeNLBSecurityPolicies) API to query the ID of a TLS custom security policy.

ResourceType.description_en:
Resource type. The values are:

* nlb: NLB instance.
* nlb_listener: Listener.
* nlb_servergroup: Server group.
* nlb_security_policy: TLS custom security policy.

Tags.N.Key.description_en: User tag key. * Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, range: 1–20. * Separate multiple tag keys with &. * Cannot start with `volc:` or `sys:`, including any case variation. * Length range: 1–128 characters. Supports input of characters from any language, numbers, spaces ( ), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and @ (@). * If the tag key starts or ends with a space, the system will automatically remove it. Tag keys for the same resource must be unique.

Tags.N.Value.description_en: User tag value. * Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, range: 1–20. * Separate multiple tag values with &. * Length range: 0–256 characters. If not specified, defaults to empty. * Supports input of characters from any language, numbers, spaces ( ), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and @ (@). * Case-sensitive. * If the tag value starts or ends with a space, the system will automatically remove it. - EndTime cannot be set to a future time

GroupBy.description_en:
The grouping dimensions used for the metric to query. See [Cloud Monitoring Metric Query](https://console.volcengine.com/cloud_monitor/metricDoc?tabKey=metric) for the **Dimensions** of each product.
- If the **Dimension** column for the metric is not marked as **optional**, it means there are no optional Dimensions. By default, all Dimensions are required and are used as grouping dimensions for the metric.
    Required means that regardless of whether you pass these Dimension parameters, the returned data will be grouped by these Dimensions.
    For example, for the Redis cache database metric **AggregatedTotalQps**, the Dimension column is **ResourceID,Node**.
    - If you pass the Dimension parameter Node but not ResourceID:
        - Query condition: Node=xxx and ResourceID=*
        - Grouping dimensions: Node,ResourceId
    - If you pass both Node and ResourceID:
        - Query condition: Node=xxx and ResourceId=yyy
        - Grouping dimensions: Node,ResourceId

- If the **Dimension** column for the metric is marked as **optional**, it means there are optional Dimensions. You need to specify the GroupBy parameter additionally. For examples, see **GroupBy instructions**.

The SDK must be upgraded to the following versions to support filtering grouping dimensions using GroupBy.

- Python: version 1.0.37 or above
- Go: version 1.0.97 or above
- Java: version 0.1.75 or above

Instances.description_en:
Monitoring metric information to query.
- When there are multiple instances, the logical relationship between instances is 'or'.
- If you do not pass the instance parameter, monitoring data for all instances in the region will be returned. Large data volumes may cause `max-select-point` to exceed the limit and impact your business. Please proceed with caution.
    If an error occurs, see the error code section for the cause and solution of `max-select-point`.

MetricName.description_en: The name of the monitoring metric to query. See [Cloud Monitoring Metric Query](https://console.volcengine.com/cloud_monitor/metricDoc?tabKey=metric) for the **MetricName** of each product.

Period.description_en:
Interval granularity for querying data supports seconds (s), minutes (m), hours (h), days (d), and weeks (w).
- For example, if you query data within 10 minutes and split it by 1 minute, you will receive 10 data points.
- When the selected time range is long, it is not recommended to use small units as the interval. Otherwise, the dataset may become too large, potentially exceeding the `max-select-bucket` limit and affecting your business. Please proceed with caution.
	If an error has already been reported, refer to the error code section for the cause and solution of `max-select-bucket`.
- For an explanation of StartTime and EndTime offsets after passing in Period, see **Period description**.

StatisticsMethods.description_en: Specify the statistical aggregation method for monitoring data. Supports `avg`, `sum`, `max`, and `min`. If not provided, the original query behavior is retained; if provided, the server processes the query results according to the specified aggregation method. When multiple aggregation methods are specified, `MetricDataResults` in the response are returned separately for each aggregation method, and `StatisticsMethods` indicates which aggregation method corresponds to the current result. Special note: It is recommended to refer to the aggregation methods provided in [Cloud Monitoring Metric Query](https://console.volcengine.com/cloud_monitor/docs) when making queries. Using aggregation methods not listed may result in statistical errors.

BfdDetectInterval.description_en: BFD detection interval (ms). Range: 200–1000, default: 1000. If BFD detection is disabled, do not enter this parameter

BfdDetectMultiplier.description_en: BFD detection count. Valid range: 3–10, default is 3. If BFD detection is not enabled, do not provide this parameter.

Description.description_en:
Description of the shared virtual interface.

* Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or number. Can include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, periods (.), spaces ( ), underscores (_), hyphens (-), equals signs (=), English commas (,), Chinese commas (，), and Chinese periods (。).
* Length: 0–255 characters.
* If this parameter is not provided or no value is specified, the default is an empty string.

DirectConnectGatewayId.description_en: ID of the Direct Connect Gateway associated with the virtual interface. You can call DescribeDirectConnectGateways to query the gateway ID.

EnableBfd.description_en:
Whether to enable BFD detection. Please enter the value exactly as shown below, including case. Do not use other values.

* true: Enabled
* false (default): Disabled

EnableBfdEcho.description_en:
Whether to enable BFD detection echo packet mode. Valid values:

* true: Enabled
* false (default): Disabled

EnableNqa.description_en:
Whether to enable NQA detection. Valid values:

* true: Enabled
* false (default): Disabled

> Note
> NQA detection is supported only when `RouteType` is set to `Static`.

LocalIp.description_en: Local gateway interconnection IP address of the shared virtual interface.

NqaDetectInterval.description_en: Interval for sending consecutive probe packets in NQA detection (ms). Range: 1000–5000, default: 2000. If NQA detection is disabled, do not specify this parameter

NqaDetectMultiplier.description_en:
NQA detection count. If the number of consecutive NQA detection failures reaches the configured detection count, this route is considered faulty. Value range: 3–8, default is 5. If NQA detection is not enabled, do not provide this parameter.
> Note
> After enabling NQA, if the route traffic is nearly at the bandwidth limit, it is recommended to set the detection count to `8`.

PeerIp.description_en: Peer gateway interconnection IP address of the shared virtual interface.

RouteType.description_en:
Route type of the shared virtual interface. Valid values:

* BGP: BGP dynamic routing
* Static: Static routing

Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key (Key) for the shared virtual interface.

* Tags.N.Key: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key (Key). Value range: 1–50, and N should be in consecutive ascending order.
* Separate multiple tag keys (Key) with &.
* Cannot start with `volc:` or `sys:`, in any case format. `volc:` and `sys:` are reserved for system tags and cannot be created.
* Length range: 1–128 characters. Supports characters from all languages, numbers, spaces (), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals (=), plus (+), hyphens (-), and @ (@).

Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value (Value) for the shared virtual interface.

* N indicates the sequence number of the tag value (Value), ranging from 1 to 50, and must be in continuous ascending order.
* Multiple tag values (Value) are separated by &.
* Length range: 0–256 characters. If not specified, the default is empty.
* Supports input in any language, numbers, spaces (), underscores (_), periods (.), half-width colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and @ (@).
* Case-sensitive. Cannot start or end with a space.

> Note
> If `Tags.N.Value` is provided, `Tags.N.Key` must also be provided.

VirtualInterfaceName.description_en:
Name of the shared virtual interface.

* Must start with a Chinese character or letter. Can include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
* Length: 1–128 characters.
* If this parameter is not provided or no value is specified, the default is the shared virtual interface instance ID.

VlanId.description_en:
VLAN ID for connecting to the local IDC. Make sure this VLAN ID is not in use. Value range: 0–2999.

* 0: Indicates no VLAN is configured on the physical dedicated connection switch port, using Layer 3 routing interface mode. Only one shared virtual interface without a VLAN tag can be created per physical dedicated connection in this mode.
* 1–2999: Indicates the switch port of the physical dedicated connection uses Layer 3 sub-interface mode. Each sub-interface is configured with a different VLAN ID mapped to a virtual interface. Multiple shared virtual interfaces can be created per physical dedicated connection in this mode.

* 1000Base: Indicates a 1G optical port

* 100GBase: Indicates a 100G optical port

40GBase and 100GBase are not enabled by default. You can contact your account manager to apply for a trial. If this feature is not enabled, avoid passing `40GBase` or `100GBase`.
For related precautions, see [Accessing Physical Dedicated Lines](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/directconnect/Accessing-a-Direct-Connect-connection-1).

PeriodUnit.description_en:

BgpAsn.description_en:
The ASN (Autonomous System Number) of the Direct Connect Gateway.

* The valid range for the Direct Connect Gateway ASN is: 137718, 64512 ~ 65534, 4200000000 ~ 4294967294. Among these, 137718 is the ASN for BytePlus.
* If the Direct Connect Gateway is used only in standard scenarios (such as a local IDC accessing a single cloud VPC resource via Direct Connect), use the BytePlus ASN (137718).
* If the Direct Connect Gateway is used in special scenarios (such as a single IDC accessing multiple Cloud Enterprise Networks via Direct Connect), each Direct Connect Gateway must use a custom ASN and avoid using the BytePlus ASN (137718), ensuring that the ASN for each Direct Connect Gateway is unique.

Description.description_en:
Description of the QoS policy

DirectConnectTrafficQosPolicyName.description_en:
Name of the QoS policy

* Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or number. Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-) are allowed
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
* If not specified, defaults to the QoS policy ID

BandwidthPercent.description_en:
Traffic queue bandwidth percentage

* If the traffic queue type is `High`, this field is not required
* If the traffic queue type is `Medium`, this field must be entered. Value range: 1~99
* The sum of bandwidth limits for all `Medium` traffic queues under the same QoS policy cannot exceed 99

Description.description_en:
Traffic queue description

* Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or number. Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), space ( ), underscore (_), hyphen (-), equals sign (=), English comma (,), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。) are allowed
* Length must be between 0 and 255 characters
* If not specified, defaults to an empty string

DirectConnectTrafficQosPolicyId.description_en: ID of the QoS policy to be bound to the traffic queue. You can call [DescribeDirectConnectTrafficQosPolicies](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/directconnect/DescribeDirectConnectTrafficQosPolicies) to query the QoS policy ID information.

DirectConnectTrafficQosQueueName.description_en:
Traffic queue name

* Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or number. Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-) are allowed
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
* If not specified, defaults to the traffic queue ID

QueueType.description_en:
Traffic queue type

* **High**: High-priority queue. High-priority queues are allocated bandwidth first. Only one high-priority traffic queue can be created per QoS policy
* **Medium**: Regular queue. Bandwidth is allocated based on the bandwidth percentage after the high-priority queue allocation

Each QoS policy supports creating a maximum of **1** `High` type traffic queue (non-upgradable) and **2** `Medium` type traffic queues (upgradable). For more usage restrictions related to QoS policy configuration for dedicated connections, see [Constraints](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/directconnect/Limits)
