- Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"

- Can be empty; length must be between 0 and 256 characters

 tip
If you specify this parameter, you must first specify Tags.N.Key

UniqueSuffix.description_en:
Indicates whether to automatically add an ordered suffix to Hostname and InstanceName when creating multiple Instances. Available values:
- true: Enable ordered suffix
- false (default): Disable ordered suffix
 tip
When ordered suffix is enabled and Hostname is left blank, the system will generate a hostname automatically without an ordered suffix.

UserData.description_en: Instance custom data. Custom data must be Base64 encoded, and its size before encoding cannot exceed 16KB. If left blank, the default is empty.

VersionDescription.description_en: Instance launch template description. Length: 1–255 English or Chinese characters

Volumes.N.DeleteWithInstance.description_en:
Whether the cloud disk is released with the Instance

- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk index. Valid values: 1–15. N = 1 refers to the system disk, which is always released with the Instance by default and cannot be retained. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks.

- Value - DeleteWithInstance: Specifies whether the cloud disk is released with the Instance.

    - true (default): The cloud disk is released with the Instance. Setting this to false has no effect on the system disk; the system disk is always released with the Instance and cannot be retained.

    - false: The cloud disk is not released with the Instance.

- Use '&' to separate multiple cloud disks.

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceIOPS.description_en:
Extra IOPS performance for cloud disks, supported only by ESSD FlexPL data disks. Unit: operations per second. Set this parameter when `ExtraPerformanceTypeId` is `Balance` or `IOPS`. The valid range for extra performance is:
- IOPS type: 1–50000
- Balance type: 1–50000
- Parameter N indicates the disk index. Valid values: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; this parameter is ignored when N is 1. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can set this parameter for data disks.
- Use & to separate multiple cloud disks.

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB.description_en:
Extra cloud disk throughput performance size (MB/s). Supported only for ESSD FlexPL data disks. Set this parameter when `ExtraPerformanceTypeId` is `Throughput`. Valid range: 1–650.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the cloud disk index. Valid values: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; this parameter is ignored when N is 1. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can set this parameter for these disks.
- Separate multiple cloud disks with &

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceTypeId.description_en:
Types of additional disk performance, supported only by ESSD FlexPL data disks. For more information, see [Additional Disk Performance](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/essd_flexpl_volume). Available values: 
- Balance: Balanced performance
- IOPS: IOPS performance
- Throughput: Throughput performance
- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk index. Valid range: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; when N is set to 1, this parameter is ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can set this parameter normally.
- Use & to separate multiple disks.

Volumes.N.Size.description_en:
Cloud disk capacity

- Parameter - N: Indicates the cloud disk number. Valid values: 1–15. N = 1 indicates the system disk; N ≥ 2 indicates data disks

- Value - Size: Indicates the cloud disk capacity in GiB. Valid values:

- System disk:
    - ESSD_PL0: 20–2048
    - PTSSD: 10–500

- Data disk:
    - ESSD_PL0: 10–32768
    - PTSSD: 20–8192

- Use & to separate multiple cloud disks

Volumes.N.SnapshotId.description_en:
Use snapshots to create cloud disks; only data disks can be created using snapshots. You can call the [DescribeSnapshots](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Describesnapshots) API to query snapshot IDs
- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk sequence number, with a value range of 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; when N is 1, this parameter is ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can specify the target data disk snapshot ID
- Separate multiple cloud disks with &
- Only Extreme SSDs support creating cloud disks from snapshots. Performance SSDs do not support snapshot-related features
- Only snapshots with the status 'Available' can be used to create new cloud disks. Snapshots in 'Creating', 'Rolling Back', 'Deleting', or 'Error' status cannot be used to create new cloud disks

Volumes.N.VolumeType.description_en:
Cloud disk types

- Parameter - N: Indicates the cloud disk index. Valid values: 1–15. N = 1 is the system disk; N ≥ 2 are data disks

- Parameter - VolumeType: Indicates the cloud disk type. Valid values:
    - ESSD_PL0: Ultra-fast SSD PL0
    - PTSSD: Performance SSD

- Separate multiple cloud disks with &

VpcId.description_en: Private network ID. You can call the [DescribeVpcs](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeVpcs) API to query eligible private networks.

ZoneId.description_en: The availability zone ID that the Instance belongs to. You can use the [DescribeZones](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeZones) API to query availability zone information within a region.

DeploymentSetGroupNumber.description_en: When an ECS instance is to join or adjust a deployment set whose policy is the deployment set group high availability policy (AvailabilityGroup), you can use this parameter to specify the instance's group number within the deployment set

DeploymentSetId.description_en: Deployment set ID for the instance to join

Description.description_en:
Instance description value:

- Cannot start with a number or hyphen '-'
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores '_' and hyphens '-' are allowed
- Length must be between 0 and 255 characters
- If left blank, defaults to an empty string

Eip.Bandwidth.description_en:
Public IP bandwidth limit, unit: Mbps

- Value range: 1–500
- Default value: 1

 tip
When you configure Eip.Bandwidth or Eip.ISP, the scaling group assigns a public IP when creating an Instance. By default, billing is pay-as-you-go with fixed bandwidth pricing.

Eip.BandwidthPackageId.description_en:
Shared bandwidth package ID, used to add a public IP to a shared bandwidth package. You can call the [DescribeBandwidthPackages](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/bandwidthpackage/DescribeBandwidthPackages) API to query the shared bandwidth package ID. To add a public IP to a shared bandwidth package, the following conditions must be met:

- Both must have the same security protection type
- Both must have the same line type
- The shared bandwidth package must be of IPv4 type

Eip.BillingType.description_en:
Public IP billing method options:

- 2: Pay-As-You-Go – Billed by bandwidth cap
- 3: Pay-As-You-Go – Billed by actual data usage

Eip.ISP.description_en:
Public IP line type options:

- BGP: BGP (multi-line)

- If your account has applied for and enabled static single-line access, you can use the following values:

    - ChinaMobile: China Mobile static single-line
    - ChinaTelecom: China Telecom static single-line
    - ChinaUnicom: China Unicom static single-line

 tip
After configuring Eip.Bandwidth or Eip.ISP, the scaling group will assign a public IP when creating an Instance. By default, billing is pay-as-you-go with fixed bandwidth pricing.

Eip.ReleaseWithInstance.description_en:
Whether the public IP is deleted along with the Instance applies only to pay-as-you-go public IPs. Options: 
- true: The public IP is deleted with the Instance. When the Instance is automatically reclaimed by the system (such as 24 hours after unsubscribing or upon expiration) or deleted using the [DeleteInstance](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DeleteInstance) or [DeleteInstances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DeleteInstances) APIs, the public IP is released together with the Instance. 
- false (default): The public IP is not deleted with the Instance.

Eip.SecurityProtectionInstanceId.description_en:
DDoS Native Protection (Enterprise Edition) ID.

- You can call the [DescInstanceList](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6352/1263659) API to query the ID of DDoS Native Protection (Enterprise Edition).

- When SecurityProtectionTypes.N is set to AntiDDoS_Enhanced, this parameter is required.

Eip.SecurityProtectionTypes.N.description_en:
Security protection types for public IP addresses

- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the security protection type. Only 1 is supported

- Values:

    - AntiDDoS_Enhanced: Request a public IP address with enhanced protection. You can add it to a DDoS Native Protection (Enterprise Edition) instance

 tip

- If you select AntiDDoS_Enhanced, EipAddress.ChargeType cannot be PrePaid, and EipAddress.ISP must be set to BGP

- Enhanced protection public IP addresses are currently in invitation-only testing. To request a trial, please [submit a ticket](https://console.volcengine.com/workorder/create/) or contact your account manager
 

- Leave blank to indicate a public IP address with basic protection

HostName.description_en:
Instance hostname requirements:

- You can use periods (.) to separate the hostname into multiple segments
- Each segment can contain letters, numbers, or hyphens (-)
- The hostname cannot start or end with a hyphen (-) or period (.), and cannot contain consecutive hyphens or periods
- For Linux, the hostname must be 2–59 characters long
- For Windows, the hostname must be 2–10 characters long, cannot contain periods (.), and cannot be composed entirely of numbers

If left blank, the hostname is generated automatically as follows:

- Format: iv- + initial hostname, for example iv-3tigy72q3u3vj0******
- Initial hostname generation logic:
  - Linux: uses all characters after 'i-' in the Instance ID
  - Windows: uses the last 12 characters after 'i-' in the Instance ID

HpcClusterId.description_en:
ID of the high-performance computing cluster to which the Instance belongs.
This parameter is valid and required only when creating a high-performance computing GPU Instance.

ImageId.description_en: Image ID used to launch the Instance. You can query available image resources through the [DescribeImages](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeImages) API.

InstanceChargeType.description_en:
Billing types for instance and cloud disk. Options: 
- PostPaid: Pay-as-you-go 
- PrePaid: Subscription (annual/monthly) 
- Esi: Elastic reservation instance 
- Segmented: Time-based elastic reservation instance
 tip
The time-based elastic reservation instance feature is currently available by invitation only. To request access, please contact your account manager.

InstanceName.description_en:
Instance name requirements:
- Cannot start with a digit, hyphen, or underscore
- Only Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens are allowed
- Length must be 1 to 128 characters
- Special characters are currently not supported; if left blank, defaults to an empty string

InstanceTypeId.description_en: Only one compute specification can be set for an Instance at this time. For more information about Instance specifications, see [Instance Specification Overview](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Introduction-to-instance-types). You can also call the [DescribeInstanceTypes](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeInstanceTypes) API to get the latest specification list.

KeepImageCredential.description_en:
Retain image settings. Options:
- true: Retain image settings. The instance will use the preset password or key pair from the image for login
- false (default): Do not retain image settings
- Only custom images and shared images support this feature
- If this parameter is set to `true`, do not specify `KeyPairName`

KeyPairName.description_en:
When logging in to an Instance using an SSH key pair, enter the name of the key pair.
 tip
If both KeyPairName and Password are set, only KeyPairName will take effect.

LaunchTemplateId.description_en:
Launch Template ID
 tip
- You must specify either LaunchTemplateId or LaunchTemplateName to select a template
- If both LaunchTemplateId and LaunchTemplateName are valid, LaunchTemplateId takes precedence

LaunchTemplateName.description_en:
Launch Template Name
 tip
You must specify either LaunchTemplateId or LaunchTemplateName to identify the template.
If both LaunchTemplateId and LaunchTemplateName are valid, LaunchTemplateId takes precedence.

NetworkInterfaces.N.SecurityGroupIds.N.description_en:
Security group IDs associated with network interfaces:

- The first N indicates the network interface number. N = 1 refers to the primary network interface; N ≥ 2 refers to a secondary network interface.

- The second N indicates the sequence number of the security group associated with the network interface. Valid values: 1–5.

- Value - SecurityGroupIds: indicates the security group ID.

- Separate multiple security group IDs with &.

NetworkInterfaces.N.SubnetId.description_en:
Private subnet ID of the instance. When creating an instance, you can bind secondary network interfaces at the same time

- Parameter - N: Indicates the network interface index. N = 1 is the primary network interface; N ≥ 2 are secondary network interfaces

- Value - SubnetId: The subnet ID of the network interface

- Use & to separate multiple private subnet IDs

ProjectName.description_en:
Project (instance)

- Only letters, numbers, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-) are allowed
- Maximum length: 64 characters

ScheduledInstance.ScheduledInstanceDescr.description_en:
Description of flexible reservation order
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), space, underscore (_), hyphen (-), equals sign (=), English comma (,), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。) are allowed
- Maximum length is 255 characters
- Defaults to an empty string if left blank

ScheduledInstance.ScheduledInstanceName.description_en:
Flexible reservation name requirements:
- Cannot start with a number, hyphen, or underscore
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens are allowed
- Length must be 1–128 characters
- Special characters are not supported for now

SecurityEnhancementStrategy.description_en:
Enable security hardening? Options: 
- Active: Enable security hardening; applies only to public images
- InActive: Disable security hardening; applies to all images
There are no restrictions or validations on the security hardening type when creating an instance launch template. However, using an incorrect security hardening type in the template may cause instance creation to fail.

SpotPriceLimit.description_en:
Maximum hourly price for spot instances, supports up to three decimal places.
 tip
This parameter is only effective when SpotStrategy=SpotWithPriceLimit.

The spot price is not validated when creating an instance launch template. However, if the template uses an incorrect spot price, instance creation may fail.

SpotStrategy.description_en:
Preemptible strategy for pay-as-you-go instances. Available values:

- NoSpot (default): Create a standard pay-as-you-go Instance
- SpotAsPriceGo: System automatically bids based on current market price for a preemptible Instance
- SpotWithPriceLimit: Set a maximum bid price for a preemptible Instance

 tip

- This parameter takes effect when InstanceChargeType is set to PostPaid
- For details on bidding modes for preemptible Instances, see [Purchase Preemptible Instance](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Buying_spot_instance)

SuffixIndex.description_en:
Starting number for ordered suffix

- Value range: 1–999
- Default value: 1

Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag keys for the Instance

- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, valid values: 1–20

- Separate multiple tag keys with &

Naming rules:

- Cannot start with any case combination of volc:

- Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following English symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"

- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

 tip
Tag keys for the same resource must be unique

Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag values for the Instance

- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, with a valid range of 1–20

- Separate multiple tag values with &

Naming rules:

- Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: '_', '.', ':', '/', '=', '+', '-', '@'

- Can be empty; length must be between 0 and 256 characters

 tip
If you specify this parameter, you must first specify Tags.N.Key

UniqueSuffix.description_en:
Indicates whether to automatically add an ordered suffix to Hostname and InstanceName when creating multiple Instances. Options:

- true: Enable ordered suffix
- false (default): Disable ordered suffix

 tip
When ordered suffix is enabled and Hostname is empty, the system will generate a hostname automatically without an ordered suffix

UserData.description_en: Instance custom data. Custom data must be Base64 encoded, and the size before encoding cannot exceed 16 KB. If left blank, the default is empty.

VersionDescription.description_en:
Description of the instance launch template version
Must be 1–256 English or Chinese characters and cannot start with http:// or https://

Volumes.N.DeleteWithInstance.description_en:
Whether the cloud disk is released with the Instance

- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk index, range: 1–15. N = 1 refers to the system disk, which is always released with the Instance and cannot be retained; N ≥ 2 refers to data disks.

- Value - DeleteWithInstance: Specifies whether the cloud disk is released with the Instance.

    - true (default): The cloud disk is released with the Instance. Setting to false has no effect on the system disk; the system disk is always released with the Instance and cannot be retained.

    - false: The cloud disk is not released with the Instance.

- Use '&' to separate multiple cloud disks

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceIOPS.description_en:
Extra IOPS performance for cloud disks, supported only by ESSD FlexPL data disks. Unit: ops/sec. Set this parameter when `ExtraPerformanceTypeId` is set to `Balance` or `IOPS`. The valid range for extra performance is:
- IOPS type: 1–50000
- Balance type: 1–50000
- Parameter N indicates the cloud disk index, with a valid range of 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; if N is set to 1, this parameter will be ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can set this parameter normally.
- Use '&' to separate multiple cloud disks.

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB.description_en:
Extra cloud disk throughput performance in MB/s. Supported only for ESSD FlexPL data disks. Set this parameter when `ExtraPerformanceTypeId` is `Throughput`. Value range: 1–650
- Parameter - N: Indicates the cloud disk sequence number, valid values are 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; when N is 1, this parameter is ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can set this parameter for data disks
- Use & to separate multiple cloud disks

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceTypeId.description_en:
Types of additional disk performance, supported only by ESSD FlexPL data disks. For more information, see [Additional Disk Performance](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/essd_flexpl_volume).
Values:
- Balance: Balanced additional performance
- IOPS: IOPS additional performance
- Throughput: Throughput additional performance
- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk sequence number, range: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; when N is 1, this parameter is ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can set this parameter normally.
- Use & to separate multiple disks.

Volumes.N.Size.description_en:
Cloud disk capacity

- Parameter - N: Indicates the cloud disk number. Valid values: 1–15. N = 1 is the system disk; N ≥ 2 are data disks

- Value - Size: Indicates the cloud disk capacity, in GiB. Valid values:

- System disk:
    - ESSD_PL0: 20–2048
    - PTSSD: 10–500

- Data disk:
    - ESSD_PL0: 10–32768
    - PTSSD: 20–8192

- Use & to separate multiple cloud disks

Volumes.N.SnapshotId.description_en:
Create cloud disks from snapshots; only data disks are supported. You can use the [DescribeSnapshots](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Describesnapshots) API to query snapshot IDs.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the cloud disk sequence number, valid values are 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; when N is set to 1, this parameter is ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can specify the target data disk snapshot ID.
- Use & to separate multiple cloud disks.
- Only Extreme SSDs support creating cloud disks from snapshots; Performance SSDs do not support snapshot-related features.
- Only snapshots with 'available' status can be used to create new cloud disks. Snapshots in 'creating', 'rolling back', 'deleting', or 'error' status cannot be used to create new cloud disks.

Volumes.N.VolumeType.description_en:
Cloud disk type.

- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the cloud disk, value range: 1–15. N = 1 indicates the system disk, N ≥ 2 indicates a data disk.

- Parameter - VolumeType: Indicates the type of cloud disk, possible values:

    - ESSD_PL0: Ultra-fast SSD PL0

    - PTSSD: Performance SSD

- Use & to separate multiple cloud disks.

VpcId.description_en: Private network ID. You can use the [DescribeVpcs](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeVpcs) API to query private networks that meet the criteria.

ZoneId.description_en: The availability zone ID of the Instance. You can call the [DescribeZones](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeZones) API to query availability zone information for a region.

AutoReleaseAt.description_en:
The instance auto release time must be set to a 10-minute mark (e.g., :00, :10, :20, etc.).
When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is set to Segmented, you must specify this parameter. Valid values are:
- If `DeliveryType` is Reserve, the earliest instance release time is one hour after the reserved delivery time slot, rounded up to the next 10-minute mark.
- If `DeliveryType` is Immediate, the earliest instance release time is the next 10-minute mark after the current time. For example, if the current time is 5:02, the earliest auto release time is 5:20.

ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a parameter value to ensure that this value is unique among different requests, preventing duplicate operations if the API call times out or a server error occurs and the client retries. Value: ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters.

Count.description_en:
Number of instances to create, valid range:
- If `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is set to `Esi`, the valid range is 1–500
- If `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is set to `Segmented`:
  - When `DeliveryType` is `Reserve`, the valid range is 1–500
  - When `DeliveryType` is `Immediate`, the valid range is 1–100
Entering 0 defaults to 1

CpuMaxFrequency.description_en:
Specify the maximum CPU frequency in GHz. The value must be between the CPU's base frequency and turbo frequency.
- Currently, only g3al (4xlarge, 8xlarge, 16xlarge, 32xlarge), c3al (4xlarge, 8xlarge, 16xlarge, 32xlarge), r3al (4xlarge, 8xlarge, 16xlarge), g4i, c4i, r4i, g4ie, c4ie, and r4ie Instances support this parameter. For details on base/turbo frequencies and more information, see [Instance specifications](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Introduction-to-instance-types).
- This feature is currently in invite-only testing. To use it, please contact your account manager.

DeletionProtection.description_en:
Instance deletion protection attribute. Specifies whether deletion protection is enabled for the instance when using the console or API. Values:
- true: Enable instance deletion protection
- false (default): Disable instance deletion protection

DeliveryType.description_en:
Elastic Scheduled Instance - Time Slot Delivery Type, options:
- Reserve (default): Scheduled delivery
- Immediate: Immediate delivery
- This parameter is required only when `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is set to `Segmented`.
- Elastic Scheduled Instance - Time Slot is currently in invite-only testing. To request access, please contact your account manager.

Description.description_en:
Instance description. Default value is an empty string
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), space, underscore (_), hyphen (-), equals sign (=), English comma (,), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
- Maximum length is 255 characters

DryRun.description_en:
Whether to only pre-check this request. Options:
- true: Sends a validation request without creating an Instance. The validation checks for required parameters, request format, business restrictions, and ECS inventory. If validation fails, the corresponding error is returned. If validation passes, the error code DryRunOperation is returned.
    When DryRun is set to `true`, if the `Count` or `Mincount` parameter is provided, its value must be 1.
  
- false (default): Sends a normal request. If validation passes, the Instance is created directly.

EipAddress.BandwidthMbps.description_en:
The bandwidth limit for a public IP is 1 Mbps by default.
- When `ChargeType` is set to `PayByBandwidth`: range is 1–500 Mbps
- When `ChargeType` is set to `PayByTraffic`: range is 1–200 Mbps

EipAddress.BandwidthPackageId.description_en:
The ID of the shared bandwidth package, required when adding a public IP to a shared bandwidth package
- You can call the [DescribeBandwidthPackages](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/bandwidthpackage/DescribeBandwidthPackages) API to query the shared bandwidth package ID
- To add a public IP to a shared bandwidth package, the following conditions must be met:
  - Both must have the same security protection type
  - Both must be in the same region
  - The public IP must use pay-as-you-go billing
  - The shared bandwidth package must be of IPv4 type

EipAddress.ChargeType.description_en:
Billing methods for public IP addresses:
- PayByBandwidth (default): Pay-as-you-go—billed by bandwidth cap
- PayByTraffic: Pay-as-you-go—billed by actual data transfer
- PrePaid: Subscription (monthly or yearly)
When the instance billing type (`InstanceChargeType`) is set to `PostPaid`, this parameter cannot be set to `PrePaid`.

EipAddress.ISP.description_en:
The line type for public IP addresses. The default is BGP. Available values:
- BGP: BGP (multi-line)
- If your account has applied for and enabled static single-line access, you can use the following values:
  - ChinaMobile: China Mobile static single-line
  - ChinaTelecom: China Telecom static single-line
  - ChinaUnicom: China Unicom static single-line
- If your account has applied for and enabled BGP single-line access, you can use SingleLine_BGP
- If your account has applied for and enabled static BGP access, you can use Static_BGP

EipAddress.ReleaseWithInstance.description_en:
Whether the public IP is deleted with the instance. Options:
- true: The public IP is deleted with the instance
- false (default): The public IP is not deleted with the instance

EipAddress.SecurityProtectionInstanceId.description_en:
DDoS Native Protection (Enterprise Edition) ID
- You can call the [DescInstanceList](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6352/1263659) API to query the DDoS Native Protection (Enterprise Edition) ID
- When `SecurityProtectionTypes` is set to `AntiDDoS_Enhanced`, this parameter is required

EipAddress.SecurityProtectionTypes.N.description_en:
Security protection types for public IP addresses
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the security protection type. Currently, only 1 is supported
- Values:
   - AntiDDoS_Enhanced: Apply for a public IP address with enhanced protection. You can add it to a DDoS Native Protection (Enterprise Edition) instance
          - If `EipAddress.SecurityProtectionTypes.N` is set to `AntiDDoS_Enhanced`, `EipAddress.ChargeType` cannot be `PrePaid`, and `EipAddress.ISP` must be set to `BGP`
     - Enhanced protection public IP addresses are currently in invite-only testing. To request a trial, contact your account manager to apply
     
   - Leave blank to apply for a public IP address with default protection

ElasticScheduledInstanceType.description_en:
Flexible Reserved Instance type. Options:
- Esi (default): Flexible Reserved Instance
- Time-Segmented: Flexible Reserved Instance - Time-Segmented
Flexible Reserved Instance - Time-Segmented is currently in invite-only testing. To request access, please contact your account manager.

EndDeliveryAt.description_en:
The instance end delivery time must be set to a 10-minute mark, and the interval between the end delivery time and `StartDeliveryAt` must be 10 minutes
- When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is set to `Esi`, the instance end delivery time must be within 4 to 8 hours after the reservation
- When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is set to `Segmented`:
  - If `DeliveryType` is `Reserve`, the instance end delivery time must be within 24 hours after the reservation
  - If `DeliveryType` is `Immediate`, you do not need to provide this parameter

Hostname.description_en:
The instance hostname is the computer name used within the instance's operating system.
- Linux instance:
  - Letters, numbers, periods ("."), and hyphens ("-") are allowed
  - Cannot start or end with a hyphen or period
  - Cannot use hyphens or periods consecutively, or use a hyphen and period together
  - Length must be between 2 and 63 characters

- Windows instance:
  - Letters, numbers, and hyphens ("-") are allowed; cannot be all numbers
  - Cannot start or end with a hyphen, and cannot use hyphens consecutively
  - Length must be between 2 and 15 characters

- If left blank, the hostname is automatically generated using the rule iv- + initial hostname, for example: iv-3tigy72q3u3vj0******
- Initial hostname generation logic:
  - Linux: Extract all characters after 'i-' in the instance ID
  - Windows: Extract the last 12 characters after 'i-' in the instance ID

- When creating instances in batches, you can customize sequential hostnames using the format `name_prefix[begin_number,bits]name_suffix`. For details, see [Batch set sequential instance names or hostnames](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Batch-configuring-sequential-instance-names-or-hostnames)

HpcClusterId.description_en: When creating a high-performance computing GPU instance, specify the high-performance computing cluster ID

HttpTokens.description_en:
Access mode for instance metadata. Specify whether to enforce hardened mode. Options:
- optional (default): Not enforced (compatibility mode). You can access instance metadata either directly or using token-based authentication (hardened mode).
- required: Enforced (hardened mode only). You can access instance metadata only using token-based authentication (hardened mode).
- For details on how to view metadata and which metadata items are supported, see [View Instance Metadata](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Viewing-instance-metadata).
- Hardened mode only is currently in invite-only testing. To request access, contact your account manager.

ImageId.description_en:
Image ID used to launch the instance
You can query available image resources through [DescribeImages](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeImages)

InstallRunCommandAgent.description_en:
Whether to install Cloud Assistant Agent when creating the instance:
- true: Install during creation
- false (default): Do not install during creation
For more information about Cloud Assistant, see [Cloud Assistant Overview](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Overview-of-cloud-assistant).

InstanceName.description_en:
Instance name
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
- If the instance uses an ordered suffix with `SuffixIndex`, the instance name length includes the ordered suffix
- When creating instances in bulk, you can use the format `name_prefix[begin_number,bits]name_suffix` to customize ordered instance names. For details, see [Set ordered instance or host names in bulk](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Batch-configuring-sequential-instance-names-or-hostnames)

InstanceTypeId.description_en:
Instance specifications
- For instance specifications that support reservation purchase, see [Elastic Reservation Instance Overview](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Elastic_Scheduled_Instances_Overview).
- You can call [DescribeAvailableResource](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeAvailableResource) to query the inventory of compute resources in the availability zone.

KeepImageCredential.description_en:
Retain image settings. Options:
- true: Retain image settings. The instance will use the preset password or key pair from the image for login.
- false (default): Do not retain image settings.
- Only custom images and shared images support this feature.
- When this parameter is set to `true`, do not specify `PassWord` or `KeyPairName`.

KeyPairName.description_en:
To log in to an Instance using SSH key authentication, specify the name of an existing key pair.
You can call [DescribeKeyPairs](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeKeyPairs) to view existing key pairs. If none are available, call [CreateKeyPair](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/CreateKeyPair) to create a key pair.
- Windows Instances do not support SSH key authentication. Even if you provide this parameter, only the password (`Password`) is used.
- Linux Instances support login with either a password or a key pair. If you set both `KeyPairName` and `Password` when calling this API, only the key pair (`KeyPairName`) is used.

MinCount.description_en:
Specify the minimum creation quantity for elastic reservation instances. Value range:

- ESI-General, ESI-Scheduled (Reserved Delivery): 1–500
- ESI-Scheduled (Immediate Delivery): 1–100

- Minimum instance creation quantity `MinCount` ≤ creation quantity `Count`
- If inventory > creation quantity `Count`, create according to `Count`
- If minimum creation quantity `MinCount` ≤ inventory ≤ creation quantity `Count`, create according to inventory
- If inventory < minimum creation quantity `MinCount`, creation fails due to insufficient inventory

NetworkInterfaces.N.PrimaryIpAddress.description_en:
Specify the primary IP address for a network interface. Currently, you can specify only one primary IP address, either for the primary network interface or for a secondary network interface.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the interface number. N = 1 refers to the primary network interface; N ≥ 2 refers to secondary network interfaces.
- Use & to separate multiple interfaces

NetworkInterfaces.N.PrivateIpAddresses.N.description_en:
Specify the secondary IP address for the primary network interface card. Currently, only the primary NIC supports secondary IP assignment
- The first N indicates the index of the primary NIC. Only one primary NIC can be bound at this time
- The second N indicates the index of the secondary IP on the primary NIC. The maximum number of assignable secondary IP addresses is the number of private IPs per NIC for this [Instance specification](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Introduction-to-instance-types) minus one primary private IP
- Use & to separate multiple secondary IP addresses

NetworkInterfaces.N.SecurityGroupIds.N.description_en:
Security group ID associated with the network interface card.
- The first N indicates the NIC sequence number. N = 1 means the primary NIC; N ≥ 2 means secondary NICs.
- The second N indicates the sequence number of the security group associated with the NIC. Valid values: 1–5.
- Use & to separate multiple security group IDs.

NetworkInterfaces.N.SubnetId.description_en:
The private subnet ID of the instance. You can attach secondary network interfaces when creating the instance.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the network interface number. N = 1 refers to the primary network interface; N ≥ 2 refers to secondary network interfaces.
- Separate multiple private subnet IDs with &

Password.description_en:
To log in to the Instance using the password method, specify the initial login password for the administrator account with this parameter. The Linux administrator account is root, and the Windows administrator account is Administrator.
Password complexity requirements:
- Length must be between 8 and 30 characters
- Passwords can only contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters, and must include at least three of these types
- Allowed special characters: `~!@#$%^&*()_-+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/
- Passwords cannot start with "/" or "$6$"
Login credentials support three methods: password, key pair, and reserved image settings. When logging in to the Instance using a password, we recommend increasing password complexity to enhance security.

ProjectName.description_en:
Project to which the resource belongs. Each resource can belong to only one project.
- Use only letters, numbers, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).
- Maximum length: 64 characters.

ScheduledInstanceDescription.description_en:
Description for flexible reservation form. Default value is an empty string
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), space, underscore (_), hyphen (-), equals sign (=), English comma (,), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。) are allowed
- Maximum length is 255 characters

ScheduledInstanceName.description_en:
Flexible reservation order name requirements:
- Cannot start with a number, hyphen, or underscore
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens are allowed
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
- Currently, special characters are not supported

SecurityEnhancementStrategy.description_en:
Enable security hardening? Options:
- Active: Enable security hardening for public images only
- InActive: Disable security hardening for all image types

StartDeliveryAt.description_en:
The instance delivery start time must be set to an exact 10-minute mark (e.g., 10:00, 10:10, etc.)
- When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is set to `Esi`, the instance will be delivered within 4 to 8 hours after the reservation
- When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is set to `Segmented`:
  - If `DeliveryType` is `Reserve`, the instance will be delivered within 24 hours after the reservation
  - If `DeliveryType` is `Immediate`, you do not need to specify this parameter

SuffixIndex.description_en: Starting number for ordered suffix, range: 1–999, default: 1

Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for user tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the index of the tag key, with a value range of 1–20
- Separate multiple tag keys with &
Naming rules:
- Cannot start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
- Can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
Tag keys for the same resource must be unique

Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for user tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag values with &
Naming rules:
- Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: '_', '.', ':', '/', '=', '+', '-', '@'
- Can be empty; length must be between 0 and 256 characters
If you specify this parameter, you must first specify `Tags.N.Key`

UniqueSuffix.description_en:
Indicates whether an ordered suffix is automatically added to `Hostname` and `InstanceName` when creating multiple Instances. Values:
- true: Enable ordered suffix
- false (default): Disable ordered suffix
- When ordered suffix is enabled and `Hostname` is empty, the system will automatically generate a hostname without an ordered suffix
- When ordered suffix is enabled and the `[begin_number,bits]` naming format is specified for `Hostname` or `InstanceName`, see [Batch set ordered Instance names or hostnames](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Batch-configuring-sequential-instance-names-or-hostnames) for details

UserData.description_en: Instance custom data. Custom data must be Base64-encoded and cannot exceed 16KB before encoding. If left blank, defaults to empty

Volumes.N.DeleteWithInstance.description_en:
Whether the cloud disk is released with the instance. Values:
- true (default): The cloud disk is released with the instance
- false: The cloud disk is not released with the instance
- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk number, valid range: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk, which is always released with the instance and cannot be retained. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks, which can be set to release with the instance or not.
- Use & to separate multiple cloud disks.

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceIOPS.description_en:
Extra IOPS performance for cloud disks, supported only by ESSD FlexPL data disks. Unit: operations/second.

Set this parameter when `ExtraPerformanceTypeId` is set to `Balance` or `IOPS`. The valid range for each type is:
- IOPS: 1–50000
- Balance: 1–50000

- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk sequence number. Valid values: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; if N is set to 1, this parameter will be ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can set this parameter normally.
- Use & to separate multiple disks.

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB.description_en:
Extra cloud disk throughput (MB/s), supported only by ESSD FlexPL data disks

Set this parameter when `ExtraPerformanceTypeId` is set to `Throughput`
Value range: 1–650

- Parameter - N: Indicates the cloud disk number, valid values: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; if N is 1, this parameter will be ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can set this parameter for these disks
- Separate multiple cloud disks with &

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceTypeId.description_en:
Type of additional disk performance, supported only by ESSD FlexPL data disks. Options:
- Balance: Balanced performance
- IOPS: IOPS performance
- Throughput: Throughput performance
For more information about additional performance, see [Additional Disk Performance](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/essd_flexpl_volume).

- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk number, with a valid range of 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; when N is set to 1, this parameter is ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; this parameter is valid.
- Use & to separate multiple disks

Volumes.N.Size.description_en:
Cloud disk capacity, in GiB. N ranges from 1 to 16. N = 1 indicates a system disk; N ≥ 2 indicates a data disk. Use & to separate multiple cloud disks.

Cloud disk capacity ranges:
- System disk:
  - ESSD_PL0: 20–2048
  - ESSD_FlexPL: 20–2048
    Default: max{40, image size of the specified ImageId}
  

- Data disk:
  - ESSD_PL0: 10–32768
  - ESSD_FlexPL: 10–32768
    If this parameter is not specified, the data disk capacity will use the snapshot size of `Volumes.N.SnapshotId`. If `Volumes.N.SnapshotId` is not provided, an error LimitExceeded.DataVolumeSize will be returned.

Volumes.N.SnapshotId.description_en:
Create a cloud disk from a snapshot. Only data disks are supported. You can use the [DescribeSnapshots](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Describesnapshots) API to query the snapshot ID.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the cloud disk sequence number, ranging from 1 to 16. N = 1 refers to the system disk. When N is set to 1, this parameter is ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to a data disk; you can specify the target data disk snapshot ID.
- Use & to separate multiple cloud disks.
- Only Ultra SSDs support creating cloud disks from snapshots. Performance SSDs do not support snapshot-related features.
- Only snapshots with the 'Available' status can be used to create new cloud disks. Snapshots in 'Creating', 'Rolling Back', 'Deleting', or 'Error' status cannot be used to create new cloud disks.

Volumes.N.VolumeType.description_en:
Cloud disk types and values:
- ESSD_PL0: Ultra-fast SSD PL0
- ESSD_FlexPL: Ultra-fast SSD FlexPL
- Parameter - N: Indicates the cloud disk number. Valid range: 1–16. N = 1 is the system disk; N ≥ 2 are data disks.
- Use & to separate multiple cloud disks.

ZoneId.description_en: ID of the availability zone where the instance is located. You can call [DescribeZones](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeZones) to query availability zone information in a region.

EventTypes.N.description_en:
Up to 100 event types are supported
- Parameter - N: Indicates the index of the event type
- Separate multiple event types with &
- For valid values, see [Subscribe and Modify Event Types](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Subscribe_to_and_modify_event_types)

Type.description_en:
Subscription type, options:
- Notification: Message notification. Channels: SMS, email, in-app message, Feishu

DeleteBindedSnapshots.description_en:
Delete snapshots or snapshot consistency groups when deleting an image?

- false: Do not delete

ImageIds.N.description_en:
Custom image IDs. Up to 100 IDs are supported. You can call the [DescribeImages](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeImages) API with the `Visibility=private` parameter to query and obtain custom image IDs.

- true: Sends a check request without deleting the Instance. Checks include required parameters, request format, and business restrictions. If the check fails, returns the corresponding error. If the check passes, returns the error code DryRunOperation.
- false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, deletes the Instance directly.

ElasticScheduledInstanceType.description_en:
Flexible Reserved Instance type. Possible values:
- NoEsi (default): Non-flexible Reserved Instance
- Esi: Flexible Reserved Instance
- Segmented: Flexible Reserved Instance (time-based)
- Takes effect when the `InstanceChargeType` parameter is set to `PostPaid`
- The time-based Flexible Reserved Instance is currently in invite-only testing. If you would like to try it, please contact your account manager to request access

InstanceChargeType.description_en:
Billing type of the resource. Valid values:
- PostPaid (default): Pay-as-you-go
- PrePaid: Subscription
- ReservedInstance: Reserved Instance voucher

InstanceTypeId.description_en: Specify an instance type or dedicated host type to query

SpotStrategy.description_en:
Preemptible strategies for pay-as-you-go billing. Options:
- NoSpot (default): Standard pay-as-you-go Instance
- SpotAsPriceGo: System sets the bid automatically, following the current market price for preemptible Instances
This parameter takes effect only when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PostPaid`.

VolumeType.description_en:
Specify the cloud disk type to query. Valid values:
- ESSD_PL0: Ultra-fast SSD PL0
- ESSD_FlexPL: Ultra-fast SSD FlexPL

ZoneId.description_en:
Availability Zone ID. You can call [DescribeZones](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeZones) to query availability zone information within a region.
If left blank, returns all eligible resources in all availability zones under the current region (RegionId).

TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en:

InvocationStatus.description_en:
Job status. Determined by the command execution status on all instances specified by the job. Possible values:

- Pending: The command is waiting for validation and scheduling. If any instance has a command status of Pending, the job status is Pending
- Scheduled: The recurring job (Rate) has been scheduled successfully and is waiting to run. If any instance has a command status of Scheduled, the job status is Scheduled
- Running: The job is in progress. If any instance has a command status of Running, the job status is Running
- Success: If all instances have a command status of Success, the job status is Success
- Failed: If all instances have a command status of Failed, the job status is Failed
- Stopped: The recurring or scheduled job was stopped manually
- PartialFailed: In an immediate job, if some instances failed to execute the command, the job status is PartialFailed
- Finished: The recurring job has completed

- Reserve (default): Scheduled delivery
- Immediate: Immediate delivery
- This parameter is valid only when `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is set to `Segmented`
- Elastic Scheduled Instance - Segmented is currently in invite-only testing. To request access, contact your account manager

ElasticScheduledInstanceType.description_en:
Elastic Reservation Instance types and values:
- Esi (default): Elastic Reservation Instance
- Segmented: Elastic Reservation Instance - Segmented
Elastic Reservation Instance - Segmented is currently in invite-only testing. To request access, please contact your account manager.

InstanceTypeId.description_en:
Instance specifications
`ElasticScheduledInstanceType` must be set to `Segmented` for this parameter to be required. Use this parameter to query the reservation and inventory status of the elastic scheduled instance (time-based type) for the current specification.
The elastic scheduled instance (time-based type) is currently available by invitation only. To request access, please contact your account manager.

VolumeType.description_en:
Specify the cloud disk type to query:
- ESSD_PL0: Ultra-fast SSD PL0
- ESSD_FlexPL: Ultra-fast SSD FlexPL

ZoneId.description_en:
Instance availability zone ID
You can call [DescribeZones](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeZones) to query availability zone information in a region
This parameter is required when `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is set to `Segmented`

DeliveryType.description_en:
Elastic Scheduled Instance - Segmented Delivery Type, options:
- Reserve (default): Scheduled delivery
- Immediate: Immediate delivery
- Only required when `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is set to `Segmented`.
- Elastic Scheduled Instance - Segmented Type is currently in invite-only beta. To request access, please contact your account manager.

ElasticScheduledInstanceType.description_en:
Flexible Reserved Instance types and values:
- Esi: Flexible Reserved Instance
- Segmented: Flexible Reserved Instance - Segmented
Flexible Reserved Instance - Segmented is currently available by invitation only. To request access, contact your account manager.

ImageId.description_en: Image ID

InstanceTypeIds.N.description_en:
Filter elastic reservation orders by instance specification; a maximum of 100 are supported
- Parameter -N: indicates the index of the instance specification
- Use & to separate multiple specifications

MaxResults.description_en:
Rows per page for paginated queries:
- Maximum: 100
- Default: 10

NextToken.description_en: Pagination token used to mark the position for paginated queries. You don't need to set this for the first API call. For the next query, use the value of the `NextToken` parameter returned by the previous API call.

ProjectName.description_en:
Resource project: Each resource can belong to only one project
- Only letters, numbers, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-) are allowed
- Up to 64 characters

ScheduledInstanceIds.N.description_en:
Up to 100 flexible reservation order IDs are supported
- Parameter -N indicates the sequence number of the reservation order ID
- Separate multiple IDs with &

ScheduledInstanceName.description_en:
Flexible reservation name requirements:
- Cannot start with a digit, hyphen, or underscore
- Only Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens are allowed
- Length must be 1–128 characters
- Currently, special characters are not supported

Status.description_en:
Reservation Order Status Values:
- CREATING: Creating
- PENDING: Pending Delivery
- DELIVERING: Delivering
- DELIVERED: Delivered
- FAILED: Delivery Failed
- PART_FAILED: Partial Delivery Failed
- INVALID: Invalid
- CANCELED: Canceled

TagFilters.N.Key.description_en:
Label key for user tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the index of the label key. Valid values: 1–10
- Separate multiple label keys with &. Duplicates are not allowed

TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en:
Tag values for user tags
- The first N indicates the index of the tag key (range: 1–10)
- The second N indicates the index of the tag value (range: 1–3). Each tag key supports up to 3 tag values per query
- Separate multiple tag values with &
If you set this parameter, you must first set `TagFilters.N.Key`
- If not set, all tag values under the same tag key will be queried
- If set to an empty string, tags with empty values will be queried

ZoneId.description_en:
Instance availability zone ID
You can call [DescribeZones](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeZones) to query availability zone information within a region

Cpus.description_en:
Number of vCPUs for the instance specification
If both `Cpus` and `MinCpus` are provided, `Cpus` takes effect

Gpu.Count.description_en: Number of GPUs per GPU Instance. For valid values, see the GPU Instance Specifications List (https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/gpu/Instances)

Gpu.ProductName.description_en:
Type of GPU card
- Value: For detailed information on GPU cards available for each Instance, see [GPU Instance Specifications](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/gpu/Instances)
- Default: None, which queries all types
- If you enter a GPU card type that does not exist, the result will be empty

InstanceTypeIds.N.description_en:
Instance specifications
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the instance specification. Valid values: 1–10
- Use & to separate multiple instance specifications
If both `InstanceTypeFamily` and `InstanceTypeIds.N` are provided, `InstanceTypeIds.N` takes precedence

MaxResults.description_en:
Number of rows per page for paginated queries
- Maximum: 1000
- Minimum: 1
- Default: 100

MemorySize.description_en:
Memory size of the instance specification, in MiB
If both `MemorySize` and `MinMemorySize` are provided, `MemorySize` takes precedence

MinCpus.description_en:
Minimum number of vCPUs for the instance type.
- You can use this value to filter results. For example, if you set `MinCpus` to 2, the system returns preemptible instances in the selected zone with vCPUs ≥ 2.
- If both `Cpus` and `MinCpus` are specified, `Cpus` takes precedence.

MinMemorySize.description_en:
Minimum memory size for the instance specification, in MiB
- You can use this value to filter instances by memory size. For example, if you set MinMemorySize to 8, the query returns preemptible instances in the zone with memory capacity ≥ 8 MiB
- If you specify both MemorySize and MinMemorySize, MemorySize takes precedence

NextToken.description_en: Pagination token used to mark the position for paginated queries. Leave this blank for the first API call. For subsequent queries, set this to the value of the `NextToken` parameter returned by the previous API call.

TimestampEnd.description_en:
End time for querying the historical price of a preemptible instance. This time cannot be later than the current time or earlier than 30 days ago. 
- Default is empty, which means the current time.
- Supported time formats: `YYYY-mm-ddTHH:MM:SSZ` or `YYYY-mm-ddTHH:MM:SS+ZZ:ZZ`.

TimestampStart.description_en:
Specify the start time for querying the historical price of a preemptible Instance. If you set the time to 30 days ago, the default start time is 30 days ago. 
- If left empty, the default is 3 hours before the end time
- Supported time formats: `YYYY-mm-ddTHH:MM:SSZ` or `YYYY-mm-ddTHH:MM:SS+ZZ:ZZ`

ZoneId.description_en: The availability zone ID of the instance specification. You can call [DescribeZones](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeZones) to query the availability zone information within a region.

Number of rows per page for paginated queries

- Minimum: 0

SubscriptionIds.N.description_en:
You can specify up to 100 subscription IDs. Use the [CreateSubscription](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/CreateSubscription) API to subscribe to event notifications, or use this API to query your list of subscribed notifications.
- Parameter - N: indicates the index of the subscription ID
- Separate multiple subscription IDs with `&`

Type.description_en:
Subscription Type, values:
- Notification: Message notifications (SMS, email, in-app message, Feishu)

EventId.description_en: Event ID. You can obtain it through event notifications or by querying the [DescribeSystemEvents](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeSystemEvents) API.

Category.description_en:
System event type
Values:
- ResourceEvent: Resource event
- TaskEvent: Task event

CreatedAtEnd.description_en: Use CreatedAtEnd as the endpoint to filter events created before this time. The default value is now, formatted as RFC3339.

CreatedAtStart.description_en: Use CreatedAtStart as the starting point to filter events created after this time. The default value is 24 hours before CreatedAtEnd (refer to the CreatedAtEnd request parameter), formatted as RFC3339.

EventIds.N.description_en:
You can specify up to 100 event IDs. You can obtain event IDs through [Event Notification](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Receiving-event-notifications) or by calling this API.
- Parameter - N: the sequence number of the event
- Separate multiple event IDs with `&`

Rows per page for paginated queries:
- Maximum: 100
- Minimum: 0
- Default: 20

NextToken.description_en: Pagination token used to mark the position for paginated queries. You don't need to set this when calling the API for the first time. For subsequent queries, use the value of the `NextToken` parameter returned by the previous API call.

ProjectName.description_en: The name of the project to which the resource belongs, used in the console to retrieve events for the corresponding resource by project name

ResourceIds.N.description_en:
Resource ID. Supports up to 100 IDs. You can call the [DescribeInstances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeInstances) API to query and obtain Instance IDs.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the resource
- Separate multiple resource IDs with `&`
Currently, only ECS Instances are supported as resource types.

Status.N.description_en:
System event statuses, up to 10 supported
- Parameter - N: Indicates the event type index
- Separate multiple event types with `&`
- Values:
   - UnknownStatus: Unknown status
   - Executing: In progress
   - Succeeded: Execution successful
   - Failed: Failed
   - Inquiring: Awaiting response
   - Scheduled: Scheduled
   - Rejected: Execution rejected by user
   - Canceled: Canceled
   - Paused: Paused
   - Recovered: Recovered

Types.N.description_en:
System event types, supporting up to 100.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the event type sequence number.
- Separate multiple event types with &.
- Values:
  - SystemFailure_Stop: Instance stopped due to system failure
  - SystemFailure_Reboot: Instance rebooted due to system failure
  - DiskError_Redeploy: Instance redeployed due to disk error
  - GpuError_Redeploy: GPU error, instance redeployed
  - SystemMaintenance_Redeploy: Instance redeployed due to system maintenance
  - SystemMaintenance_StopAndRepair: Instance stopped for system repair
  - SystemFailure_Redeploy: Instance redeployed due to system failure
  - SystemFailure_Repair: System failure, repair performed
  - CreateInstance: Create instance
  - RunInstance: Start instance
  - StopInstance: Stop instance
  - DeleteInstance: Delete instance
  - SpotInstanceInterruption_Delete: Spot instance interrupted, instance released
  - AccountUnbalanced_Stop: Account overdue, instance stopped
  - AccountUnbalanced_Delete: Account overdue, instance released
  - InstanceChargeType_Change: Instance billing type changed
  - InstanceConfiguration_Change: Instance configuration changed
  - FileSystemReadOnly_Change: File system changed to read-only
  - RebootInstance: Reboot instance
  - InstanceFailure: Instance exception due to operating system error
  - ApplicationFailure: Application exception
  - DeploymentSet_Modify: Modify instance deployment set
  - ServerMigrationTask: Server migration task
  - ServerMigration_FirstSync: Server migration, full data sync
  - ServerMigration_AdditionalSync: Server migration, incremental data sync
  - GpuRiskDetected: GPU operation risk detected
  - ElasticScheduledInstance_Create: Elastic reservation order created
  - ElasticScheduledInstance_Cancel: Elastic reservation order canceled
  - ElasticScheduledInstance_Deliver: Elastic reservation order delivered
  - ElasticScheduledInstance_AutoRelease: Elastic reserved instance automatically released
  - ElasticScheduledInstance_Invalid: Elastic reservation order invalid
  - InfrastructureUpgrade_Redeploy: Instance redeployed due to infrastructure upgrade
  - DiskErrorDetected: Disk error detected
  - DiskError_ReplaceDisk: Disk replaced due to disk error
  - InstanceOOM: Instance memory OOM
  - MemoryRiskDetected: Memory operation risk detected
  - InstanceFileSystemFailure_StopAndRepair: Instance stopped and repaired due to file system error
  - InstanceDiskStalled: Instance exception due to impaired cloud disk performance
  - SystemMaintenance_ReserveAndRepair: Instance stopped and repaired due to system maintenance

TaskIds.N.description_en:
Task ID. You can specify up to 100 task IDs at a time. Obtain task IDs when using the [ExportImage](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/ExportImage), [CopyImage](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/CopyImage), or other similar APIs to create custom images

- `KeyPairName` and `KeyPairId` cannot both be empty.

ImageId.description_en: Image ID. Call the [DescribeImages](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeImages) API and set the `Visibility=private` parameter to query and obtain your custom image ID.

TOSBucket.description_en: Name of the TOS bucket where the exported image file is stored. You can call the [ListBuckets](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/tos/reference-listbuckets) API to query the TOS bucket name

TOSPrefix.description_en:
Set a custom prefix for the exported image file
- Use letters or numbers only
- 1–30 characters
The final image file saved to TOS will be named:
`CustomPrefix_ImageId_system.qcow2`

WakeUp.description_en:
Whether to wake up instances in a dormant state
- true: Wake up dormant instances
- false (default): Do not wake up dormant instances

DeliveryType.description_en:
Elastic Scheduled Instance – segmented delivery types:
- Reserve (default): Scheduled delivery
- Immediate: Immediate delivery
Only effective when `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is set to `Segmented`.

InstanceTypeId.description_en: Instance Specification ID

StartDeliveryAt.description_en: Start Delivery Time for Time Slot-Type Flexible Reservation Instance (Scheduled Delivery)

VolumeType.description_en:
Cloud disk type. Values:
- ESSD_PL0: Ultra-fast SSD PL0
- ESSD_FlexPL: Ultra-fast SSD FlexPL

ZoneId.description_en:
Instance availability zone ID. Valid values:
- cn-beijing2-b
- cn-datong-a

If you specify any other value, the system returns the public error code InvalidActionOrVersion

Architecture.description_en:
Image architecture type
Options:
- amd64: x86 computing
- arm64: ARM computing

BootMode.description_en:
Boot mode for the image. Options:
- BIOS (default): BIOS boot mode
- UEFI: UEFI boot mode
- Cloud servers with the Elastic Bare Metal specification support only `UEFI` boot mode
- If `Architecture=arm64`, the default is `UEFI` and only `UEFI` can be set

Description.description_en:
Image description
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), equal signs (=), English commas (,) and periods (.), Chinese commas (，) and periods (。), and spaces are allowed
- Length: 0–255 characters
- If left blank, the default is empty

ImageName.description_en:
Image Name
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

ImportDataVolumes.N.DataVolumeUrl.description_en:
The data disk files included in the custom image are available at URL links in the TOS bucket.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the data disk URL, ranging from 1 to 15
- Separate multiple data disk URLs with &
Upload your custom image file to the TOS bucket to get the link. For details, see [Import Custom Image](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Importing-custom-images-1).

LicenseType.description_en:
Image license type. Options:
- VolcanoEngine: Default. Uses the official BytePlus license based on your selected `platform`.
- BYOL: Bring Your Own License (BYOL).
- If you use BYOL, make sure your license key is valid for use on BytePlus
- This parameter only applies when importing commercial images (such as Windows Server); otherwise, it does not take effect

NeedDetection.description_en:
Whether to perform mirror detection
- true: Default, detection enabled
- false: Detection not performed

OsType.description_en:
Operating system type. Options:
- Linux
- Windows
If left blank, BytePlus determines `OsType` based on your `Platform` value.

Platform.description_en:
Image OS distribution. Options:
- CentOS
- Debian
- veLinux
- Windows Server
- Fedora
- OpenSUSE
- Ubuntu
- Rocky Linux
- AlmaLinux

PlatformVersion.description_en: Image release version. Maximum length: 100 characters

ProjectName.description_en: Associated Project

Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for image tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, ranging from 1 to 20
- Separate multiple tag keys with `&`
- Naming rules:
  - Cannot start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
  - Can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
  - Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
- Tag keys for the same resource must be unique

Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Label value for the image tags.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, value range: 1–20.
- Multiple tag values are separated by `&`.

- Naming rules:
  - Can only contain alphabetic characters, numbers, spaces, and English symbols "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@".
  - Can be empty. Length is limited to 0–256 characters.
- If this parameter is passed, `Tags.N.Key` must be passed first.

Url.description_en:
The system disk file included in the custom image is located at a URL in the TOS bucket.
Upload the custom image file to a TOS bucket to obtain the URL. For details, see [Import Custom Image](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Importing-custom-images-1).

ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if retries occur due to API timeouts or server errors. Value: ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters.

Description.description_en:
Description for the key pair:
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), space, underscore (_), hyphen (-), equals sign (=), English comma (,), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
- Maximum length is 255 characters

KeyPairName.description_en:
Key pair name
- Must be unique
- Length must be between 2 and 64 characters
- You can use periods (.) to separate the name into segments; each segment can include letters, numbers, or hyphens (-)
- Cannot start or end with a hyphen (-) or period (.), and cannot contain consecutive hyphens or periods

ProjectName.description_en:
Project for this resource: Each resource can belong to only one project
- Use only letters, numbers, underscores (_), dots (.), and hyphens (-)
- Maximum length: 64 characters

PublicKey.description_en: Public key information of the key pair

Tag key for user tags

- Separate multiple tag keys with &

Naming rules:
- Cannot start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
- Can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
Tag keys for the same resource must be unique

Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for the user tag
- Parameter - N: Indicates the tag value's sequence number, range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag values with &

Naming rules:
- Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
- Can be empty; length must be 0–256 characters

InstanceIds.N.description_en:
You can specify up to 50 Instance IDs. To query and obtain Instance IDs, call the [DescribeInstances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeInstances) API.

- Parameter - N: indicates the sequence number of the instance
- Separate multiple Instance IDs with &

CommandId.description_en: Command ID. You can view all available Command IDs through the [DescribeCommands](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeCommands_-_Query_the_command_list) API

Frequency.description_en:
Execution frequency. This parameter is required only when `RepeatMode=Rate`. Specify the execution interval using a Rate expression in the following format:

- <Interval Value><Interval Unit>
  - Interval unit: Supports minutes (m), hours (h), and days (d). Use for jobs that run at fixed intervals.
  - Interval value range: Minutes 5–60, hours 1–24, days 1–7. The interval must be longer than the job timeout.
- The interval is based on a fixed frequency and does not depend on the actual job duration.
- After the job is created, it runs once at `LaunchTime`, then the next run is scheduled based on the specified interval.

InstanceIds.N.description_en:
Instance ID list, supports up to 200 IDs. You can call the [DescribeInstances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeInstances) API to query and obtain instance IDs.

- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the instance
- Separate multiple instance IDs with `&`

InvocationDescription.description_en: Job description, defaults to an empty string, up to 256 characters

InvocationName.description_en:
Job Name

- Up to 64 characters
- Special characters are not restricted for now
- Duplicate job names are allowed within the same region

LaunchTime.description_en:
Execution time

- For `RepeatMode=Rate`, enter the initial job execution time in the following format:
  - Time format: RFC3339, for example: 2022-11-07T11:49:13Z
- For `RepeatMode=Fixed`, enter the job start time in the following format:
  - Time format: RFC3339, for example: 2022-11-07T11:49:13Z

Parameters.description_en:
When a command includes custom parameters, use this option to pass key-value pairs for those parameters.
For example, if the command is `echo {{name}}`, you can use the `Parameter` option to pass the key-value pair `{"name":"Jack"}`. The custom parameter will automatically replace the variable `name`, generating a new command. The actual command executed will be `echo Jack`. - You can set 0 to 60 custom parameters - Keys cannot be empty strings and can be up to 64 characters long - Values can be empty strings - The combined length of custom parameters and the original command, after Base64 encoding, cannot exceed 16 KB - The set of custom parameter names must be a subset of the parameter set defined when creating the command. Default values will be used for any parameters not provided

ProjectName.description_en:
Project to which the resource belongs
A resource can only belong to one project

RecurrenceEndTime.description_en:
Cycle End Time, only applies to recurring tasks (Rate)
RFC3339 format
Required only when `RepeatMode` is set to `Rate` (recurring jobs)

RepeatMode.description_en:
Set how the command is executed. Supported options:

- Once: Default. Executes the command immediately
- Rate: Executes the command on a recurring schedule. Specify the interval using a Rate expression in the `Frequency` parameter
- Fixed: Executes the command at a scheduled time. Specify the time using the `LaunchTime` parameter

Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for user tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag keys with &

Naming rules:
  - Cannot start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
  - Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
  - Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
Tag keys for the same resource must be unique

Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for the user tag
- Parameter - N: Indicates the index of the tag value, valid range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag values with &

Naming rules:
  - Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
  - Can be empty; length must be between 0 and 256 characters
If you provide this parameter, you must first provide `Tags.N.Key`.

Timeout.description_en:
The maximum timeout for a created command when executed on an ECS Instance, in seconds.

- Default: 60
- Range: 30–86400
If the created command cannot run for any reason, a timeout will occur. After the timeout, the command process will be forcibly terminated.

Username.description_en:
Username for executing commands in the ECS Instance
The username in the command is used by default

WorkingDir.description_en:
The directory where the created command runs in the ECS instance. Default value:
For Linux instances: The default path is /home.

MaxResults.description_en:
Number of rows per page for paginated queries
- Maximum: 100
- Default: 10

NextToken.description_en: Pagination query token used to mark the position in paginated queries. You don't need to set this when calling the interface (API) for the first time. For subsequent queries, set the value to the NextToken parameter returned by the previous interface (API) call.

ResourceIds.N.description_en:
Resource ID
- Parameter - N: Indicates the resource number, range: 1–50
- Use & to separate multiple resources

ResourceType.description_en:
Resource type, values:
- instance: Instance
- image: Image
- reservedinstance: Reserved Instance Coupon
- scheduledinstance: Elastic Scheduled Instance
- keypair: Key Pair

TagFilters.N.Key.description_en:
Specify the tag key when querying resources by tag
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, valid values: 1–10
- Separate multiple tag keys with &, duplicates are not allowed
- If not provided, all tags are queried
- If an empty string is passed, returns error code InvalidTagFilterKey.Malformed

TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en:
Specifies the tag value when querying resources by tag.
- The first N indicates the tag key index (range: 1–10)
- The second N indicates the tag value index (range: 1–3)
- Use & to separate multiple tag values
- If you pass this parameter, you must first pass `TagFilters.N.Key`
- If this parameter is not specified, all tag values under the same tag key are queried
- If an empty string is passed, tags with empty tag values are queried

CommandContent.description_en:
The Base64-encoded content of the command.
- Provide the corresponding command content according to the `ContentEncoding` parameter
- Make sure the script specifies the interpreter on the first line before encoding. Follow these rules:
    - For shell scripts: the first line must be `#!/bin/bash`
    - For Python scripts: the first line must be `#!/usr/bin/python`
- Command content cannot exceed 16KB
- When `EnableParameter=true`, custom parameters are supported in the command content. Follow these rules:
    - Define custom parameters using `{{}}`
    - Spaces and line breaks before and after the parameter name inside `{{}}` are ignored

CommandId.description_en: Custom command ID. You can query and obtain it through the [DescribeCommands](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeCommands_-_Query_the_command_list) API

ContentEncoding.description_en:
Whether the command content is Base64 encoded. Options:

- Base64 (default): Encoded with Base64
- PlainText: Not encoded

Description.description_en:
Command description (leave blank to keep the current description)
- Character limit: 0–256
- Special characters allowed

EnableParameter.description_en:
Specifies whether the created command uses custom parameters. Values:

- false: Does not use custom parameters
- true: Uses custom parameters

Name.description_en:
Command Name (leave blank to keep the current name)
- 1–32 characters
- No restrictions on special characters

ParameterDefinitions.N.DecimalPrecision.description_en:
Specifies the allowed number of decimal places for custom parameter values (numeric)

- 'DecimalPrecision' range: 0–10
- Required when 'Type=Digit'
- Defaults to 0 if 'Required' is set to true

ParameterDefinitions.N.DefaultValue.description_en:
Custom Parameter Default Value
Enter a default value that matches the type specified by the `Type` parameter.

ParameterDefinitions.N.MaxLength.description_en:
Maximum length for custom parameter values (string)

- `MaxLength` range: 1–1000
- Required when `Type=String`; defaults to 1000 if `Required` is set to `true`
- This value must be greater than `MinLength`

ParameterDefinitions.N.MaxValue.description_en:
Maximum value for custom parameter (numeric)

- `MaxValue` range: -1000000 to 1000000
- This field is required when `Type=Digit`
- If `Required` is true, the default value is 1000000
- This value must be less than `MinValue`

ParameterDefinitions.N.MinLength.description_en:
Minimum length for custom parameter value (string)

- `MinLength` range: 1–1000
- Required when `Type=String`; defaults to 1 if `Required` is set to `true`
- `MinLength` must be less than `MaxLength`

ParameterDefinitions.N.MinValue.description_en:
Minimum value for custom parameter (numeric)

- `MinValue` range: -1000000 to 1000000
- Required when `Type=Digit`; defaults to -1000000 if `Required` is true
- This value must be less than `MaxValue`

ParameterDefinitions.N.Name.description_en:
Parameter name, defined in the script using `{{Param}}`. Naming rules:

- Each parameter name must not exceed 64 bytes
- Follow Shell variable naming conventions: use a combination of a-z, A-Z, 0-9, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
- The first character cannot be a number
- No spaces allowed; underscores can be used

ParameterDefinitions.N.Required.description_en:
Whether required. Values:

- true: Required
- false: Optional
When required, use the InvokeCommand API to execute the command and provide a custom parameter value in the `Parameters` argument.

ParameterDefinitions.N.Type.description_en:
Parameter type. Possible values:

- String: Custom parameter type is `String` (string) type
- Digit: Custom parameter type is `Digit` (number) type

Timeout.description_en:
Maximum timeout for executing the created command on an ECS Instance, in seconds (s)

- Value range: 30–86400
- Default: 60
If the created command cannot run for any reason, a timeout will occur. After the timeout, the command process will be forcibly terminated.

Type.description_en:
Command type. Supported values:
- Shell: Indicates the script type is Shell
- Python: Indicates the script type is Python
- Bat: Indicates the script type is Bat
- PowerShell: Indicates the script type is PowerShell

Username.description_en:
Username for command execution
The default user for Linux Instances is `root`.

WorkingDir.description_en:
The directory where the created command runs on the ECS instance.
The default path for Linux instances is `/home`.

AutoPlacement.description_en:
Whether to add the dedicated host to the automatic deployment resource pool. Options:
