- On: Add to the automatic deployment resource pool. When creating an Instance, you do not need to specify a DDH. The system will select a suitable DDH from the pool to deploy the Instance.
- Off (default): Do not add to the automatic deployment resource pool. You need to deploy the Instance on a DDH yourself, that is, specify the DDH when creating the Instance.

For instructions on creating an Instance, see [RunInstances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/RunInstances).

ClientToken.description_en:
Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API call times out or a server error occurs and the client retries. 
Value: Supports ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters.

CpuOvercommitRatio.description_en:
CPU oversubscription ratio increases the number of available vCPUs on a DDH. Available vCPUs on a single DDH = number of physical CPU cores × 2 × CPU oversubscription ratio.
- Value range: 1–4
- Default: the maximum oversubscription ratio supported for configuration.

DedicatedHostClusterId.description_en:
Dedicated host cluster ID
You can call [DescribeDedicatedHostClusters](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6396/1253698) to obtain the dedicated host cluster ID

DedicatedHostId.description_en:
Dedicated Host ID
You can call [DescribeDedicatedHosts](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6396/1253691) to query the dedicated host ID

DedicatedHostName.description_en:
Dedicated host name
- Cannot start with a digit, underscore "_", or hyphen "-"
- Only Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores "_", and hyphens "-" are allowed
- Length must be 1–128 characters
- Special characters are not supported at this time

DedicatedHostRecovery.description_en:
When a dedicated host is in TempUnavailable status, you can choose whether to enable automatic failover migration:
- On: Enable automatic failover migration. When enabled, the host will automatically migrate to a healthy DDH if it fails.
- Off (default): Disable automatic failover migration. You can manually replace the physical host by calling [RedeployDedicatedHost](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6396/1253695).

Description.description_en:
Description for the dedicated host. Default value is an empty string
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), space, underscore (_), hyphen (-), equals sign (=), English comma (,), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。) are allowed
- Maximum length is 255 characters

ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API call times out or a server error occurs and the client retries. Value: ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters

DedicatedHostClusterId.description_en:
Dedicated Host Cluster ID
You can call the [DescribeDedicatedHostClusters](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6396/1253698) API to get the cluster ID.

DedicatedHostClusterName.description_en:
Dedicated Host Cluster Name
- Cannot start with a number, hyphen, or underscore
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens
- Length must be 1–128 characters
- Special characters are not supported for now

Description.description_en:
Description for the dedicated host cluster. The default value is an empty string
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), space, underscore (_), hyphen (-), equals sign (=), English comma (,), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
- Maximum length is 255 characters
Description.example_en: A dedicated host cluster used for testing.

ClientToken.description_en:
Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API call times out or a server error occurs and the client retries. 
Value: Only ASCII characters are supported, up to 64 characters.

DeploymentSetId.description_en:
Deployment Set ID
You can call [DescribeDeploymentSets](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeDeploymentSets) to query the Deployment Set ID

DeploymentSetName.description_en:
Deployment Set Name
- Cannot start with a digit, hyphen, or underscore
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens
- Length must be 1–128 characters

Description.description_en:
Deployment set description
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period '.', space, underscore '_', hyphen '-', equals sign '=', English comma ',', Chinese comma '，', and Chinese period '。'
- Maximum length is 255 characters
Submitting an empty string will clear the existing description

BootMode.description_en:
Boot mode for the image. Leave blank to keep the current configuration. Options:
- BIOS: BIOS boot mode
- UEFI: UEFI boot mode
* Elastic Bare Metal Instances support only `UEFI` boot mode
* The default for ARM images is `UEFI`, and only `UEFI` can be set

Description.description_en:
Image description
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscore (_), hyphen (-), equals sign (=), English comma (,), English period (.), Chinese comma (，), Chinese period (。), and spaces are allowed
- Length limit: 0–255 characters
- Leave blank to keep the current setting
- Enter an empty string to clear the original description

ImageId.description_en: You can call the [DescribeImages](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeImages) API and set the `Visibility=private` parameter to query and obtain the custom image ID

ImageName.description_en:
Image Name
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- May only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

AddAccounts.N.description_en:
Add shared accounts (up to 50 supported)
- Parameter - N: indicates the account index
- Separate multiple accounts with `&`

ImageId.description_en: Image ID. Call the [DescribeImages](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeImages) API and set the `Visibility=private` parameter to query and obtain your custom image ID.

RemoveAccounts.N.description_en:
Delete shared accounts
- Parameter - N: Indicates the account number
- Separate multiple accounts with `&`

ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if retries occur due to API timeouts or server errors. Value: ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters.

CpuOptions.CpuAccelerator.description_en:
Enable CPU accelerator. Values:
- CpuAcceleratorOn: Enable CPU accelerator
- CpuAcceleratorOff: Disable CPU accelerator

CpuOptions.HypervisorOff.description_en:
Disable hyper-threading (SMT). Values:
- true: Disable. Each physical core provides only 1 logical thread when disabled.
- false: Enable

CpuOptions.Numa.description_en:
Enable NUMA. Values:
- true: Enable
- false: Disable

CpuOptions.NumaPerSocket.description_en: Number of NUMA nodes per CPU socket.

CpuOptions.ThreadsPerCore.description_en:
Enable hyper-threading. Values:
- 1: Disable hyper-threading
- 2: Enable hyper-threading

CpuOptions.TopologyType.description_en:
CPU topology mode. Values:
- ContinuousCoreToHTMapping: HT continuous mode
- DiscreteCoreToHTMapping: HT discrete mode
- This feature is currently in invite-only testing. To use it, please contact your account manager.

DeletionProtection.description_en:
The instance deletion protection attribute specifies whether deletion of the instance through the console or API is allowed
Values:
- true: Enable instance deletion protection
- false: Disable instance deletion protection

Description.description_en:
Instance description
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period '.', space, underscore '_', hyphen '-', equals sign '=', English comma ',', Chinese comma '，', and Chinese period '。'
- Maximum length: 255 characters
Passing an empty string will clear the existing description

EnableJumboFrame.description_en:
Enable jumbo frames for the Instance. Values:
- false: Jumbo frames disabled. All NICs on this Instance have an MTU of 1500.
- true: Jumbo frames enabled. All NICs on this Instance have an MTU of 8500.
This feature is only supported on certain Instances. In China East 2 (Shanghai), Instances have this feature enabled by default; in other regions, it is disabled by default. For supported Instances, see [Enable/Disable Jumbo Frames](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Enabling_or_Disabling_jumbo_frames).

Hostname.description_en:
The instance hostname is the computer name inside the instance's operating system.
- Linux instance:
  - Letters, numbers, dots ("."), and hyphens ("-") are allowed.
  - Cannot start or end with a hyphen or dot, and hyphens and dots cannot be used consecutively.
  - Length must be between 2 and 63 characters.
- Windows instance:
  - Letters, numbers, and hyphens ("-") are allowed; the name cannot consist solely of numbers.
  - Cannot start or end with a hyphen, and hyphens cannot be used consecutively.
  - Length must be between 2 and 15 characters.

InstanceName.description_en:
Instance Name
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

Password.description_en:
When logging in to the Instance using the password method, set a login password for the Instance
- Password length must be between 8 and 30 characters
- Password can only contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters, and must include at least three of these types
- Allowed special characters: `~!@#$%^&*()_-+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/
- Password cannot start with '/' or '$6$'

UserData.description_en:
Instance custom data lets you customize instance startup behavior and pass in data
- When passing in data, the custom data must be Base64-encoded, and the size of the custom data before encoding cannot exceed 16 KB
- Passing an empty string clears the custom data

AutoPay.description_en:
Auto Payment Setting:
- true: Auto payment enabled. Make sure your account balance is sufficient. If your balance is insufficient, an exception order will be generated and the billing method change will fail.
- false (default): Only generates the order without charging your account. After the order is created, you can log in to the BytePlus order management page to complete the payment.
If your payment method has insufficient balance, we recommend setting this parameter to `false`.

AutoRenew.description_en:
Whether to automatically renew the Instance after expiration. Values:
- true: auto-renew
- false (default): do not auto-renew
This takes effect only when the `InstanceChargeType` parameter is set to `PrePaid`.

AutoRenewPeriod.description_en:
Duration of each auto-renewal.
- This parameter is valid only when `AutoRenew` is set to `true`. The default value is 1.
- When `PeriodUnit` is set to `Month`, `AutoRenewPeriod` can be 1, 2, 3, 6, or 12.

ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API times out or the server returns an internal error and the client retries. Value: ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters.

DryRun.description_en:
Whether to perform a dry run for this request. Options:
- true: Sends a validation request without changing the billing mode. Checks include required parameters, request format, business restrictions, and ECS inventory. If validation fails, returns the corresponding error. If validation succeeds, returns the error code DryRunOperation.
- false (default): Sends a normal request. If validation passes, the billing mode is changed immediately.

IncludeDataVolumes.description_en:
Convert all pay-as-you-go data disks attached to the instance to subscription data disks
- true: convert
- false (default): do not convert

InstanceChargeType.description_en:
Target billing method to modify for the instance. Options:
- PrePaid (default): Convert a pay-as-you-go instance to a yearly/monthly subscription instance
- PostPaid: Convert a yearly/monthly subscription instance to a pay-as-you-go instance

InstanceIds.description_en: Instance ID

InstanceIds.N.description_en:
Supports up to 20 instance IDs
- Parameter - N: indicates the sequence number of the instance
- Separate multiple instance IDs with &

Period.description_en:
Duration of resource purchase. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 24, 36
This parameter is required and valid only when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`.

PeriodUnit.description_en:
Time unit for resource duration, specified by the Period parameter. Options:
- Month (default)
- Week (not supported)

ClientToken.description_en:
Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API call times out or a server error occurs and the client retries. 
Value: Only ASCII characters are supported, up to 64 characters.

DeploymentSetGroupNumber.description_en:
Deployment set group number, valid range: 1–7
This parameter is required only when `Strategy` is set to `AvailabilityGroup`

DeploymentSetId.description_en:
Target deployment set ID
- Pass an empty string to remove the instance from the deployment set
- You can call [DescribeDeploymentSets](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeDeploymentSets) to query deployment set IDs

HttpTokens.description_en:
Access mode for instance metadata. Specifies whether to enforce hardened mode. Options:
- optional: Not enforced (compatibility mode). You can access instance metadata either directly or using the token-based hardened method.
- required: Enforced (hardened-only mode). Only token-based hardened access to instance metadata is supported.
- For details on how to view metadata and which metadata items are supported, see [View Instance Metadata](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Viewing-instance-metadata).
- Hardened-only mode is currently in invite-only testing. To request access, contact your account manager.

Affinity.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is associated with a dedicated host. Possible values:
- Host: The instance is associated with a dedicated host. When you restart an instance with Stop-Save Mode enabled, it will be deployed on the original host.
- Default: When you restart an instance with Stop-Save Mode enabled, it will first try to migrate to a host that supports automatic deployment. If resources are insufficient, the instance will start on the original host.

ClientToken.description_en:
Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API call times out or a server error occurs and the client retries. 
Value: Supports ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters.

DedicatedHostId.description_en:
Target dedicated host ID. You can call the [DescribeDedicatedHosts](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6396/1253691) API to view available dedicated hosts.
- To migrate the instance to a specified dedicated host, you must provide this parameter.
- To migrate the instance to a dedicated host in the system's automatic deployment resource pool, leave this parameter empty and set `Tenancy` to `Host`. For details on automatic deployment, see [Feature Overview](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6396/1253641).

DryRun.description_en:
Perform pre-check only for this request. Values:
- true: Send a check request without changing the Instance host deployment. The check includes required parameters, request format, business rules, and resource inventory. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code DryRunOperation is returned.
- false (default): Send a normal request. If the check passes, the Instance host deployment is adjusted immediately.

InstanceTypeId.description_en:
Specify the target instance type for the change. When adjusting the instance's host, you can also change its type. The target instance type must match the specifications of the specified dedicated host.
- This parameter takes effect when `MigrationType` is set to `ColdMigration`.
- To deploy the instance on a DDH after the change, you must specify the value of `DedicatedHostId`. If you want the instance to be placed on a shared host, you do not need to specify this value.

MigrationType.description_en:
Specify the migration method for instances when adjusting their deployment on the host machine. Options:
- LiveMigration: Hot migration (migrates without shutting down). The instance must be in the running state
- ColdMigration: Cold migration (migrates after shutting down). The instance must be stopped. You can also change the instance type

Tenancy.description_en:
Whether to deploy the instance on a dedicated host. Options:
- Host: If `DedicatedHostId` is not specified, the instance can be deployed in the automatic deployment pool
- Default: The instance can be deployed on a shared host

ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API times out or the server returns an internal error and the client retries. Value: ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters.

DryRun.description_en:
Whether to only pre-check this request. Values:
- true: Sends a check request without modifying the Instance specifications. The check includes required parameters, request format, business restrictions, and ECS inventory. If the check fails, returns the corresponding error. If the check passes, returns the error code DryRunOperation.
- false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, directly modifies the Instance specifications.

InstanceTypeId.description_en:
Modified instance specifications
For instance families whose specifications support modification, see [Modify Instance Specifications](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Overview-2)

ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API call times out or a server error occurs and the client retries. Value: supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters.

PrimaryIpAddress.description_en:
The new primary private IP address must be within the subnet CIDR block
- You can call [DescribeNetworkInterfaceAttributes](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttributes) to query the primary private IP address of the network interface
- If you do not specify this parameter, the system randomly assigns an address from the subnet CIDR block

SecurityGroupIds.N.description_en:
Security group IDs added to the instance after modifying the VPC
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the security group. Valid values: 1–5
- Separate multiple security group IDs with &
- You must provide this parameter only when you specify `VpcId`
- You can call [DescribeSecurityGroups](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeSecurityGroups) to query security group IDs

SubnetId.description_en:
New subnet ID
- You cannot specify the subnet ID where the instance currently resides
- If `VpcId` is empty, the new subnet and the original subnet must be in the same availability zone and the same VPC. You can call [DescribeSubnets](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeSubnets) to query subnet IDs in the target VPC that are in the same availability zone as the original subnet
- If `VpcId` is not empty, the specified subnet ID must belong to that VPC and be in the same availability zone as the original subnet

VpcId.description_en:
Target VPC ID
- If you do not specify this parameter, you change the subnet within the same VPC
- You can call [DescribeVpcs](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeVpcs) to query available VPCs in the same region as the Instance

ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API call times out or a server error occurs and the client retries. Value: supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters.

InstanceIds.description_en: Instance ID

InstanceIds.N.description_en:
Supports up to 20 instance IDs
Parameter - N: indicates the sequence number of the instance
Separate multiple instance IDs with &

InstanceTypeId.description_en: Modified Instance Specifications

ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API call times out or a server error occurs and the client retries. Value: ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters

Description.description_en:
Description for the key pair. Default is an empty string
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), space, underscore (_), hyphen (-), equals sign (=), English comma (,), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。) are allowed
- Maximum length is 255 characters
- Entering an empty string will clear the existing description

KeyPairId.description_en:
Unique key pair ID. You can query it using the [DescribeKeyPairs](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeKeyPairs) API.
- `KeyPairName` and `KeyPairId` cannot both be empty.
- If both `KeyPairName` and `KeyPairId` are set, `KeyPairId` takes precedence.

KeyPairName.description_en:
Key pair name
- `KeyPairName` and `KeyPairId` cannot both be empty
- If both `KeyPairName` and `KeyPairId` are set, `KeyPairId` takes priority

AutoRenew.description_en:
Whether to enable auto-renewal for the target reserved instance coupon after expiration. Options:
- true: Auto-renew
- false (default): Do not auto-renew
When auto-renewal is enabled, the platform will automatically deduct the renewal fee for all target coupons generated this time before they expire. No manual renewal is required

AutoRenewPeriod.description_en:
Duration of each auto-renewal
- This parameter is valid only when the `AutoRenew` parameter is set to `true`
- When `PeriodUnit` is set to `Month`, this parameter can be set to 1, 2, 3, 6, or 12. The default value is 1

ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if retries occur due to API timeouts or server errors. Value: ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters.

Configurations.N.HpcClusterId.description_en:
High Performance Computing Cluster ID.
- Parameter -N: Indicates the serial number of the reserved instance voucher.
- Use & to separate multiple reserved instance vouchers.
This parameter is only effective when the reserved instance voucher is a high performance computing GPU-type instance.

Configurations.N.InstanceCount.description_en:
The target reserved instance coupon can offset pay-as-you-go instance charges for up to 100 instances. If you enter 0 or leave this field blank, the default is 1.
- Parameter -N: Indicates the sequence number of the target reserved instance coupon. N can be any value from 1 to 50.
- Use & to separate multiple reserved instance coupons.

Configurations.N.InstanceTypeId.description_en:
Instance type ID that the target reserved instance coupon can match
- Parameter -N: Indicates the index of the target reserved instance coupon. N ranges from 1 to 50
- Use & to separate multiple reserved instance coupons

Configurations.N.ReservedInstanceName.description_en:
Target reserved instance coupon name
- Parameter -N: Indicates the sequence number of the target reserved instance coupon. N ranges from 1 to 50.
- Separate multiple reserved instance coupons with &

Configurations.N.Scope.description_en:
Type of reserved instance coupon. Options:
- ZonalRI: Availability zone-level reserved instance coupon
- RegionalRI: Region-level reserved instance coupon. Region-level reserved instance coupons are currently in invitation-only testing. To request access, please contact your account manager.
- Parameter -N: Indicates the sequence number of the reserved instance coupon. N can be any value from 1 to 50.
- Separate multiple reserved instance coupons with &

Configurations.N.ZoneId.description_en:
The Availability Zone ID where the target reserved instance coupon is located
You can call [DescribeZones](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeZones) to query availability zone information within a region
- Parameter -N: Indicates the sequence number of the reserved instance coupon. N can be any value from 1 to 50
- Use & to separate multiple reserved instance coupons
This parameter is required when `Configurations.N.Scope` is set to `ZonalRI`

Description.description_en:
Description for the reserved Instance Coupon:
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period '.', space, underscore '_', hyphen '-', equals sign '=', English comma ',', Chinese comma '，', and Chinese period '。'
- Maximum length is 255 characters

If you enter an empty string, the original description will be cleared

ProjectName.description_en:
Project for this resource: Each resource can belong to only one project
- Use only letters, numbers, underscores (_), dots (.), and hyphens (-)
- Maximum length: 64 characters

RegionId.description_en: Region ID of the original reserved instance coupon. You can call the [DescribeRegions](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeRegions) API to view region IDs.

ReservedInstanceIds.N.description_en:
Original reserved instance coupon IDs (up to 10 supported)
- Parameter -N: indicates the sequence number of the original reserved instance coupon
- Separate multiple IDs with &

Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for user tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the index of the tag key, valid range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag keys with &

Naming rules:
- Must not start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
- Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
Tag keys for the same resource must be unique

Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for the user tag
- Parameter - N: Indicates the tag value's sequence number, range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag values with &

Naming rules:
- Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
- Can be empty; length must be 0–256 characters
If you specify this parameter, you must first specify `Tags.N.Key`

EventTypes.N.description_en:
Event types, up to 100 supported. Leave empty or omit to unsubscribe
- Parameter - N: Indicates the index of the event type
- Separate multiple event types with &
- For valid values, see [Subscribe and Modify Event Types](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Subscribe_to_and_modify_event_types)

SubscriptionId.description_en: Subscription ID. You can call the [CreateSubscription](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/CreateSubscription) API to subscribe to event notifications or the [DescribeSubscriptions](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeSubscriptions) API to query the list of subscribed notifications to obtain the Subscription ID.

DefaultAction.description_en:
Default event operations:
- Redeploy: Redeploy
- ReplaceDisk: Replace disk
    This operation is not supported for local disk LVM or SRIOV partitioned disk scenarios

EventId.description_en:
Event ID. You can query it via [Event Notification](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Receiving-event-notifications) or the [DescribeSystemEvents](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeSystemEvents) API.
This operation is only supported when the `DiskErrorDetected` event is in the `Inquiring` status.

OperatedEndAt.description_en:
Event O&M time window end time
Required when the `DefaultAction` parameter is set to `Redeploy`. Format: RFC3339.

OperatedStartAt.description_en:
Event O&M time window start time
Required when the `DefaultAction` parameter is set to `Redeploy`. Format: RFC3339.

DefaultVersionNumber.description_en: Launch Template Version Number Set as Default

LaunchTemplateId.description_en:
Instance Launch Template ID
 tip
You must specify either LaunchTemplateId or LaunchTemplateName to identify the template

LaunchTemplateName.description_en:
Instance Launch Template Name
 tip
You must specify either LaunchTemplateId or LaunchTemplateName to identify the template

AutoRenew.description_en:
Auto-renew reserved coupon after expiration?
- true: Auto-renew
- false (default): Do not auto-renew

AutoRenewPeriod.description_en:
Duration of each auto-renewal
- This parameter is valid only when `AutoRenew` is set to `True`
- When `PeriodUnit` is `Month`, valid values are 1, 2, 3, 6, or 12; the default is 1

ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a parameter value to ensure that this value is unique among different requests, preventing duplicate operations if the API call times out or a server error occurs and the client retries. Value: ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters.

Description.description_en:
Description for reserved coupon. Default value is an empty string
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), space, underscore (_), hyphen (-), equals sign (=), English comma (,), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。) are allowed
- Maximum length is 255 characters

EffectiveAt.description_en: The effective time for the reserved storage capacity package. By default, this field is empty, which means the package takes effect immediately. If you specify a time that is not on the hour, the package will take effect at the start of that hour. For example, if you set the time to 2025-03-29T17:50:00+08:00, the actual effective time will be 2025-03-29T17:00:00+08:00.

HpcClusterId.description_en:
When purchasing reserved instance vouchers for high-performance computing GPU instances, you must specify the high-performance computing cluster ID.
To purchase GPU reserved instance vouchers, contact your account manager.

InstanceCount.description_en: Reserved instance vouchers can offset the number of reserved pay-as-you-go instances. Value range: 1–100. If you enter 0 or leave it blank, the default is 1. For example, if the instance type is ecs.ecs.g3i.large and the quantity is set to 2, this reserved instance voucher can offset two pay-as-you-go instances of ecs.ecs.g3i.large at the same time.

InstanceTypeId.description_en: Reserved instance coupons can be used to offset the cost of reserved instance specifications

Period.description_en:
Purchase duration for reserved instance coupon (months)
- Available values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 24, 36
- Default value: 1

PeriodUnit.description_en: Time unit for purchasing reserved instance coupons (value: Month)

ProjectName.description_en:
Project to which the resource belongs. Each resource can belong to only one project.
- Use only letters, numbers, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).
- Maximum length: 64 characters.

RegionId.description_en:
Region ID of the reserved instance coupon
You can call the [DescribeRegions](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeRegions) API to view region IDs
You must specify this parameter when `Scope` is set to `RegionalRI`

ReservedCapacity.description_en:
Reserved storage capacity package per hour, measured in GiB/hour or TiB/hour
Value range: 65535 GiB to 64 TiB
- Total package capacity = `ReservedCapacity` × number of valid hours; maximum hourly deduction = `ReservedCapacity` × 2
- When `ReservedStorageCapacityName` is empty, this parameter is optional and does not take effect
- When `ReservedStorageCapacityName` is not empty, this parameter is required

ReservedInstanceName.description_en:
Name of the reserved instance voucher
- Cannot start with a number, hyphen, or underscore
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores "_", and hyphens "-"
- Length must be 1–128 characters
- Special characters are currently not supported

ReservedStorageCapacityName.description_en:
Name for the reserved storage capacity package
- Cannot start with a number, hyphen, or underscore
- Can only include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens
- Length must be 1–128 characters
- Special characters are not supported for now
If not provided, no reserved storage capacity package will be purchased

RscAutoRenew.description_en:
Whether to automatically renew the reserved storage capacity package after expiration. The possible values are:
- true: Automatically renew
- false (default): Do not automatically renew

RscAutoRenewPeriod.description_en:
Duration of each automatic renewal for the reserved storage capacity package
- This parameter is valid only when `RscAutoRenew` is set to `True`
- When `PeriodUnit` is `Month`, this parameter can be set to 1, 2, 3, 6, or 12; the default is 1

Scope.description_en:
Reserved Instance Coupon Type:
- ZonalRI (default): Availability zone-level reserved instance coupon
- RegionalRI: Region-level reserved instance coupon. Region-level reserved instance coupons are currently available by invitation only. To request access, please contact your account manager

Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for user tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the index of the tag key, range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag keys with &

Naming rules:
- Cannot start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
- Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
Tag keys for the same resource must be unique

Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for user tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag values with &

Naming rules:
- Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
- Can be empty; length must be between 0 and 256 characters
If you specify this parameter, you must first specify Tags.N.Key

VolumeType.description_en:
Cloud disk type. Options:
- ESSD_PL0: Ultra-fast SSD PL0
- ESSD_FlexPL: Ultra-fast SSD FlexPL
- When `ReservedStorageCapacityName` is empty, this parameter is optional and does not take effect
- When `ReservedStorageCapacityName` is not empty, this parameter is required

ZoneId.description_en:
Availability Zone ID where the Reserved Instance voucher is located
You can call [DescribeZones](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeZones) to query availability zone information in a region
You must specify this parameter when `Scope` is set to `ZonalRI`

ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API times out or the server returns an internal error and the client retries. Value: ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters.

DryRun.description_en:
Whether to only pre-check this request
- Value: true: Sends a check request without restarting the Instance. Checks include required parameters, request format, and business restrictions. If the check fails, returns the corresponding error. If the check passes, returns the error code DryRunOperation.
- false (default): Sends a normal request. The Instance restarts after passing the checks.

ForceStop.description_en:
Whether to force shutdown the Instance before restarting. Values:
- true: Force shutdown. This is similar to a typical power-off operation; any cached data not written to storage devices will be lost.
- false (default): Normal shutdown.
For the following types of Instances, `ForceStop` will always perform a force shutdown, regardless of whether it is set to `true` or `false`.
- Elastic Bare Metal Instance
- High-performance computing GPU types: ebmhpcpni2l, ebmhpcpni2, ebmhpchfpni2 Instances
  > ebmhpcpni2l, ebmhpcpni2, and ebmhpchfpni2 are currently in invitation testing. To request a trial, please contact your account manager.

ClientToken.description_en:
Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API call times out or a server error occurs. 
Value: ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters

ForceStop.description_en:
Whether to force shutdown the Instance before restarting. Values:
- true: Force shutdown. This is similar to a typical power-off operation; any cached data not written to storage devices will be lost.
- false (default): Normal shutdown.
For the following types of Instances, `ForceStop` will always perform a force shutdown, regardless of whether the value is `true` or `false`:
- Elastic bare metal Instances.
- High-performance computing GPU types: ebmhpcpni2l, ebmhpcpni2, ebmhpchfpni2 Instances.
  > ebmhpcpni2l, ebmhpcpni2, and ebmhpchfpni2 are currently in invite-only beta. To apply for a trial, please contact your account manager.

InstanceIds.description_en: Instance ID

InstanceIds.N.description_en:
Instance ID: supports up to 100 IDs
- Parameter N: indicates the instance sequence number
- Separate multiple Instance IDs with &

ClientToken.description_en:
Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API call times out or a server error occurs and the client retries. 
Value: Supports ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters.

Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API call times out or a server error occurs and the client retries. 
Value: Supports ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters.

Period.description_en:
Renewal duration (months)
Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 24, 36

PeriodUnit.description_en: Time unit for renewal duration, which is the unit of the Period parameter. Value: Month

ClientToken.description_en:
Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API call times out or a server error occurs and the client retries. 
Value: Only ASCII characters are supported, up to 64 characters.

PeriodUnit.description_en:
The time unit for renewal duration, i.e., the unit of the `Period` parameter. Options:
- Month (default)
- Week (not supported yet)

AutoReleaseAt.description_en: Automatic release time after renewal. If the renewal is successful, the instance will be automatically released at this time. You can also manually release the instance at any time before then.

ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a parameter value to ensure that this value is unique among different requests, preventing duplicate operations if the API call times out or a server error occurs and the client retries. Value: ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters.

ImageId.description_en:
Image ID
You can call the [DescribeImages](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeImages) API to query and obtain it

ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API call times out or a server error occurs. Value requirements: ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters.

DryRun.description_en:
Whether to only pre-check this request. Options:
- true: Send a pre-check request without changing the system. Checks include required parameters, request format, and business restrictions. If the check fails, returns the corresponding error. If the check passes, returns the error code `DryRunOperation`.
- false (default): Send a normal request. If the check passes, the system will be changed directly.

ImageId.description_en: Image ID used when changing the operating system. You can obtain it by calling the [DescribeImages](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeImages) API.

ImageReleaseVersion.description_en:
Specific version number of the image being used
- This parameter takes effect only when you select a public image
- If left empty, the latest version will be used

InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeInstances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeInstances) API to query and obtain it

KeepImageCredential.description_en:
Log in to the Instance using the image's preset password or key pair. Values:
- true: Use the image's preset password or key pair to log in
- false (default): Do not use the image's preset password or key pair to log in
- Only custom images and shared images support this feature
- If this parameter is set to `true`, do not provide `PassWord` or `KeyPairName`

KeyPairName.description_en:
Reset key pair. You can call the [DescribeKeyPairs](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeKeyPairs) API to query and obtain key pairs.
- Applies only to Linux Instances
- When `KeepImageCredential` is set to `false`, either this parameter or `Password` must be provided
- If both `KeyPairName` and `Password` are set, only `KeyPairName` takes effect

Password.description_en:
Reset Password
Password requirements:
- Length must be between 8 and 30 characters
- Password can only contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters, and must include at least three of these types
  Allowed special characters: `~!@#$%^&*()_-+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/
- Cannot start with '/' or '$6$'
- Login credentials support three methods: password, key pair, or keep image settings. When logging in to an Instance using a password, we recommend increasing password complexity for better security
- When `KeepImageCredential` is set to `false`, this parameter and `KeyPairName` cannot both be empty

Description.description_en: Detailed description of the abnormal issue

DeviceNames.N.description_en:
List of device names for disk mounts with the same exception issue; supports up to 100 device names
- Parameter - N: indicates the sequence number of the device name
- Separate multiple device names with &

DiskIds.N.description_en:
List of disk IDs with the same exception issue; supports up to 100 disk IDs
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the disk ID
- Separate multiple disk IDs with &
If this is a local disk instance, enter the SN of the disk device

EndTime.description_en: End time of instance abnormal issue, format: RFC3339

InstanceIds.N.description_en:
Supports up to 100 instance IDs for abnormal issues
Format:
- Parameter-N: indicates the identifier for an instance ID
- Separate multiple instance IDs with &

Reason.description_en:
Impact of abnormal issues on the instance. Possible values:
- instance-hang: Instance is unavailable or cannot be connected
- instance-stuck-in-status: Instance remains in the same status for an extended period, such as Starting or Stopping
- abnormal-network: Instance experiences network abnormality
- abnormal-local-disk: The local disk attached to the instance is abnormal
- abnormal-cloud-disk: The cloud disk or shared block storage attached to the instance is abnormal
- abnormal-GPU-device: The GPU card in a GPU instance is abnormal
- abnormal-RDMA-device: The RDMA network card in an HPC instance is abnormal
- others: Other types of abnormalities. If none of the above apply, set Reason=others and provide more details in Description

StartTime.description_en: Start time of instance abnormal issue (RFC3339 format)

CommandContent.description_en:
Command content.
- Before encoding, make sure the script specifies the interpreter on the first line. The rules are as follows:
	- For shell scripts: the first line must be `#!/bin/bash`.
	- For Python scripts: the first line must be `#!/usr/bin/python`.
- Command content cannot exceed 16KB.

ContentEncoding.description_en:
Whether the command content is Base64 encoded. Options:

- Base64 (default): Encoded with Base64
- PlainText: Not encoded

EnableParameter.description_en:
Specifies whether the created command uses custom parameters. Options:

- false: Default; does not use custom parameters
- true: Uses custom parameters

Frequency.description_en:
Execution frequency. This parameter is required only when `RepeatMode=Rate`. Specify the execution cycle using a rate expression in the following format:

- <interval value><interval unit>
    - Interval unit: Supports minutes (m), hours (h), and days (d). Use for jobs that run at fixed intervals.
    - Interval value range: 5–60 (minutes), 1–24 (hours), 1–7 (days). The interval must be longer than the job's timeout period.
- The execution interval is based on a fixed frequency and is not affected by the actual job duration.
- After the job is created, it runs once at `LaunchTime`. The next execution time is determined by the specified interval.

InstanceIds.N.description_en:
Instance ID list, supporting up to 200 IDs. You can use the [DescribeInstances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeInstances) API to query and obtain Instance IDs.

- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the instance
- Separate multiple Instance IDs with `&`
If you specify multiple instances and any instance does not meet the execution conditions (for example, the instance is shut down or unavailable), you need to specify all instances again.

InvocationDescription.description_en: Job description, defaults to an empty string, up to 256 characters

InvocationName.description_en:
Job Name. Must follow these rules:

- No more than 64 characters
- Can only include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-); cannot start with a number or hyphen
- Duplicate job names are allowed within the same region

LaunchTime.description_en:
Execution time

- For `RepeatMode=Rate`, enter the initial job execution time in the following format:
  - Time format: RFC3339, for example: 2022-11-07T11:49:13Z
- For `RepeatMode=Fixed`, enter the job start time in the following format:
  - Time format: RFC3339, for example: 2022-11-07T11:49:13Z

ParameterDefinitions.N.DecimalPrecision.description_en:
Number of decimal places allowed for custom parameter values (numeric)
- `DecimalPrecision` range: 0–10
- Required when `Type=Digit`; defaults to 0 if `Required` is set to true

ParameterDefinitions.N.DefaultValue.description_en:
Custom Parameter Default Value
Enter a default value that matches the type specified by the `Type` parameter.

ParameterDefinitions.N.MaxLength.description_en:
Maximum length for custom parameter values (string)
- `MaxLength` range: 1–1000
- Required when `Type=String`; defaults to `1000` if `Required` is set to `true`
- Must be greater than `MinLength`

ParameterDefinitions.N.MaxValue.description_en:
Maximum value for custom parameter (numeric)
- `MaxValue` range: -1,000,000 to 1,000,000
- Required when `Type=Digit`; defaults to `1,000,000` if `Required` is set to true
- This value must be less than `MinValue`

ParameterDefinitions.N.MinLength.description_en:
Minimum length for custom parameter value (string)
- `MinLength` range: 1–1000
- The `MinLength` field is required when `Type=String`; its default value is 1 if `Required` is set to `true`
- This value must be less than `MaxLength`

ParameterDefinitions.N.MinValue.description_en:
Minimum value for custom parameter (numeric)
- `MinValue` range: -1000000 to 1000000
- Required when `Type=Digit`; defaults to `-1000000` if `Required` is set to `true`
- This value must be less than `MaxValue`

ParameterDefinitions.N.Name.description_en:
Custom parameter names must be defined in the script using {{Param}}. Naming rules:

- Each parameter name must not exceed 64 bytes
- Use only letters (a-z, A-Z), numbers (0-9), and underscores (_)
- The first character cannot be a number
- No spaces allowed; use underscores to separate words

ParameterDefinitions.N.Required.description_en:
Is the custom parameter required? Values:

- true: Required
- false: Optional
If required, you must provide a custom parameter value in the `Parameters` field.

ParameterDefinitions.N.Type.description_en:
Custom parameter types. Options:

- String: Indicates that the custom parameter type is `String` (string)
- Digit: Indicates that the custom parameter type is `Digit` (numeric)

Parameters.description_en:
When a command includes custom parameters, use this parameter to provide key-value pairs for those parameters. For example, if the command is `echo {{name}}`, you can pass the key-value pair `{"name":"Jack"}` using the `Parameter` parameter. The custom parameter will automatically replace the variable `name`, resulting in a new command: `echo Jack`.
Custom parameter rules: - You can set 0 to 60 custom parameters - Keys cannot be empty and can be up to 64 characters - Values can be empty - The combined length of the custom parameters and the original command, after Base64 encoding, cannot exceed 16 KB - The set of custom parameter names must be a subset of the parameter set defined when the command was created. Default values will be used for any parameters not provided

ProjectName.description_en: Project the resource belongs to. Each resource can belong to only one project.

RecurrenceEndTime.description_en:
Cycle End Time, RFC3339 format
Only required when `RepeatMode` is set to `Rate` (recurring job)

RepeatMode.description_en:
Set how the command is executed. Options:

- Once: Default. Runs the job immediately
- Rate: Runs the job on a recurring schedule. Specify the interval using a Rate expression in the `Frequency` parameter
- Fixed: Runs the job at a scheduled time. Specify the time using the `LaunchTime` parameter

Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for user tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag keys with &

Naming rules:
  - Cannot start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
  - Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
  - Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
Tag keys for the same resource must be unique

Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for the user tag
- Parameter - N: Indicates the index of the tag value, valid range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag values with &

Naming rules:
  - Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
  - Can be empty; length must be between 0 and 256 characters
If you provide this parameter, you must first provide `Tags.N.Key`.

Timeout.description_en:
Maximum timeout for the created command when executed on an ECS instance, in **seconds**

- Range: 30–86400
- Default: 60
If the timeout is reached, the command process will be forcibly terminated

Type.description_en:
Command type. Available values:

- Shell: Create a Shell script that runs on a Linux Instance
- Python: Create a Python script
- Bat: Create a Bat script
- PowerShell: Create a PowerShell script

WorkingDir.description_en: Directory where the created command runs in the ECS instance. The default for Linux instances is `/home`.

AffinityGroupSize.description_en:
Affinity group specification, value: 2
- Currently, only high-performance computing NPU type hpcpci3 Instances (invite-only beta) support affinity groups
- This feature is in invite-only beta. To request access, please contact your account manager

AutoRenew.description_en:
Whether the instance is automatically renewed after expiration. Values:
- true: Auto-renew
- false (default): Do not auto-renew
This parameter takes effect only when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`.

AutoRenewPeriod.description_en:
Duration of each auto-renewal
- This parameter takes effect only when `AutoRenew` is set to `True`; the default value is 1
- When `PeriodUnit` is set to `Month`, this parameter can be set to 1, 2, 3, 6, or 12

ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a parameter value that must be unique among different requests. This prevents duplicate operations if the client retries due to an API timeout or server error. Value: Only ASCII characters are supported and the value cannot exceed 64 characters.

Count.description_en: Quantity (range: 1–100); if set to 0, defaults to 1

CpuMaxFrequency.description_en:
Specify the maximum CPU frequency in GHz. Valid range: from the CPU's base frequency to turbo frequency.
- Currently, only g3al (4xlarge, 8xlarge, 16xlarge, 32xlarge), c3al (4xlarge, 8xlarge, 16xlarge, 32xlarge), r3al (4xlarge, 8xlarge, 16xlarge), g4i, c4i, r4i, g4ie, c4ie, and r4ie Instances support this parameter. For details on base/turbo frequency and more information, see [Instance specifications](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Introduction-to-instance-types).
- This feature is currently in invite-only testing. To use it, please contact your account manager to apply.

CpuOptions.TopologyType.description_en:
CPU topology mode. Values:
- ContinuousCoreToHTMapping: HT continuous mode
- DiscreteCoreToHTMapping (default): HT discrete mode
- This feature is currently in invitation-only beta. To use it, please contact your account manager to apply.

CreditSpecification.description_en:
Operating mode for burstable performance instances. Valid values:
- Standard: Standard mode
- Unlimited: No performance constraints (not supported yet)
- This parameter takes effect only when `InstanceTypeId` is set to an ecs.t2 series, that is, a burstable performance Instance.
- If not specified or left empty, the burstable performance Instance defaults to Standard mode.

DeletionProtection.description_en:
Instance deletion protection attribute. Specifies whether deletion of the instance through the console or API is allowed. Values:
- true: Enable instance deletion protection
- false (default): Disable instance deletion protection

DeploymentSetGroupNumber.description_en: When an ECS instance is to join or adjust its deployment set policy to AvailabilityGroup, you can use this parameter to specify the instance's group number within the deployment set. Valid values: 1 to 7

DeploymentSetId.description_en: Deployment set ID the instance needs to join

Description.description_en:
Instance description (default: empty string)
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), space, underscore (_), hyphen (-), equals sign (=), English comma (,), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
- Maximum length: 255 characters

DryRun.description_en:
Whether to perform a dry run for this request. Valid values:
- true: Sends a validation request without creating an Instance. The validation checks required parameters, request format, business limits, and ECS inventory. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, the error code DryRunOperation is returned.
    When `DryRun` is set to `true`, if you specify the `Count` or `Mincount` parameter, the value must be 1.
  
- false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, the Instance is created directly.

EipAddress.BandwidthMbps.description_en:
Maximum bandwidth for public IP. Default value: 1. Unit: Mbps
- When `ChargeType` is set to `PayByBandwidth`: range is 1–500
- When `ChargeType` is set to `PayByTraffic`: range is 1–200

EipAddress.BandwidthPackageId.description_en:
The ID of the shared bandwidth package, required when adding a public IP to a shared bandwidth package
- You can call the [DescribeBandwidthPackages](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/bandwidthpackage/DescribeBandwidthPackages) API to query the shared bandwidth package ID
- To add a public IP to a shared bandwidth package, the following conditions must be met:
  - Both must have the same security protection type
  - Both must be in the same region
  - The public IP must use pay-as-you-go billing
  - The shared bandwidth package must be of IPv4 type

EipAddress.ChargeType.description_en:
Billing methods for public IP addresses:
- PayByBandwidth (default): Pay-as-you-go—billed by bandwidth cap
- PayByTraffic: Pay-as-you-go—billed by actual data transfer
- PrePaid: Subscription (monthly or yearly)
When the instance billing type (`InstanceChargeType`) is set to `PostPaid`, this parameter cannot be set to `PrePaid`.

EipAddress.ISP.description_en:
Public IP line type. Default is BGP. Available values:
- BGP: BGP (multi-line)
- If your account has applied for and enabled static single line, you can use:
  - ChinaMobile: China Mobile static single line
  - ChinaTelecom: China Telecom static single line
  - ChinaUnicom: China Unicom static single line
- If your account has applied for and enabled BGP single line, you can use SingleLine_BGP
- If your account has applied for and enabled static BGP, you can use Static_BGP

EipAddress.ReleaseWithInstance.description_en:
Whether the public IP is released with the Instance. Only applies to pay-as-you-go public IPs. Options:
- true: The public IP is released with the Instance. When the Instance is automatically recycled (such as 24 hours after unsubscription or upon expiration) or deleted using the [DeleteInstance](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DeleteInstance) or [DeleteInstances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DeleteInstances) APIs, the public IP is released together with the Instance
- false (default): The public IP is not released with the Instance

EipAddress.SecurityProtectionInstanceId.description_en:
DDoS Native Protection (Enterprise Edition) ID
- You can call the [DescInstanceList](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6352/1263659) API to query the DDoS Native Protection (Enterprise Edition) ID
- When `SecurityProtectionTypes` is set to `AntiDDoS_Enhanced`, this parameter is required

EipAddress.SecurityProtectionTypes.N.description_en:
Security protection types for public IP addresses
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the security protection type. Currently, only 1 is supported
- Values:
   - AntiDDoS_Enhanced: Apply for a public IP address with enhanced protection, which can be added to a DDoS Native Protection (Enterprise Edition) Instance
          - If `EipAddress.SecurityProtectionTypes.N` is set to `AntiDDoS_Enhanced`, `EipAddress.ChargeType` cannot be `PrePaid`, and `EipAddress.ISP` must be set to `BGP`
     - Enhanced protection public IP addresses are currently available by invitation only. To request access, please contact your account manager
     
   - Leave blank to request a public IP address with default protection

EnablePrimaryInterfaceHighBandwidthType.description_en:
Does the primary network interface card support high bandwidth types? Values:
- true: Supported
- false (default): Not supported

Hostname.description_en:
The instance hostname is the computer name used within the instance's operating system.
- Linux instance:
  - Letters, numbers, periods ("."), and hyphens ("-") are allowed
  - Cannot start or end with a hyphen or period
  - Cannot use hyphens or periods consecutively, or use a hyphen and period together
  - Length must be between 2 and 63 characters

- Windows instance:
  - Letters, numbers, and hyphens ("-") are allowed; cannot be all numbers
  - Cannot start or end with a hyphen, and cannot use hyphens consecutively
  - Length must be between 2 and 15 characters

- If left blank, the hostname is automatically generated using the rule iv- + initial hostname, for example: iv-3tigy72q3u3vj0******
- Initial hostname generation logic:
  - Linux: Extract all characters after 'i-' in the instance ID
  - Windows: Extract the last 12 characters after 'i-' in the instance ID

- When creating instances in batches, you can customize sequential hostnames using the format `name_prefix[begin_number,bits]name_suffix`. For details, see [Batch set sequential instance names or hostnames](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Batch-configuring-sequential-instance-names-or-hostnames)

HpcClusterId.description_en:
High-performance computing cluster ID of the instance
This parameter is required and only applies when creating a high-performance computing GPU instance

HttpTokens.description_en:
Access mode for instance metadata. Specify whether to enforce hardened mode. Values:
- optional (default): Not enforced (compatibility mode). You can access instance metadata either directly or using the hardened method with token-based authentication.
- required: Enforced (hardened mode only). Only access via the hardened method with token-based authentication is supported.
- For details on how to view metadata and which metadata items are supported, see [View Instance Metadata](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Viewing-instance-metadata)
- The "hardened mode only" option is currently in invite-only testing. To request access, contact your account manager

ImageId.description_en:
Image ID used to launch the instance
You can call the [DescribeImages](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeImages) API and enter the desired instance type ID in the `InstanceTypeId` parameter to query supported images and their IDs for that instance type

ImageReleaseVersion.description_en:
Specific image version number
- This parameter only applies when selecting a public image
- If left blank, the latest version of the image will be used

InstallRunCommandAgent.description_en:
Whether to install Cloud Assistant Agent when creating the instance:
- true: Install during creation
- false (default): Do not install during creation
For more information about Cloud Assistant, see [Cloud Assistant Overview](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Overview-of-cloud-assistant).

InstanceChargeType.description_en:
Billing types for instances and cloud disks:
- PostPaid: Pay-as-you-go
- PrePaid: Subscription (yearly or monthly)
Make sure your account supports balance payment or credit payment. Otherwise, you will receive an InvalidInstanceChargeType error message.

InstanceName.description_en:
Instance Name
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
- If the instance uses an ordered suffix with `SuffixIndex`, the instance name length includes the ordered suffix
- When creating instances in bulk, you can use the format `name_prefix[begin_number,bits]name_suffix` to customize ordered instance names. For details, see [Set Ordered Instance or Host Names in Bulk](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Batch-configuring-sequential-instance-names-or-hostnames)

InstanceTypeId.description_en:
Instance Specifications
- Product selection: You can refer to the [Instance Specifications Overview](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Introduction-to-instance-types) or call [DescribeInstanceTypes](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeInstanceTypes) to view performance data for each instance specification. For guidance on how to choose an instance specification, see [Best Practices for Instance Selection](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Instance-type-selection-best-practice).
- Check inventory: You can call [DescribeAvailableResource](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeAvailableResource) to view the available compute resource inventory in each availability zone.

KeepImageCredential.description_en:
Retain image settings. Options:
- true: Retain image settings. The instance will use the preset password or key pair from the image for login.
- false (default): Do not retain image settings.
- Only custom images and shared images support this feature.
- When this parameter is set to `true`, do not specify `PassWord` or `KeyPairName`.

KeyPairName.description_en:
To log in to an Instance using SSH key authentication, specify the name of an existing key pair.
You can call [DescribeKeyPairs](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeKeyPairs) to view existing key pairs. If none are available, call [CreateKeyPair](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/CreateKeyPair) to create a key pair.
- Windows Instances do not support SSH key authentication. Even if you provide this parameter, only the password (`Password`) will be used.
- Linux Instances support login with either a password or a key pair. If you set both `KeyPairName` and `Password` when calling this API, only the key pair (`KeyPairName`) will be used.

MinCount.description_en:
Set the minimum number of ECS instances to create (range: 1–100)
- The minimum instance creation count (MinCount) must be less than or equal to the creation count (Count)
- If available stock > creation count (Count), create Count instances
- If minimum creation count (MinCount) ≤ available stock ≤ creation count (Count), create the number of instances equal to the available stock
- If available stock < minimum creation count (MinCount), creation fails due to insufficient stock

NetworkInterfaces.N.Ipv6AddressCount.description_en:
Number of private IPv6 addresses assigned to the primary network interface card. Only 1 is supported
- When you specify this parameter, the system automatically assigns the same number of available private IPv6 addresses from the subnet to the network interface card, and uses them as its private IPv6 addresses
- You can only assign IPv6 addresses to the primary network interface card when creating an instance. To assign IPv6 addresses to an auxiliary network interface card, see [CreateNetworkInterface](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/CreateNetworkInterface)
- Parameter - N: Indicates the index of the network interface card. N = 1 refers to the primary network interface card; N ≥ 2 refers to an auxiliary network interface card. If you specify N ≥ 2, this parameter will be ignored
Assigning IPv6 addresses to network interface cards is currently in invite-only testing. Only accounts that have completed [enterprise verification](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6261/64937) can apply for a trial. To request access, contact your account manager

NetworkInterfaces.N.PrimaryIpAddress.description_en:
Specify the primary IP address for a network interface. Currently, you can specify only one primary IP address, either for the primary network interface or for a secondary network interface.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the interface number. N = 1 refers to the primary network interface; N ≥ 2 refers to secondary network interfaces.
- Use & to separate multiple interfaces

NetworkInterfaces.N.PrivateIpAddresses.N.description_en:
Specify the secondary IP addresses for the primary network interface card. Currently, only the primary NIC supports assigning secondary IPs.
- The first N indicates the index of the primary NIC. Only one primary NIC can be bound at this time.
- The second N indicates the index of the secondary IP on the primary NIC. The maximum number of secondary IP addresses you can assign is the number of private IPs supported by the [Instance specification](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Introduction-to-instance-types) for a single NIC, minus one primary private IP.
- Separate multiple secondary IPs with &.

NetworkInterfaces.N.SecurityGroupIds.N.description_en:
Security group ID associated with the network interface card.
- The first N indicates the NIC sequence number. N = 1 means the primary NIC; N ≥ 2 means secondary NICs.
- The second N indicates the sequence number of the security group associated with the NIC. Valid values: 1–5.
- Use & to separate multiple security group IDs.

NetworkInterfaces.N.SubnetId.description_en:
Private network subnet ID for the Instance. When creating an Instance, you can also bind secondary network interfaces.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the network interface index. N = 1 indicates the primary network interface; N ≥ 2 indicates secondary network interfaces.
- Separate multiple private network subnet IDs with &.

NetworkOptions.EnableJumboFrame.description_en:
Whether the Instance enables jumbo frames. Values:
- false: Jumbo frames are disabled. All network interfaces of this Instance have an MTU value of 1500.
- true: Jumbo frames are enabled. All network interfaces of this Instance have an MTU value of 8500.
This feature is only supported for certain Instances. For Instances that support jumbo frames, see [Enable/Disable Jumbo Frames](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Enabling_or_Disabling_jumbo_frames).

Password.description_en:
To log in to the Instance using the password method, specify the initial login password for the administrator account with this parameter. The Linux administrator account is root, and the Windows administrator account is Administrator.
Password complexity requirements:
- Length must be between 8 and 30 characters
- Passwords can only contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters, and must include at least three of these types
- Allowed special characters: `~!@#$%^&*()_-+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/
- Passwords cannot start with "/" or "$6$"
Login credentials support three methods: password, key pair, and reserved image settings. When logging in to the Instance using a password, we recommend increasing password complexity to enhance security.

Period.description_en:
Resource purchase duration (months)
- Allowed values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60
- Default value: 1
This parameter is required and only takes effect when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`.

PeriodUnit.description_en:
Duration unit for purchasing resources. Value: Month (default).
This parameter is valid and required only when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`.

Placement.Affinity.description_en:
For ECS instances in stopped with savings mode, some resources are released after the instance stops. This parameter lets you choose whether to redeploy the instance on the original dedicated host when restarting. Options:

- Host: When you restart an instance in stopped with savings mode, it is redeployed on the original dedicated host
- Default (default): When you restart an instance in stopped with savings mode, the instance is first migrated to a dedicated host that supports auto-deployment if resources are available; if not, it starts on the original dedicated host

Placement.DedicatedHostClusterId.description_en:
Dedicated host cluster ID where the instance resides
You can call the [DescribeDedicatedHostClusters](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6396/1253698) API to query the host cluster ID

Placement.DedicatedHostId.description_en:
Dedicated host ID where the instance resides
Call the [DescribeDedicatedHosts](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6396/1253691) API to query the list of dedicated hosts

Placement.Tenancy.description_en:
Whether to create an instance on a dedicated host. Options:
- Default: Create a standard cloud server instance
- Host: Create an instance on a dedicated host. If you do not specify `Placement.DedicatedHostId`, the system will automatically select a dedicated host for the instance
For supported instance types on dedicated hosts, see [Instance Types](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6396/1253643)

PrimaryNetworkInterfacePciBus.description_en:
Specify primary NIC PCI bus (default: empty)
Value range: 0

ProjectName.description_en: Project to which the resource belongs. Each resource can belong to only one project. Use only letters, numbers, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-). Maximum length: 64 characters.

SecurityEnhancementStrategy.description_en:
Whether to enable security hardening. Values:
- Active: Enable security hardening; applies to public images only
- Inactive: Disable security hardening; applies to all image types

SpotPriceLimit.description_en:
Maximum hourly price for spot instances, supports up to three decimal places
This parameter takes effect only when `SpotStrategy` is set to `SpotWithPriceLimit`

SpotStrategy.description_en:
Preemptible strategy for pay-as-you-go Instances. Valid values:
- NoSpot (default): Creates a standard pay-as-you-go Instance
- SpotAsPriceGo: System sets the bid automatically based on the current market price for a preemptible Instance
- SpotWithPriceLimit: Preemptible Instance with a custom bid price limit
- This parameter takes effect only when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PostPaid`
- For details on preemptible Instance bidding modes, see [Purchase Preemptible Instances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Buying_spot_instance)

SuffixIndex.description_en: Starting number for ordered suffix. Range: 1–999, default: 1

Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for user tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag keys with &

Naming rules:
  - Cannot start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
  - Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
  - Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
Tag keys for the same resource must be unique

Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for user tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the index of the tag value, range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag values with &

Naming rules:
  - Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
  - Can be empty; length must be between 0 and 256 characters
If you pass this parameter, you must first pass `Tags.N.Key`

UniqueSuffix.description_en:
Indicates whether to automatically add a sequential suffix to `Hostname` and `InstanceName` when creating multiple Instances. Values:
- true: Enable sequential suffix
- false (default): Disable sequential suffix
- When sequential suffix is enabled and `Hostname` is empty, the system will automatically generate a hostname without a sequential suffix.
- When sequential suffix is enabled and you specify the `[begin_number,bits]` naming format for `Hostname` or `InstanceName`, see [Batch set sequential instance names or hostnames](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Batch-configuring-sequential-instance-names-or-hostnames) for details on the final result.

UserData.description_en: Instance custom data. Custom data must be Base64-encoded and cannot exceed 16KB before encoding. If left blank, defaults to empty

Volumes.N.BurstEnabled.description_en:
Enable Burst (performance burst) feature for cloud disk?
- true: Enabled
- false (default): Not enabled

Volumes.N.DeleteWithInstance.description_en:
Whether the cloud disk is released with the instance. Options:
- true (default): The cloud disk is released with the instance
- false: The cloud disk is not released with the instance
- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk number, valid range: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk, which is always released with the instance and cannot be retained. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks, which can be set to release with the instance or not
- Use & to separate multiple cloud disks

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceIOPS.description_en:
Extra IOPS performance size for cloud disks. Only ESSD FlexPL data disks support this feature. Unit: operations/second

Set this parameter when `ExtraPerformanceTypeId` is set to `Balance` or `IOPS`. The valid value ranges for each type are:
- IOPS type: 1–50000
- Balance type: 1–50000

- Parameter N: Indicates the disk sequence number. Valid values: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; when N is 1, this parameter is ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can set this parameter for these disks.
- Use & to separate multiple disks.

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB.description_en:
Extra disk throughput (MB/s). Supported only for ESSD FlexPL data disks.

Set this parameter when `ExtraPerformanceTypeId` is set to `Throughput`.
Value range: 1–650.

- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk sequence number. Valid values: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; if N is 1, this parameter is ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can set this parameter for data disks.
- Use & to separate multiple disks.

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceTypeId.description_en:
Types of additional disk performance, supported only by ESSD FlexPL data disks. Options:
- Balance: Balanced performance
- IOPS: IOPS performance
- Throughput: Throughput performance

For more information about additional performance, see [Additional Disk Performance](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/essd_flexpl_volume).

- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk index, with a valid range of 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; when N is set to 1, this parameter is ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can set this parameter normally.
- Use & to separate multiple disks.

Volumes.N.Size.description_en:
Cloud disk capacity, in GiB. N ranges from 1 to 16. N = 1 indicates a system disk; N ≥ 2 indicates a data disk. Use & to separate multiple cloud disks.

Cloud disk capacity ranges:
- System disk:
  - ESSD_PL0: 20–2048
  - ESSD_FlexPL: 20–2048
    Default value: max{40, the image size of the specified ImageId}.
  

- Data disk:
  - ESSD_PL0: 10–32768
  - ESSD_FlexPL: 10–32768
    If this parameter is not specified, the capacity of the data disk is set to the size of the snapshot specified by `Volumes.N.SnapshotId`. If `Volumes.N.SnapshotId` is not provided, an error LimitExceeded.DataVolumeSize is returned.

Volumes.N.SnapshotId.description_en:
Create a cloud disk from a snapshot. Only data disks are supported. You can use the [DescribeSnapshots](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/Describesnapshots) API to query snapshot IDs.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the cloud disk index, valid values: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; if you set N to 1, this parameter will be ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can specify the target data disk snapshot ID.
- Use & to separate multiple cloud disks.
- Only Ultra SSDs support creating cloud disks from snapshots. Performance SSDs do not support snapshot-related features.
- Only snapshots with the 'Available' status can be used to create new cloud disks. Snapshots in 'Creating', 'Rolling Back', 'Deleting', or 'Error' status cannot be used to create new cloud disks.

Volumes.N.VolumeType.description_en:
Cloud disk type options:
- ESSD_PL0 (default): Ultra-fast SSD PL0
- ESSD_FlexPL: Ultra-fast SSD FlexPL
- Parameter N: Indicates the cloud disk number. Valid range: 1–16. N = 1 is the system disk. N ≥ 2 are data disks
- Use & to separate multiple cloud disks

ZoneId.description_en: ID of the availability zone where the instance is located. You can call [DescribeZones](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ecs/DescribeZones) to query availability zone information in a region.

ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API times out or the server returns an internal error and the client retries. Value: ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters.

DryRun.description_en:
Whether to only pre-check this request. Values:
- true: Sends a check request without starting the Instance. The check includes required parameters, request format, business restrictions, and ECS inventory. If the check fails, returns the corresponding error. If the check passes, returns the error code DryRunOperation.
- false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, the Instance starts immediately.

ClientToken.description_en:
