StorageType.description_en:
Instance storage type. Valid values:
- `LocalSSD`: Local disk
- `CloudESSD_FlexPL`: FlexPL cloud disk
- `CloudESSD_PL0`: PL0 cloud disk
- If you need to set the StorageSpace parameter, the StorageType parameter is required
- When InstanceType is set to `SingleNode`, StorageType can only be `CloudESSD_FlexPL` or `CloudESSD_PL0`
- The valid values for this parameter vary by API. The specific rules are as follows:
	- When used as a request parameter in the following APIs, StorageType can only be `LocalSSD`:
		- RestoreToCrossRegionInstance
		- RestoreToNewInstanceFromUserTos

- When used as a request parameter in certain APIs, the valid values for this parameter depend on the storage type of the original instance. The specific rules are as follows:
	- If the original instance storage type is `LocalSSD` or `CloudESSD_FlexPL`, changing the storage type is not supported
	- If the original instance storage type is `CloudESSD_PL0`, StorageType can be set to `CloudESSD_PL0` or `CloudESSD_FlexPL`
	The relevant APIs are:
		- RebuildDBInstance
		- RestoreToNewInstance
		- ModifyDBNodeSpec

AllowList.description_en:
IP addresses outside the security group that need to be added to the whitelist. You can enter individual IP addresses or IP ranges in CIDR format.

- Each whitelist supports up to 300 IP addresses or CIDR-format IP ranges
- Duplicate addresses are not allowed; separate multiple addresses with English commas (,)
- Entering `0.0.0.0/0` allows access from all addresses
- Entering `127.0.0.1` blocks access from all addresses
- Entering both `0.0.0.0/0` and `127.0.0.1` allows access from all addresses
- Entering CIDR `192.168.1.0/24` allows access from all IP addresses in that subnet
- Entering `192.168.1.1` allows access only from that IP address
- This field cannot be used together with UserAllowList

AllowListCategory.description_en:
Whitelist category. Possible values:

- `Ordinary`: Ordinary whitelist
- `Default`: Default whitelist

When used as a request parameter, the default value is `Ordinary`

AllowListDesc.description_en: Remark information for the whitelist cannot exceed 200 characters

AllowListName.description_en:
Allowlist name

- To modify the IP address of an existing allowlist, enter the original allowlist name. You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/RDS_for_MySQL/describeallowlists1) API to view all allowlist information in a specific region, including allowlist names.
- To change the allowlist name, enter a new name. The name must meet the following requirements:
  - Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
  - Can only contain letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
  - Must be 1–32 characters long

ApplyInstanceNum.description_en:
Number of instances bound to the current whitelist.

- This parameter is required when modifying the AllowList or UserAllowList parameters.
- You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/RDS_for_MySQL/describeallowlists1) API to query all whitelist information in a specified region, including the total number of instances bound to each whitelist.

- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No (default)

ModifyMode.description_en:
Modification mode. Available options:

- `Cover` (default): Replace the original whitelist with the IP addresses specified in the `AllowList` parameter.
- `Append`: Add the IP addresses entered in the `AllowList` parameter to the existing whitelist.
- `Delete`: Remove the IP addresses entered in the `AllowList` parameter from the existing whitelist. At least one IP address must be retained.

This field is only effective if the allowlist is already bound to a security group. You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/RDS_for_MySQL/describeallowlists1) API to check whether the allowlist is bound to a security group.

BinlogSpaceLimitEnable.description_en:
Enable automatic binlog cleanup when storage usage is too high. When the total storage usage of the instance exceeds 80% or the remaining space is less than 5 GiB, the system will automatically start cleaning up the earliest local binlog until the total storage usage drops below 80% and the remaining space is greater than 5 GiB.

- `true`: Enable
- `false`: Disable

BinlogStoragePercentage.description_en:
Maximum storage usage rate can be set from 20% to 50%. When usage exceeds the set limit, the system automatically deletes the oldest Binlog files until usage drops below the threshold.

Local Binlog storage usage rate = Local Binlog size / Total available (purchased) instance storage size

DataBackupAllRetention.description_en:
Whether to retain all data backups before releasing the instance. Options:

- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No

DataBackupEncryptionEnabled.description_en:
Whether to enable data backup encryption for local disk instances

Values:

- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No

This feature is not supported for cloud disk instances yet

DataBackupRetentionDay.description_en:
Backup file retention duration. The range of backup retention days varies by storage type:

- For local disk instances: selectable range is 7–3650 days, default is 7 days.

- For cloud disk instances: currently only 7 days are supported.

DataFullBackupPeriods.description_en:
Full backup schedule. It is recommended to select at least 2 days each week for full backups. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Available values:

- `Monday`: Monday
- `Tuesday`: Tuesday
- `Wednesday`: Wednesday
- `Thursday`: Thursday
- `Friday`: Friday
- `Saturday`: Saturday
- `Sunday`: Sunday

DataFullBackupStartUTCHour.description_en:
Start time of the full backup window (UTC). The window lasts 1 hour.

Both DataFullBackupStartUTCHour and DataFullBackupTime can specify the full backup window for an instance. DataFullBackupStartUTCHour has higher priority; if both fields are returned, DataFullBackupStartUTCHour takes precedence.

DataFullBackupTime.description_en:
Backup task time window. The time window is 1 hour. Format: `HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ` (UTC time).

- Both DataFullBackupStartUTCHour and DataFullBackupTime can be used to specify the full backup time window for the instance. DataFullBackupStartUTCHour has higher priority. If both fields are returned, DataFullBackupStartUTCHour takes precedence.
- To set a time window starting at 15:00 (UTC), set the end time to 15:59.

DataIncrBackupPeriods.description_en:
Incremental backup schedule. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Valid values:

- `Monday`: Monday
- `Tuesday`: Tuesday
- `Wednesday`: Wednesday
- `Thursday`: Thursday
- `Friday`: Friday
- `Saturday`: Saturday
- `Sunday`: Sunday

The incremental backup schedule must not conflict with the full backup schedule.

DataKeepDaysAfterReleased.description_en: Number of days backups are retained when the instance is released. Supports integer values from 7 to 3650; default is 7

DataKeepPolicyAfterReleased.description_en:
Backup retention policy after instance release. Options:
- `Last`: Keep the most recent backup (default)
- `All`: Keep all backups for the instance
- `None`: Do not keep any backups

DryRun.description_en: @sdk_hide_next_line Evaluates the scope of data space impact when modifying backup strategies; currently used to assess space changes after modifying strategies for deleted instances

HighFrequencySnapshotBackupEnable.description_en:
Whether to enable high-frequency backup for cloud disk instance

Possible values:
- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No

HighFrequencySnapshotBackupSecondPeriod.description_en:
Frequency of incremental snapshot backups for cloud disk instances (in seconds). Available values:
- `3600`: Every 1 hour
- `7200`: Every 2 hours
- `10800`: Every 3 hours
- `14400`: Every 4 hours
- `19200`: Every 6 hours
- `28800`: Every 8 hours
- `38400`: Every 12 hours

HourlyIncrBackupEnable.description_en:
Whether to enable high-frequency backup for local disk instances. Values:

- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No

IncrBackupHourPeriod.description_en:
Frequency of high-frequency incremental backups for local disk instances. Available values:

- `2`: Perform an incremental backup every 2 hours
- `4`: Perform an incremental backup every 4 hours
- `6`: Perform an incremental backup every 6 hours
- `12`: Perform an incremental backup every 12 hours

- When `HourlyIncrBackupEnable` is set to `true`, `IncrBackupHourPeriod` is required
- `IncrBackupHourPeriod` only takes effect when `HourlyIncrBackupEnable` is set to `true`

KeepCrossBackupEnableAfterReleased.description_en:
Retain cross-region backup. Values:

- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No
This feature is not supported for cloud disk instances.

LockDDLTime.description_en: Maximum DDL wait time. Default value: 30, minimum value: 10, maximum value: 1440, unit: minutes.

LockDDLTimeSecond.description_en:
Maximum DDL wait time. Maximum value: 86400, minimum value: 1, default value: 1800, unit: seconds, increment: 1.

The backup process blocks DDL. If the blocking time exceeds the specified duration, the backup will automatically stop.

LogBackupRetentionDay.description_en:
Binlog backup retention period. The number of days backups are retained varies by storage type:

- For local disk instances: selectable range is 7–3650 days, default is 7 days
- For cloud disk instances: selectable range is 7–720 days, default is 7 days

LogBackupRetentionDay does not take effect when RetentionPolicySynced is set to `true`.

RetentionPolicySynced.description_en:
Is the log backup retention policy consistent with the data backup retention policy?
When set to `true`, LogBackupRetentionDay and BinlogBackupAllRetention are ignored

PublicDownloadEnable.description_en:
Whether to allow downloading instance backup data from the public network environment. Values:
- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No

BackupEnabled.description_en:
Whether to enable cross-region backup

- `true`: Enable
- `false`: Disable (default value)

CrossBackupAllRetention.description_en:
Whether to retain cross-region backups long-term before instance release. Values:

- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No

CrossBackupRegion.description_en: Destination region ID for cross-region backup. This parameter is required when BackupEnabled is set to `true`

LogBackupEnabled.description_en:
Enable cross-region log backup

- `true`: Enable
- `false`: Disable (default)

You can only enable cross-region log backup when cross-region backup is enabled.

Retention.description_en:
Cross-region backup retention days. Value range: 7–3650. Default: 7. Unit: days.
If CrossBackupAllRetention is set to `true`, you do not need to configure this field.

AccountDesc.description_en: Description for the database account, up to 256 characters. This field is optional. If you leave it blank or enter an empty string (length 0), any existing remarks will be cleared.
AccountDesc.example_en: This is a new description for account tester.

AccountName.description_en: Database Account Name

Host.description_en:
Specify the IP address that the account uses to access the database. The default value is `%`.

- If Host is set to `%`, the account can access the database from any IP address
- You can use wildcards to define IP address ranges. For example, if Host is set to `192.10.10.%`, the account can access the database from IP addresses between `192.10.10.0` and `192.10.10.255`
- The specified Host must be added to the whitelist bound to the instance; otherwise, the account cannot access the instance. You can call the [ModifyAllowList](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/RDS_for_MySQL/modifyallowlist1) API to add the Host to the whitelist

If you create a high-privilege account, the host IP can only be set to `%`. That is, when AccountType is set to `Super`, Host must be `%`.

AccountName.description_en:
Database Standard Account

Only the IP address for standard accounts accessing the database can be changed

Host.description_en: Original IP Address for Account Database Access

NewHost.description_en:
New IP address that the account can use to access the database

- If Host is set to %, the account can access the database from any IP address
- You can use wildcards to specify a range of IP addresses. For example, setting Host to `192.10.10.%` allows the account to access the database from IP addresses between `192.10.10.0` and `192.10.10.255`
- The specified Host must be added to the whitelist bound to the instance; otherwise, the account cannot access the instance. You can call the [ModifyAllowList](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/RDS_for_MySQL/modifyallowlist1) API to add the Host to the whitelist

AutoAddNewNodes.description_en:
When the endpoint type is read/write or read-only, you can set whether new nodes are automatically added. Values:

- `true`: Auto add.
- `false`: Do not auto add (default).

- The auto-add new node feature for multi-node instance connection endpoints cannot be adjusted. The auto-add new node feature is enabled by default for default and read-only endpoints, and disabled by default for write endpoints.
- This feature is not supported for single-node instances.

ConnectAllSlaveNodes.description_en:
Whether to associate all standby nodes
Values:
- `true`: Yes (default)
- `false`: No

- This setting is only supported for read-only endpoints of multi-node instances
- You can only disable this feature if the instance has two or more standby nodes

ConnectionMode.description_en:
Connection endpoint type. Available values:
- `Proxy`: Proxy endpoint
- `Direct`: Direct endpoint

- If the database proxy feature is enabled for the instance, you can select either `Proxy` or `Direct`.
- If the database proxy feature is not enabled, only `Direct` is available.

You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/RDS_for_MySQL/describedbinstancedetail) API to check whether the database proxy feature is enabled for the instance.

ConnectionPoolType.description_en:
Connection pool type for proxy endpoints. Options:
- `Transaction`: Transaction-level connection pool (default)
- `Direct`: Direct connection mode

- This feature is not supported for single-node instances.
- When the ConnectionMode parameter is set to Proxy, this parameter is required; when set to Direct, this parameter is not applicable.

Description.description_en: Endpoint description. Length must be between 1 and 255 characters.

EnableConnectionPersistent.description_en:
Whether to enable connection keep-alive for the terminal. Values:
- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No

This setting is only supported for proxy terminals

EndpointId.description_en: Instance connection terminal ID

EndpointName.description_en:
Instance connection terminal name
Terminal name rules:
- Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-) are allowed
- Length must be between 1 and 64 characters

ExplicitTransSplit.description_en: Whether to enable explicit transaction separation: "true" | "false". For internal operations only, temporarily not available to customers

IdleConnectionReclaim.description_en:
Enable idle connection recycling.
- `true`: Enable.
- `false`: Disable.
This feature is not supported for single-node instances.

ImplicitTransSplit.description_en:
Enable transaction isolation
Values:
- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No (default)

This setting is supported only on proxy terminals

MasterNodeRouting.description_en:
Enable primary node routing. Values:
- `true`: Enable.
- `false`: Disable. Default value.

- Only proxy endpoints support this setting.
- This feature is not supported for multi-node or single-node instances.

MasterProtectorTimeout.description_en:
Overload protection timeout. Valid values are integers between 60 and 7200; the default is 60 seconds.

- Overload protection is supported only on proxy terminals.
- This setting is effective only when OverloadProtection is set to `true`.

MultiStatementsMode.description_en:
Multi-Statements mode for the proxy endpoint. Values:
- `Strict`: Strict mode. Default value.
- `Loose`: Loose mode.

- This feature is not supported for single-node instances.
- When the `ConnectionMode` parameter is set to `Proxy`, this parameter is required; when set to `Direct`, this parameter is invalid.

Nodes.description_en:
Node list for configuring connection terminals

- For the primary node, you do not need to provide a node ID. Use the string 'Primary'.
- **Dual-node instance**
    - In read-write mode, a proxy terminal can be associated with only the primary node, or with the primary node and up to 10 read-only nodes. In read-only mode, it can only be associated with read-only nodes, with a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 10 read-only nodes.
    - In read-write mode, a direct terminal can only be associated with the primary node. In read-only mode, it can only be associated with 1 read-only node.
- **Multi-node instance**
    - The default terminal is associated with all nodes in the instance. The write terminal is associated only with the primary node. You cannot adjust the associated nodes for either the default terminal or the write terminal.
    - By default, the read-only terminal is associated with all standby nodes in the instance. You can associate a minimum of 1 and a maximum of all standby nodes. To adjust the associated nodes for a read-only terminal in a multi-node instance, you must disable the 'Associate All Standby Nodes' feature. When a standby node is promoted to primary, it will automatically be disassociated from the read-only terminal.
    - If a standby node associated with a read-only terminal is promoted to primary, the number of standby nodes associated with the read-only terminal will decrease by one. To maintain the original number of standby nodes, you need to manually add a new standby node. It is recommended to configure a sufficient number of standby nodes for terminals to handle business traffic.
- To ensure high availability in read-only mode, it is recommended to associate at least two standby nodes (for multi-node instances) or two read-only nodes (for dual-node instances) with each read-only terminal.

OverloadProtection.description_en:
Enable overload protection. Values:
- `true`: Enable. Default value.
- `false`: Disable.

- Only proxy endpoints support overload protection.
- Overload protection is effective only when read/write splitting is enabled on the connection endpoint and the primary node is not the only node for the current connection endpoint.
- This feature is not supported for single-node instances.

ReadOnlyNodeDistributionType.description_en:
Read weight allocation mode. This parameter is required when read/write splitting is enabled (`true`). For request parameters in the CreateDBEndpoint and ModifyDBEndpoint APIs, the available values are:
- `LoadSchedule`: Load scheduling.
- `RoundRobinCustom`: Custom weight round-robin scheduling.
- `RoundRobinAuto`: Auto-assigned weight round-robin scheduling.

For response parameters in the DescribeDBInstanceDetail API, the available values are:
- `Default`: Auto-assign by specification weight.
- `Custom`: Custom weight assignment.
- `RoundRobin`: Round-robin scheduling.
- `LoadSchedule`: Load scheduling.
- `RoundRobinCustom`: Custom weight round-robin scheduling.
- `RoundRobinAuto`: Auto-assigned weight round-robin scheduling.

- Multi-node instances only support `RoundRobinAuto`.
- This feature is not supported for single-node instances.
- When the `ConnectionMode` parameter is set to `Proxy`, this parameter is required; when set to `Direct`, this parameter is invalid.

ReadOnlyNodeMaxDelayTime.description_en:
Maximum latency threshold for read-only nodes. If a read-only node's latency exceeds this value, read traffic will not be routed to that node. Valid range: 1–3600 seconds. Default: 30 seconds.

For read/write terminals, you can set this parameter after enabling read/write splitting.

ReadOnlyNodeWeight.description_en:
Customize read weight distribution by assigning read request weights to the primary node and read-only nodes. Increase weights in increments of 100, up to a maximum of 10,000. When ReadOnlyNodeDistributionType is set to `Custom`, you must provide this parameter.

- For the primary node, set NodeType to Primary; for read-only nodes, provide the NodeID.
- You cannot set all weights to 0.

ReadWriteMode.description_en:
Read/write mode for the connection terminal. Options:

- `ReadWrite`: Read and write
- `ReadOnly`: Read only

When used as a request parameter, the default value is `ReadWrite`.

ReadWriteSpliting.description_en:
Enable read/write splitting. Options:

- `true`: Enable read/write splitting
- `false`: Disable read/write splitting (default)

- Supported when ReadWriteMode is set to `ReadWrite`; not supported when ReadWriteMode is set to `ReadOnly`. This parameter only applies to the default endpoint.
- This feature is not supported for single-node instances.

DomainPrefix.description_en:
Connection address prefix. The connection address prefix must meet the following requirements:

- Start with a lowercase letter and end with a lowercase letter or a digit
- Consist of at least two of the following: lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens (-)
- The connection address prefix must contain at least 8 characters, and the total length of the connection address (prefix + suffix) must not exceed 63 characters

EipId.description_en: Elastic Public IP ID

EndpointId.description_en: Instance Connection Terminal ID

InternetProtocol.description_en: IP protocol version. The value is `IPv4`.

NetworkType.description_en:
Network address type. Possible values:

- `Private`: private network address
- `Public`: public network address

Port.description_en:
Port. Port number range: 1000–65534

If not set, the system will use and configure the terminal's default private network port as the default port in real time.

SubnetId.description_en: Private network address subnet ID

VpcId.description_en: VpcId

ConnectionMode.description_en:
Connection terminal type. Options:
- `Proxy`: Proxy terminal (default)
- `Direct`: Direct terminal

- You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/RDS_for_MySQL/describedbinstancedetail) API to check whether the database proxy feature is enabled for the instance.
	- If the database proxy feature is enabled, you can select either `Proxy` or `Direct`.
	- If the database proxy feature is not enabled, only `Direct` is available.
- Adjusting the connection terminal type is not supported for multi-node instances.

EndpointId.description_en: Connected Terminal ID

DNSVisibility.description_en:
- `false`: Volcengine private network resolution (default)
- `true`: Volcengine private and public network resolution

EndpointId.description_en: Instance Connection Terminal ID

NetworkType.description_en: Network address type. Value is `Private`, which means a private network address

AutoUpgradeMinorVersion.description_en:
Upgrade policy for instance kernel minor versions. Options:
- `Auto`: Automatic upgrade. When a new kernel minor version is released, the instance will automatically upgrade to the latest kernel minor version during the configured [maintenance window](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/RDS_for_MySQL/setting_a_maintenance_period?lang=zh).
- `Manual`: Manual upgrade. When a new kernel minor version is released, you need to manually upgrade to the latest kernel minor version from the Console. For details, see [Manually upgrade instance kernel minor version](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/RDS_for_MySQL/upgrading_instance_kernel_minor_version?lang=zh).
If the kernel minor version of the instance exceeds the maintenance period, the system will temporarily ignore the configured upgrade policy and automatically upgrade the kernel minor version for the instance.

AutoRenew.description_en:
Whether to enable auto-renewal in the prepaid scenario. Options:

- `true`: Auto-renewal enabled
- `false`: Auto-renewal disabled

This field is required when ChargeType is set to `PrePaid`.

ChargeResourceType.description_en: Billing resource type. Possible values: PrimaryInstance, Regular Instance

ChargeType.description_en:
Payment type. Possible values:

- `PrePaid`: Annual or monthly subscription
- `PostPaid`: Pay-as-you-go (billed by usage)

InstanceId.description_en: Instance ID. You can enter up to 20 instance IDs. Separate multiple IDs with English commas (,).

Period.description_en:
Purchase Duration in Prepaid Scenario

This field is required when ChargeType is set to PrePaid

PeriodUnit.description_en:
Purchase cycle in prepaid scenarios.

- `Month`: Monthly purchase cycle. Default.
- `Year`: Annual purchase cycle.

This field is required when ChargeType is set to `PrePaid`.

PrepaidPeriod.description_en:
Purchase cycle in prepaid scenarios
- `Month`: Monthly plan
- `Year`: Annual plan

UsedTime.description_en: Purchase duration in the prepaid scenario

DeletionProtection.description_en:
Enable deletion protection for this instance?
Options:
- Enabled
- Disabled

GlobalReadOnly.description_en:
Whether to enable global read-only mode for this instance. Values:
- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No

DayKind.description_en: Maintenance Cycle Granularity; Options: Week, 周

DayOfWeek.description_en:
Specify the days of the week when the maintenance window is active. You can select multiple days.

- `Monday`: Monday
- `Tuesday`: Tuesday
- `Wednesday`: Wednesday
- `Thursday`: Thursday
- `Friday`: Friday
- `Saturday`: Saturday
- `Sunday`: Sunday

If no days are selected or the field is left empty, the maintenance window is active every day by default.

MaintenanceTime.description_en:
Instance maintenance window. Format: HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ (UTC time)

- The minimum interval is 2 hours, and the maximum is 24 hours. Selecting a time range that crosses days is not allowed.
- Only hour-level settings are currently supported.

InstanceNewName.description_en:
New instance name

Naming rules:

- Cannot start with a number or hyphen
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens are allowed
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

AllowUnsupportParams.description_en: @sdk_hide_next_line allows passing in unsupported parameters and ignores errors; used in batch parameter modification scenarios

CustomNodeIds.description_en:
ID of the read-only node to apply parameter changes

This parameter is only effective when the ParamApplyScope parameter is set to `CustomNode`.

DryRun.description_en: @sdk_hide_next_line DryRun status. If true, only generates a modification plan; does not execute changes

Forcerestart.description_en: Whether to restart the database when modifying parameters, default: false

ParamApplyScope.description_en:
Specifies the scope for parameter changes. Options:

- `AllNode`: All nodes. Default value.
- `OnlyMasterSlaveNode`: Only master and slave nodes.
- `OnlyReadOnlyNode`: All read-only nodes.
- `CustomNode`: Specified read-only nodes.

This parameter only applies when the instance type is dual-node.

Parameters.description_en: Parameter value object: user-defined parameter values based on the default parameter template

SpecifiedSwitchEndTime.description_en: Specify the deadline for triggering the switch; effective only when SwitchType is SpecifiedTime

SpecifiedSwitchStartTime.description_en: Specify the start time to trigger the switch; effective only when SwitchType is set to SpecifiedTime. Use RFC3339 format and set the time to the hour

SwitchType.description_en:
Change Type, values:

- `Immediate`: Switch immediately (default)
- `MaintainTime`: Switch during maintenance window

TemplateId.description_en:
When modifying instance parameters using a parameter template, use the ID of the parameter template.
- You must use a parameter template with the same engine version as the instance.
- If this field is provided, the parameter settings specified in the parameter template take precedence, and the settings in the Parameters field are ignored. When modifying instance parameters using a parameter template, you can pass an empty array to the Parameters field.

ReloadSSLCertificate.description_en:
Update SSL certificate validity period. If set to `true`, the SSL certificate validity period will be updated.

- Only takes effect when SSL encryption is enabled for the instance.
- Cannot be modified together with the SSLEnable field.

SSLEnable.description_en:
Enable or disable SSL encryption. Values:

- `true`: Enable
- `false`: Disable (default)

If you do not set this field, the SSL encryption status of the instance will not change.

SpecifiedSwitchEndTime.description_en:
When executing within a specified time period, set the end time of the period (UTC time). Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.

- This parameter is required when SwitchType is set to `SpecifiedTime`.
- The minimum duration for the specified time period is one hour and fifty-nine minutes.
- Cross-day time periods are not supported; the task start and end times must not exceed 24 hours.

SpecifiedSwitchStartTime.description_en:
When executing within a specified time period, set the start time of the period (UTC time). Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.

- This parameter is required when SwitchType is set to `SpecifiedTime`.
- The task start time must not be later than the seventh day after the current date.
- The time must be an exact hour (e.g., 10:00, 11:00).

SwitchType.description_en:
Execution time options:

- `Immediate`: Switch immediately (default)
- `MaintainTime`: Switch during the maintenance window
- `SpecifiedTime`: Switch within the specified time period

- You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/RDS_for_MySQL/describedbinstancedetail) API to query the maintenance window for the instance.
- If `SpecifiedTime` is selected, you must set the start and end times in the `SpecifiedSwitchStartTime` and `SpecifiedSwitchEndTime` parameters.

DryRun.description_en: @sdk_hide_next_line: whether DryRun. If true, it only generates a pre-scheduling plan and does not execute

ModifyType.description_en: Change type for instance specifications. Value: `Usually` – routine adjustment

NodeInfo.description_en:
Instance specification configuration. There must be exactly one primary node and one secondary node. You can add 0 to 10 read-only nodes. Ignore ZoneId except when adding read-only nodes.

- You must select either this parameter or StorageSpace, and you can modify both at the same time.
- Cloud Database MySQL Edition supports creating the primary and secondary nodes in different availability zones, but each read-only node must be added to the availability zone of either the primary node or the secondary node.

RequestSource.description_en:
Request source. Values:
- `EventType_Web`: From Web
- `EventType_OpenAPI`: From Open API

RollbackTime.description_en: Restore Time, effective when ModifyType is set to Temporary

SpecifiedSwitchEndTime.description_en:
When executing within a specified time window, this is the end time of the window. The time format is `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.
- When SwitchType is set to `SpecifiedTime`, this parameter is required
- The minimum duration for the specified time window is one hour and fifty-nine minutes
- Cross-day time windows are not supported; the start and end times must be within 24 hours

SpecifiedSwitchStartTime.description_en:
When executing within a specified time window, this is the start time of the window. The time format is `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.

- When SwitchType is set to `SpecifiedTime`, this parameter is required
- The start time for the task must not be later than the seventh day after the current date

StorageSpace.description_en:
Instance Storage Space. Value range: [20, 3000] GB, in increments of 10 GB. Default is the same as the current value

You must specify either this parameter or NodeInfo. Both parameters can be modified at the same time

StorageType.description_en:
Instance storage type. Value range:
- `LocalSSD`: Local disk.
- `CloudESSD_FlexPL`: FlexPL cloud disk.
- `CloudESSD_PL0`: PL0 cloud disk.
- If you need to set the StorageSpace parameter, the StorageType parameter is required.
- When InstanceType is set to `SingleNode`, StorageType can only be `CloudESSD_FlexPL` or `CloudESSD_PL0`.
- The value range of this parameter varies by API. The specific rules are as follows:
	- When used as a request parameter in the following APIs, StorageType can only be `LocalSSD`:
		- RestoreToCrossRegionInstance
		- RestoreToNewInstanceFromUserTos

- When used as a request parameter in some APIs, the value range of this parameter depends on the storage type of the original instance. The specific rules are as follows:
	- If the original instance storage type is `LocalSSD` or `CloudESSD_FlexPL`, changing the storage type is not supported.
	- If the original instance storage type is `CloudESSD_PL0`, the value can be `CloudESSD_PL0` or `CloudESSD_FlexPL`.
	The related APIs are:
		- RebuildDBInstance
		- RestoreToNewInstance
		- ModifyDBNodeSpec

SwitchType.description_en:
Switch execution time. Available values:

- `Immediate`: Switch immediately (default)
- `MaintainTime`: Switch during the maintenance window
- `SpecifiedTime`: Switch within a specified time window

- You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/RDS_for_MySQL/describedbinstancedetail) API to query the maintenance window for the instance
- If the value is `SpecifiedTime`, you must set the start and end times in the `SpecifiedSwitchStartTime` and `SpecifiedSwitchEndTime` parameters

KeyName.description_en: Custom Key Name

KeyringName.description_en:
Custom Keyring Name

To use a custom key, you must provide both KeyringName and KeyName. If you provide only one field or leave both blank, an automatically generated key will be used.

SpecifiedSwitchEndTime.description_en:
When executing within a specified time period, set the end time of the period (UTC time). Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.

- This parameter is required when SwitchType is set to `SpecifiedTime`.
- The minimum duration for the specified time period is one hour and fifty-nine minutes.
- Cross-day time periods are not supported; the task's start and end times must not exceed 24 hours.

SpecifiedSwitchStartTime.description_en:
When executing within a specified time period, set the start time of the period (UTC time). Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.

- This parameter is required when SwitchType is set to `SpecifiedTime`.
- The task's start time must not be later than the seventh day after the current date.
- The start time must be an exact hour.

SwitchType.description_en:
Execution time options:

- `Immediate`: Switch immediately (default)
- `MaintainTime`: Switch during the maintenance window
- `SpecifiedTime`: Switch within the specified time period

- You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/RDS_for_MySQL/describedbinstancedetail) API to query the maintenance window for the instance.
- When `SpecifiedTime` is selected, you must set the start and end times in the `SpecifiedSwitchStartTime` and `SpecifiedSwitchEndTime` parameters.

When restoring to a new instance using the RestoreToNewInstance API, the whitelists from the source instance are not bound by default. If needed, you can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/RDS_for_MySQL/describeallowlists1) API to query the whitelists bound to the source instance and enter them in this field before calling the restore API. Alternatively, after restoring to the new instance, you can bind whitelists by calling the [AssociateAllowList](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/RDS_for_MySQL/associateallowlist1) API.

AutoUpgradeMinorVersion.description_en:
Upgrade policy for instance kernel minor versions. Options:
- `Auto`: Automatic upgrade. When a new kernel minor version is released, the instance will automatically upgrade to the latest kernel minor version during the configured [maintenance window](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/RDS_for_MySQL/setting_a_maintenance_period?lang=zh).
- `Manual`: Manual upgrade. When a new kernel minor version is released, you need to manually upgrade to the latest kernel minor version in the console. For details, see [Manually upgrade instance kernel minor version](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/RDS_for_MySQL/upgrading_instance_kernel_minor_version?lang=zh).
If the kernel minor version of the instance exceeds the maintenance period, the system will temporarily ignore the configured upgrade policy and automatically upgrade the kernel minor version for the instance.

- You must specify either this parameter or the RestoreTime parameter.

StorageType.description_en:

- `CloudESSD_FlexPL`: FlexPL cloud disk.
- `CloudESSD_PL0`: PL0 cloud disk.

- When InstanceType is set to `SingleNode`, StorageType can only be `CloudESSD_FlexPL` or `CloudESSD_PL0`.
- The value range of this parameter varies by interface. The specific rules are as follows:
	- When used as a request parameter in the following interfaces, StorageType can only be `LocalSSD`.
		- RestoreToCrossRegionInstance
		- RestoreToNewInstanceFromUserTos

- When used as a request parameter in some interfaces, the value range of this parameter depends on the storage type of the original instance. The specific rules are as follows:
	- If the original instance storage type is `LocalSSD` or `CloudESSD_FlexPL`, changing the storage type is not supported.
	- If the original instance storage type is `CloudESSD_PL0`, you can set it to `CloudESSD_PL0` or `CloudESSD_FlexPL`.
	The relevant interfaces are:
		- RebuildDBInstance
		- RestoreToNewInstance
		- ModifyDBNodeSpec

- CIDR IP range format. Example: `10.23.12.0/24` (Classless Inter-Domain Routing, where 24 indicates the prefix length, ranging from 1 to 32)

AllowList.description_en:
IP addresses included in the whitelist. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,). Do not repeat IP addresses. Supports the following two formats:

- IP address format. For example: `10.23.12.24`
- CIDR IP range format. For example: `10.23.12.0/24` (Classless Inter-Domain Routing; 24 indicates the prefix length, range is 1–32)

- Each whitelist can contain up to 300 IP addresses or IP ranges. If you have many IPs, it is recommended to merge them into ranges, such as 10.23.12.0/24
- It is forbidden to add IP addresses in the format `x.x.x.x/0` except for `0.0.0.0/0`
- No default value. If this parameter is not set, the existing whitelist IPs will not be modified

AllowListCategory.description_en:

- `Ordinary`: Ordinary whitelist
- `Default`: Default whitelist

This parameter has no default value when used in requests. If not provided, all whitelist categories will be queried.

AllowListId.description_en: Whitelist ID. You can query it using the [DescribeAllowLists](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/RDS_for_PG/describeallowlists) API.

- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
- Length must be 1 to 128 characters

ModifyMode.description_en:

- `Cover`: Overwrite—replace the original whitelist with the IP addresses specified in the AllowList field. Default option
- `Append`: Add—add the IP addresses from the AllowList field to the existing whitelist
- `Delete`: Remove—delete the IP addresses specified in the AllowList field from the existing whitelist. At least one IP address must be retained

If the whitelist is bound to a security group, or you need to bind a security group when modifying the whitelist, ModifyMode can only be set to `Cover`.

- `Friday`: Friday

- Call the [DescribeVpcs](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeVpcs) API to view available private networks.
- Call the [CreateVpc](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/CreateVpc) API to create a new private network.

AllowListDesc.description_en: Whitelist description. Maximum 200 characters. Default value is an empty string.

AllowListName.description_en:
Name of the merged whitelist. Naming rules:

- Whitelist names must be unique within the current region
- Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_)
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
- Length must be 1 to 128 characters

InstanceIds.description_en:
IDs of instances whose whitelists will be merged/generated

You can merge or generate whitelists for up to 300 instances

ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter value. It must be unique for each request, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

InstanceIds.description_en:
Instance IDs that need to be bound to tags
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/describedbinstances) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including instance IDs
* You can provide multiple instance IDs at once, separated by commas (,). Up to 20 instance IDs can be provided at the same time

Tags.description_en: Array object of tag keys and tag values that need to be bound

AllowListIds.description_en:
Whitelist ID that needs to be bound to the instance
* You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/describeallowlists) API to view all whitelists in a specified region, including whitelist IDs
* You can enter multiple whitelist IDs at once, separated by commas (,)
* You cannot enter multiple instance IDs and multiple whitelist IDs at the same time. You can either bind multiple instances to a single whitelist, or bind one instance to multiple whitelists in a single operation

ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate request submissions. The client generates this parameter value; it must be unique across requests, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

InstanceIds.description_en:
Instance IDs to be bound to the whitelist
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/describedbinstances) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including instance IDs.
* You can enter multiple instance IDs at once, separated by commas (,).
* You cannot enter multiple instance IDs and multiple whitelists at the same time. You can either bind multiple instances to the same whitelist at once, or bind one instance to multiple whitelists at once.

AllowList.description_en:
Enter an IP address or a CIDR block
* The `AllowList` and `SecurityGroupBindInfos` parameters cannot both be empty
* Duplicate addresses are not allowed; separate multiple addresses with an English comma (,)
* Setting `0.0.0.0/0` allows access from all addresses; setting `127.0.0.1` blocks access from all addresses; setting both `0.0.0.0/0` and `127.0.0.1` allows access from all addresses
* Setting the CIDR `192.168.1.0/24` allows access from IP addresses within that block; setting `192.168.1.1` allows access only from that IP address

AllowListCategory.description_en:
Whitelist type. Available values:

* `Ordinary` (default): Ordinary whitelist
* `Default`: Default whitelist

Each BytePlus account can set at most one default whitelist per region. When you set a new default whitelist, it automatically replaces the previous one, which then becomes a non-default whitelist. For more details, see [Constraints and limitations](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/quota-and-limit#%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD%E7%89%B9%E6%80%A7%E9%99%90%E5%88%B6).

AllowListDesc.description_en:
Whitelist remark cannot exceed 200 characters.
If you do not set this parameter, the remark for the new whitelist will be empty by default.

AllowListName.description_en:
Whitelist name requirements (all must be met):

* Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
* Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-) are allowed
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

SecurityGroupBindInfos.description_en:

BackupPointName.description_en:
Set a backup name for manually created backups
To set a backup name, make sure it meets all of the following requirements:

* Starts with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_)
* Contains 1–128 characters
* Can include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)

If you do not set a backup name, the backup ID generated during backup creation will be used as the name by default.

Instance ID

SourceInstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID of the source instance (i.e., the blue instance).
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/describedbinstances) API to query basic information, including instance IDs, for all Redis instances in the target region.

TargetEngineVersion.description_en:
Set the database version for the green instance.
The database version of the green instance must be greater than that of the blue instance. For example, if the blue instance uses version 5.0, the green instance can use version 6.0 or 7.0.

TargetInstanceName.description_en:
Set the name of the target instance (i.e., the green instance). The name must meet the following requirements:

* Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
* Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
* Length must be 1–128 characters

* If you do not set a name for the green instance, the default name will be `<blue instance name>-green-<six-digit random code>`.
   For example, if the blue instance name is `redistest`, then when creating a green instance for this instance, the default name may be `redistest-green-b4bf10`.
* The instance name for Redis cache database cannot exceed 128 characters, and `-green-<six-digit random code>` will occupy a fixed 13 characters. Therefore, the `<blue instance name>` part in the green instance name can retain up to the first 115 characters of the blue name to fit the total length limit.

AccountName.description_en:
Account Name
The name must meet all of the following requirements:

* Start with a lowercase letter and end with a lowercase letter or number
* Be 2 to 16 characters long
* Use only lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores (_)

ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter; it must be unique for each request, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

Description.description_en:
Account description, up to 256 characters
If this parameter is empty, no account description will be set

InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/describedbinstances) API to query basic information about all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID

Password.description_en:
Account password. The password must meet all of the following requirements:

* Length must be 8–64 characters
* Must contain at least two of the following: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, or special characters
* The following special characters are supported:
   ```Plain Text
   ()`~!@#$%^&*-+=_|{}[];<>,.?
   ```

RoleName.description_en:
Account roles. The following default roles are supported:

* `Administrator`: Allows all supported commands on all Keys in the Redis instance
* `ReadWrite`: Allows all commands except those in the `admin` category on all Keys
* `ReadOnly`: Allows all commands in the `read` category on all Keys
* `NotDangerous`: Allows all commands except those in the `dangerous` category on all Keys
* `NotWrite`: Allows all commands except those in the `write` category on all Keys

* For details on the specific commands supported by each role's ACL rules, see [ACL Syntax](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/create-role#acl-%E8%AF%AD%E6%B3%95).
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceAclCategories](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/describedbinstanceaclcategories) API to query the command categories supported by the target Redis instance, and call the [DescribeDBInstanceAclCommands](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/describedbinstanceaclcommands) API to query the details of commands supported under a specified command category.

ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate request submissions. The client generates this parameter value, which must be unique for each request, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/describedbinstances) API to query basic information about all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID

Port.description_en:
Set the port number for the direct connection address. Valid ranges are 1024–4000 and 5100–64512.
* If this parameter is not specified, the direct connection address uses port 6379 by default.
* After the application is completed, you can also call the [ModifyDBInstanceVisitAddress](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/modifydbinstancevisitaddress) API to change the domain name and port number of the direct connection address.

ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter; it must be unique for each request, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

EipId.description_en:

InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/describedbinstances) API to query basic information about all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

Port.description_en:
Set the port number for the public address. Valid values: 1024–65535.
* If you leave this parameter blank, the public address uses port 6379 by default
* After the request is complete, you can also call the [ModifyDBInstanceVisitAddress](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/modifydbinstancevisitaddress) API to modify the domain name and port number of the public address

AllowListIds.description_en:
Allowlist ID list. If this parameter is left empty, the new instance will not be added to any allowlist by default.
* You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/describeallowlists) API to query all IP allowlist information under the specified region for the current account, including allowlist IDs.
* Each instance supports binding up to 100 allowlists, and you can batch bind up to 100 allowlists at a time.
* Each instance supports binding up to 1000 IP addresses or IP address ranges in CIDR format.

ArchType.description_en: Architecture Type: "Standard" – Standard type, "Cluster" – Cluster type

For more information on billing types, see [Pay-as-you-go](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/pay-as-you-go) and [Subscription](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/subscription)

ConsulName.description_en: Dedicated region environment is not empty

For more information about instance deletion protection, see [Instance Deletion Protection](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/deletion-protection).

EipId.description_en: EIP ID to Bind

EngineVersion.description_en:
Database version. Valid values:

* `5.0`: Redis version 5.0
* `6.0`: Redis version 6.0
* `7.0`: Redis version 7.0

Initiator.description_en: Request initiator: leave blank to indicate the SDK initiates the request; enter 'WEB' to indicate the frontend page initiates the request

InstanceName.description_en:
Instance name. The name must meet all of the following requirements:

* Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
* Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

If this parameter is left blank, the instance ID will be used as the instance name by default

InstanceType.description_en: Instance Type: "Cache" for memory, "Storage" for storage, default is "Storage"

MaintenanceTime.description_en: Instance maintenance window, xx:00-yy:00, minimum 2 hours

Modules.description_en: Enabled module list: exbloom, exstring, exts, valkey_search

MultiAZ.description_en:
Set the instance's availability zone deployment scheme. Value options:

* `disabled`: Single availability zone deployment scheme
* `enabled`: Multi-availability zone deployment scheme

* When creating a single-node instance (that is, when `NodeNumber` is set to `1`), only the single availability zone deployment scheme is allowed. In this case, `MultiAZ` must be set to `disabled`.
* For more details about availability zone deployment schemes, see [Multi-AZ Disaster Recovery Solution](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/multi-az-solution).

NeedRecoverPoint.description_en: Do we need to restore data? Do we need to seed data?

NetworkType.description_en: Network type: "Classic" – classic network, "VPC" – private network. Default: "VPC"

NoAuthMode.description_en:
Enable or disable passwordless access for the new instance. Value options:

* `open`: Enable passwordless access
* `close` (default): Disable passwordless access

* Parameter values are case-insensitive.
* After the instance is created, you can also call the [ModifyDBInstanceVpcAuthMode](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/modifydbinstancevpcauthmode) API to enable or disable passwordless access. For more information, see [Passwordless Access](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/pwd-free-access).

NodeCpus.description_en: Node CPU cores: Only 2, 4, or 8 are allowed

NodeNumber.description_en:
Number of nodes per shard. Value range: 1–6
* By default, each account can create up to 4 nodes of the 256 MiB specification (that is, `ShardCapacity` set to `256`) in each region. To adjust the purchase quota for 256 MiB nodes (maximum 10), see [Account Quota](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/quota-and-limit#%E8%B4%A6%E5%8F%B7%E9%85%8D%E9%A2%9D)
* When the value is `1`, a single-node instance is created; when greater than `1`, a master-replica instance is created. Single-node and master-replica instances support different features. For details on the differences, see [Feature Differences](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/feature-faq#%E4%B8%BB%E5%A4%87%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B%E5%92%8C%E5%8D%95%E8%8A%82%E7%82%B9%E7%B1%BB%E5%9E%8B%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B%E6%94%AF%E6%8C%81%E7%9A%84%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD%E7%89%B9%E6%80%A7%E6%9C%89%E4%BD%95%E5%B7%AE%E5%88%AB%EF%BC%9F)

ParameterGroupId.description_en:
Parameter template to be applied to the new instance.
* Redis provides a default system parameter template for each database version, which includes all configurable parameters and their default values for that version. If this parameter is left blank, the system will select and apply the corresponding version's system parameter template based on your specified database version (`EngineVersion`) and whether the instance is single-node (`NodeNumber` is `1`).
* You can call the [DescribeParameterGroups](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/describeparametergroups) API to query basic information about all parameter templates under your account and region, including parameter template IDs.

Password.description_en:
Set the password for the default database account. The password must meet the following requirements:

* Length: 8–64 characters
* Must include at least two of the following: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, or special characters
* Supports the following special characters:

```Plain Text
()`~!@#$%^&*-+=_|{}[];<>,.?
```

* If this parameter is left blank, no password will be set for the default account. In this case, the system will automatically generate a password for the default account to ensure instance security. No account can retrieve this random password, so you must reset the default account password via the [ModifyDBAccount](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/modifydbaccount) API before connecting to the instance.
* You can also set a new account and password as needed via the [CreateDBAccount](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/createdbaccount) API.
* To use passwordless access, you must first enable passwordless access via the [ModifyDBInstanceVpcAuthMode](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/modifydbinstancevpcauthmode) API.

PointBasicTosPrefix.description_en: The basic tos prefix of the backup point is used to set the instance context during batch instance creation

Port.description_en:
Customize the port number for the private network connection address. Value range: 1024~65535.
* If this parameter is left blank, the private network connection address uses port 6379 by default.
* After the instance is created, you can also modify the port number of the private network address. For instructions, see [Modify Port Number](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/modify-port).

ProjectName.description_en:
Select the project to which the instance belongs. If this parameter is left blank, the new instance will be added to the default (i.e., `default`) project.
A project is a virtual concept that includes a group of resources, users, and roles. Projects allow unified viewing and management of resources, and control the permissions of users and roles within the project for those resources. For more details, see [Resource Management](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6649/94333).

PurchaseMonths.description_en:
Purchase duration, in months. Value options:

* Monthly purchase: `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`, `6`, `7`, `8`, `9`
* Annual purchase: `12`, `24`, `36`

When `ChargeType` is `PrePaid`, this parameter is required.

RegionId.description_en:
Region ID.
You can call the [DescribeRegions](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/describeregions) API to query all region information supported by Redis instances, including region IDs.

RestoreInfoGetFromDataBase.description_en: Indicates whether to retrieve the backup point for restoring instance data from the database; used for setting instance context during batch creation

SealZoneVisit.description_en: Do you want to enable sales area access?

ShardCapacity.description_en:
Memory capacity per shard, in MiB. Value options:

* When sharded cluster is not enabled (`ShardedCluster` set to `0`), available values per shard: 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 24576, 65536
* When sharded cluster is enabled (`ShardedCluster` set to `1`), available values per shard: 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384

* When creating a single-node instance (`NodeNumber` set to `1`), 256 MiB memory capacity is not supported
* For more details on Redis product specifications, see [Product Specifications](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/product-specification)

ShardNumber.description_en:
Number of shards in the instance. Value range: 2–256.
This parameter is required only when `ShardedCluster` is set to `1` (enabled).

ShardedCluster.description_en:
Whether to enable sharded cluster. Value range:

* `0`: Disabled
* `1`: Enabled

For more information about the product architecture of Redis, see [Product Architecture](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/product-component-architecture).

SubnetId.description_en:
Set the subnet ID for the instance.
* Subnets have availability zone attributes. You must select a subnet in the target VPC that is in the same availability zone as the instance.
* A subnet is an IP address block within a VPC. All cloud resources in the VPC must be deployed within a subnet. Subnets assign private IP addresses to cloud resources. You can call the [CreateSubnet](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/CreateSubnet) API to create a subnet.
* You can call the [DescribeSubnets](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeSubnets) API to query all subnet list information in a specified availability zone, including subnet IDs.

Tags.description_en:
Array of tag keys and tag values to bind.
If this parameter is left empty, the new instance will not bind any tags by default.

VpcId.description_en:
Set the instance's VPC ID.
* It is recommended that the Redis instance and the ECS instance to be connected are in the same VPC; otherwise, they cannot communicate over the internal network for optimal performance. You can create a VPC using the [CreateVpc](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/CreateVpc) API.
* You can query VPC information that meets specified criteria, including VPC ID, using the [DescribeVpcs](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeVpcs) API.

AllowListIds.description_en:
Whitelist ID list. The system binds newly created instances to the specified whitelist.
You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/84772/1393071) API to query all IP whitelist information, including whitelist IDs, for the specified region under your account. For more details about enterprise edition whitelists, see [Create Whitelist](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/84772/1255848).

AutoRenew.description_en:
Enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

* `true`: Enable
* `false` (default): Disable

This parameter is effective only when `ChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`.

ChargeType.description_en:
Billing type. Available options:

* `PostPaid`: Pay-as-you-go
* `PrePaid`: Subscription (annual/monthly)

For more information about billing types, see [Billing types](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/84772/1355136).

ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter value. It must be unique for each request, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

ConfigureNodes.description_en: List of availability zones for the node

DataLayout.description_en:
Specify the data storage type for the new instance. Available options:

* `RAM`: Memory type
* `Hybrid`: Hybrid type

For more information about data storage types for enterprise edition instances, see [Data Storage Types](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/84772/1258077#%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E5%AD%98%E5%82%A8%E5%BD%A2%E6%80%81).

DeletionProtection.description_en:
Enable or disable instance deletion protection. Valid values:

* `disabled` (default): Disabled
* `enabled`: Enabled

If this parameter is not specified, instance deletion protection is disabled by default. For more information, see [Instance Deletion Protection](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/84772/1255845).

FlashPerShard.description_en:
Set the high-speed storage capacity for a single shard in MiB.
Range: 10240–30720 (10GiB–30GiB), increment: 10240MiB (10GiB).
This parameter is only effective when the instance data storage type is hybrid (i.e., `DataLayout` is set to `Hybrid`).

Initiator.description_en: Leave blank to indicate the request is initiated by the SDK. Enter 'WEB' to indicate the request is initiated by the frontend page.

InstanceName.description_en:
Instance name
The name must meet all of the following requirements:

* Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
* Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
* Must be 1–128 characters long

If this parameter is left blank, the instance ID will be used as the instance name by default

MaintenanceTime.description_en: Instance maintenance window, xx:00-yy:00, minimum 2 hours

Modules.description_en:
Set the modules to load. Supported module types:

* `RedisJSON`
* `RedisBloom`
* `RediSearch`
* `RedisTimeSeries`

* `RediSearch` and `RedisTimeSeries` modules are only available when the data store type is an in-memory instance (that is, when `DataLayout` is set to `RAM`).
* If this parameter is left blank, no modules will be loaded by default. For more details about Redis modules, see [Data Modules](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/84772/1258077#%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E6%A8%A1%E5%9D%97).

MultiAZ.description_en:
Set the instance's availability zone deployment scheme. Valid values:

* `disabled` (default): Single availability zone deployment
* `enabled`: Multi-availability zone deployment

For more details about availability zone deployment schemes, see [Multi-availability zone same-city disaster recovery solution](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/84772/1285437).

NeedRecoverPoint.description_en: Do we need to restore data? Do we need to seed data?

Password.description_en:
Set the password for the default database account. The password must meet all of the following requirements:

* Length must be 8–32 characters
* Must include at least two of the following: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, or special characters
* The following special characters are supported:
   ```Plain Text
   ()`~!@#$%^&*-+=_|{}[];<>,.?
   ```

* If you leave this field blank, no password will be set for the default account. The system will automatically generate a password to secure instance access. No account can retrieve this random password, so you must [reset](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/84772/1255833) the default account password before connecting to the instance.
* After the instance is created, you can also create new accounts and passwords as needed. For detailed steps, see [Create and manage accounts](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/84772/1262348).

PurchaseMonths.description_en:
Purchase duration, in months. Valid values:

* Monthly: `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`, `6`, `7`, `8`, `9`
* Yearly: `12`, `24`, `36`

RamPerShard.description_en:

RegionId.description_en:
Region ID

ShardNumber.description_en: Number of shards in the instance. Allowed values: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32

SubnetId.description_en:
Set the subnet ID for the instance.
* Subnets have an availability zone attribute. You must select a subnet in the target VPC that is in the same availability zone as the instance.
* A subnet is an IP address block within a VPC. All cloud resources in the VPC must be deployed in a subnet. Subnets assign private IP addresses to cloud resources. You can call the [CreateSubnet](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/CreateSubnet) API to create a subnet.
* You can call the [DescribeSubnets](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeSubnets) API to query the list of all subnets in a specified availability zone, including subnet IDs.

Tags.description_en:
An array object containing the tag keys and tag values to bind
If left empty, the new instance does not bind any tags by default

VpcId.description_en:
Set the private network ID for the instance.
* For best performance, we recommend placing the Redis instance and the ECS instance it connects to in the same private network. Otherwise, they cannot communicate over the internal network. You can use the [CreateVpc](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/CreateVpc) API to create a private network.
* Use the [DescribeVpcs](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeVpcs) API to query private network information that meets your criteria, including the private network ID.

InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/describedbinstances) API to query basic information about all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

ScanKeyNumPerSecond.description_en: Number of expired keys scanned per second. Enter an integer between 2000 and 100000

Description.description_en:
The remark for the parameter template cannot exceed 200 characters.
If you do not set this parameter, the remark for the new parameter template will be empty by default.

EngineVersion.description_en:
Redis database versions supported by the parameter template. Available options:

* `7.0`: Redis 7.0
* `6.0`: Redis 6.0
* `5.0`: Redis 5.0

Name.description_en:
Parameter template name. The name must meet all of the following requirements:

* Cannot start with a digit or hyphen (-)
* Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
* Must be 2–64 characters long

ParamValues.description_en:
List of parameter information to include in new parameter templates.
* Each parameter template must include at least one parameter
* For more details about supported Redis parameters, please see [Parameter Support](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/supported-parameter)

ApplyImmediately.description_en:
Apply configuration changes immediately? Valid values:

* `true`: Apply changes immediately
* `false`: Apply changes during the maintenance window

For more information about the maintenance window, see [Set Maintenance Window](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/set-maintenance-period).

BackupPointName.description_en:
Set a backup name for the full backup created before the change. The backup name must meet all of the following requirements:

* Starts with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_)
* Length is 1–128 characters
* Can include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)

* This parameter is only effective if you choose to create a backup before the change (that is, if `CreateBackup` is set to `true`).
* If you do not set a backup name, the backup ID will be used as the name by default.

ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter value, which must be unique across different requests, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

CreateBackup.description_en: * Whether to create a full backup before making changes Value range: `true`: create backup; `false` (default): do not create backup

NodesNumberToDecrease.description_en:
Set the number of nodes to remove from a single shard
Each shard supports 2 to 6 nodes. After reducing nodes, the total must satisfy: 2 <= (current node count - nodes to remove) <= 6
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/describedbinstancedetail) API to query details for a specific instance, including the current node count in each shard
* By default, each account can create up to 4 nodes of the 256MiB specification per region. To adjust the purchase quota for 256MiB nodes (maximum 10), see [Constraints and usage limits](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/quota-and-limit#%E8%B4%A6%E5%8F%B7%E9%85%8D%E9%A2%9D)

BackupPointName.description_en:
Set a backup name for the final backup of the instance to be deleted. If you do not specify a backup name, the backup ID will be used by default.

To set a backup name, make sure the name meets all of the following requirements:

* Starts with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_)
* Contains 1–128 characters
* Consists of Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)

* This parameter applies only to **pay-as-you-go** **primary-secondary instances**, where `InstanceClass` is `PrimarySecondary` and `ChargeType` is `PostPaid`.
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/describedbinstancedetail) API to view details of a specific instance, including instance type and billing type.

ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client must generate this parameter value, which must be unique for each request, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

CreateBackup.description_en:
Create a final backup when deleting an instance. Possible values:

* `true` (default): Create a backup
* `false`: Do not create a backup

* This parameter applies only to master-replica node instances. Single-node instances do not support persistence or backup. When you delete a single-node instance, no backup is created by default. All data will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered. Please proceed with caution. For more details about single-node instances, see [Product Architecture](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/product-component-architecture#%E4%BA%A7%E5%93%81%E6%9E%B6%E6%9E%84).
* If you leave this parameter empty, a final backup will be created by default when deleting a master-replica instance to save all data before deletion. After the instance is deleted, you can call the [DescribeBackups](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/describebackups) API to view all backup sets for the instance, including backups of deleted instances.

Initiator.description_en: Request initiator. Leave blank for SDK-initiated requests; enter 'WEB' for requests from the frontend page

BackupPointName.description_en:
Set a backup name for the final backup of the instance to be deleted. If you want to set a backup name, make sure it meets all of the following requirements:

* Starts with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_)
* Length is 1–128 characters
* Can include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)

* This parameter is only effective for pay-as-you-go instances when you choose to create a full backup before deleting the instance (that is, when `CreateBackup` is set to `true`). For subscription instances, the final backup name created before deletion is the backup ID.
* If you do not set a backup name, the backup ID will be used as the default name.

ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter value, which must be unique across requests, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

CreateBackup.description_en:
Whether to create a full backup before deleting the instance. Valid values:

* `true` (default): Create a backup
* `false`: Do not create

* This parameter applies only to **Pay-As-You-Go** instances (where `ChargeType` is `PostPaid`). For Subscription instances (where `ChargeType` is `PrePaid`), a final backup must be created before deletion and this parameter cannot be set.
* You can call the [DescribeEnterpriseDBInstanceDetail](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/84772/1168033) API to query details of a specified instance, including instance type and billing type.

ParameterGroupId.description_en:
Parameter template ID.
* You can call the [DescribeParameterGroups](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/describeparametergroups) API to query basic information for all parameter templates under your account and region, including the parameter template ID.
* Only custom parameter templates (where `Source` is `User`) can be deleted; system parameter templates (where `Source` is `System`) cannot be deleted.
* Deleted templates cannot be restored. It is recommended to proceed with caution. For more details, see [Delete Parameter Template](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/delete-parameter-template).

AllowListId.description_en:
Allowlist ID
You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/describeallowlists) API to view all allowlists for your account in the specified region, including allowlist IDs

ProjectName.description_en: ProjectName is used for Project authentication processing and filtering

IPAddress.description_en:
Filter the whitelist that meets the criteria by IP address.
When you query with `IPAddress`, the system matches the exact IP address and any IP address ranges that include it.
* Leave this parameter blank to disable IP address filtering
* You can enter up to 50 IP addresses at once, separated by English commas (,)

IPSegment.description_en:
Filter the whitelist by IP address range
When you query with `IPSegment`, the filter precisely matches entries within the specified IP address range
* If you leave this parameter blank, the results are not filtered by IP address range
* You can enter up to 50 IP address ranges at once, separated by commas (,)

InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/describedbinstances) API to query basic information about all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.
* If you leave this parameter blank, the instance ID filter will not be applied.

ProjectName.description_en:
Whitelist Project Name
Leave this field blank to skip filtering by whitelist project name

QueryDefault.description_en:
Filter by whitelist type to determine whether to query only the default whitelist. Valid values:

* `true`: Yes, query only the default whitelist
* `false`: No, query only the regular whitelist

If this parameter is left empty, whitelist type filtering is not applied and information for all whitelist types is returned

RegionId.description_en:
Region ID
You can call the [DescribeRegions](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/describedbinstances) API to query all region information supported by Redis instances, including region IDs

InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID. After specifying, you can view the regions available for cross-region backup for this instance.
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/describedbinstances) API to view basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

BackupType.description_en:
Recovery mode. Available options:

* `Full` (default): Full recovery, restores from the backup set
* `Inc`: Incremental recovery, restores to a specific point in time

* To restore to a specific point in time (`BackupType` set to `Inc`), you must enable the data flashback feature first. For details, see [Restore to original instance by point in time](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/recovery-by-time-point#%E6%81%A2%E5%A4%8D%E5%88%B0%E5%8E%9F%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B).
* You can call the [StartContinuousBackup](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/redis/startcontinuousbackup) API to enable data flashback for a specified instance.

Backup ID of the target backup file
