* You must provide one of the parameters `CidrIp`, `SourceGroupId`, or `PrefixListId`. If multiple are provided, only one takes effect, with priority: `CidrIp` > `SourceGroupId` > `PrefixListId`.

Priority.description_en:
Security group rule priority. The smaller the number, the higher the priority.
Value range: 1 ~ 100.

Protocol.description_en:

* tcp: TCP protocol
* udp: UDP protocol
* icmp: ICMP protocol
* icmpv6: ICMPV6 protocol
* gre: GRE protocol
* all: Supports all protocols

SecurityGroupId.description_en:
Security group ID.

SourceGroupId.description_en:
Source address security group ID. All network interface addresses in this security group are used as source addresses.
You must provide one of the parameters `CidrIp`, `SourceGroupId`, or `PrefixListId`. If multiple are provided, only one takes effect, with priority: `CidrIp` > `SourceGroupId` > `PrefixListId`.

SourcePortEnd.description_en:
End value of the source port range.

* When `Protocol` is `tcp` or `udp`, the valid range is `1` ~ `65535`.
* When `Protocol` is `icmp`, `icmpv6`, or `all`, only `-1` is supported, which means no port restriction.

SourcePortStart.description_en:

* When `Protocol` is `icmp`, `icmpv6`, or `all`, only `-1` is supported, which means no port restriction.

Description.description_en:
Description of the subnet.

* Length limit: 0–255 characters.
* Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number. Can include English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。).

EnableIpv6.description_en:
Enable or disable IPv6. This parameter can be configured only if the VPC to which the subnet belongs has IPv6 enabled.
Enter the following enum values exactly as shown. Do not enter other values.

* true: Enable
* false: Disable. This value can be configured only if there are no cloud resources in the subnet with assigned IPv6 addresses.

IPv6 is currently in invite-only testing. Only accounts that have completed [Enterprise Verification](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6261/64937) can apply for a trial. To request a trial, contact your account manager.

Ipv6CidrBlock.description_en:
The last 8 bits of the subnet IPv6 CIDR block (the subnet mask is fixed at /64).

* Value range: 0–255. The mask is fixed at /64.
* This parameter can only be configured when EnableIpv6 is set to true.

After the VpcIpv6CidrBlock parameter is specified, this parameter will not take effect.

SubnetId.description_en:
ID of the subnet whose information is to be modified.
You can call the [DescribeSubnets](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeSubnets) API to query the subnet ID.

SubnetName.description_en:
Name of the subnet.

* Length limit: 1–128 characters.
* Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number. Can include period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-).

VpcIpv6CidrBlock.description_en:
Subnet IPv6 CIDR block. The mask is fixed at /64.
After this parameter is specified, the Ipv6CidrBlock parameter will not take effect.

Description.description_en:
Filter description

* Length must be between 0 and 255 characters
* Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number. Can include English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)

TrafficMirrorFilterId.description_en:
Filter ID.
You can call the [DescribeTrafficMirrorFilters](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeTrafficMirrorFilters) API to query the filter ID

TrafficMirrorFilterName.description_en:
Filter name

* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
* Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number; can include period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-)

Description.description_en:
Description of the filter rule.

* Length limit: 0–255 characters.
* Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number. Can include English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。).

DestinationCidrBlock.description_en: Destination CIDR block for traffic.

DestinationPortRange.description_en:
Destination port range for traffic.

* When `Protocol` is all or icmp:
   * This parameter is not required.
   * Default value is -1/-1, which means no port restriction.
* When `Protocol` is tcp or udp:
   * This parameter is required.
   * Value range: 1–65535.
   * Use a forward slash (/) to separate the start and end ports, such as 1/50, 80/80.

Policy.description_en:
Traffic mirroring policy. Valid values:

* accept: Allow. When the traffic from the mirror source matches this rule, the traffic is copied to the mirror target for monitoring and analysis.
* reject: Deny. When the traffic from the mirror source matches this rule, the traffic is not copied and is not monitored or analyzed.

Priority.description_en:
Priority of the filter rule, range: 1–1000.

* The smaller the value, the higher the priority. Default is 1; 1 is the highest priority.
* The priority must be unique for the same filter condition and direction.

Protocol.description_en:
Traffic protocol. Valid values:

* all: Includes TCP, UDP, and ICMP protocols.
* tcp: TCP protocol.
* udp: UDP protocol.
* icmp: ICMP protocol.

SourcePortRange.description_en:
Source port range for traffic.

* When `Protocol` is all or icmp:
   * This parameter is not required.
   * Default value is -1/-1, which means no port restriction.
* When `Protocol` is tcp or udp:
   * This parameter is required.
   * Value range: 1–65535.
   * Use a forward slash (/) to separate the start and end ports, such as 1/50, 80/80.

TrafficDirection.description_en:
Traffic direction. Valid values:

* ingress: Inbound.
* egress: Outbound.

TrafficMirrorFilterRuleId.description_en:
ID of the filter rule.
You can call the [DescribeTrafficMirrorFilters](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeTrafficMirrorFilters) API to query the filter rule ID within the filter condition.

Description.description_en:
Description of the traffic mirror session.

* Length limit: 0~255 characters
* Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number. Can contain English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)

PacketLength.description_en:
Packet size of the traffic mirror session. Minimum is 64 bytes. Recommended range: 64–1450 bytes. Default is 1500 bytes.
If the packet size is set ≤ the MTU value of the mirror source or > 1450, some packets will be truncated and the truncated content will be discarded. To ensure packets are not truncated, set the NIC MTU value as follows:
MTU of mirror source ≤ packet size set for the traffic mirror session ≤ MTU of mirror target - 50, and packet size set for the traffic mirror session ≤ 1450.

Priority.description_en:
Priority of the traffic mirror session. Value range: **1**~**32766**.

* The smaller the number, the higher the priority
* The priority of traffic mirror sessions created by the same account in the same region must not be duplicated

TrafficMirrorFilterId.description_en:
Filter condition ID.
You can call the [DescribeTrafficMirrorFilters](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeTrafficMirrorFilters) API to query the filter condition ID.

TrafficMirrorSessionId.description_en:
Traffic mirror session ID.
You can call the [DescribeTrafficMirrorSessions](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeTrafficMirrorSessions) API to query the session ID.

TrafficMirrorSessionName.description_en:
Name of the traffic mirror session.

* Length limit: 1 ~ 128 characters
* Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number. Can contain period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-)

TrafficMirrorTargetId.description_en:
Traffic mirror target ID.
You can call the [DescribeTrafficMirrorTargets](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeTrafficMirrorTargets) API to query the target ID.

VirtualNetworkId.description_en:
Traffic mirror session VNI. Used by the mirror target to distinguish traffic from different mirror sessions.

* Value range: **1**~**16777215**
* If not specified, a value is assigned randomly

Description.description_en:
Description of the traffic mirror target.

* Length limit: 0–255 characters
* Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number. Can include English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)

TrafficMirrorTargetId.description_en: Traffic mirror target ID.\nYou can call the [DescribeTrafficMirrorTargets](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeTrafficMirrorTargets) API to query the traffic mirror target ID.

TrafficMirrorTargetName.description_en:

DnsServers.N.description_en:
DnsServers for the VPC.

* Parameter - N: indicates the sequence number of the DNS server address. You can specify up to 5 addresses per request, and each DnsServer must be a valid IP address.
* Separate multiple IP addresses with &.

EnableIpv6.description_en:
Enable/disable IPv6.
Please enter the following values exactly as shown, do not use other values.

* true: Enable
* false: Disable. This option is only available when all subnets under the VPC have IPv6 disabled and the VPC is not associated with an IPv6 gateway.

Ipv6CidrBlock.description_en:
IPv6 CIDR block for the VPC.

* After this parameter is provided, the Ipv6MaskLen parameter will not take effect.
* If the Ipv6Isp parameter is set to anything other than BGP, you must provide either the Ipv6MaskLen or Ipv6CidrBlock parameter.
* If the Ipv6Isp parameter is not provided or set to BGP and this parameter is not provided, the system will automatically assign an IPv6 CIDR block.

Ipv6Isp.description_en:
Line type. Available values:

* BGP: BGP (multi-line)
* ChinaMobile: China Mobile static single line
* ChinaTelecom: China Telecom static single line
* ChinaUnicom: China Unicom static single line
* ChinaMobile_Value: China Mobile Value static single line
* ChinaUnicom_Value: China Unicom Value static single line
* ChinaTelecom_Value: China Telecom Value static single line

Except for BGP (multi-line), all other line types only support East China 2 (Shanghai) region.

Ipv6MaskLen.description_en:
IPv6 subnet mask length.

* When Ipv6Isp is set to BGP, only 56 is supported; otherwise, this parameter supports 62–64.
* After the parameter Ipv6CidrBlock is provided, this parameter is not effective.
* If Ipv6Isp is not BGP, either Ipv6MaskLen or Ipv6CidrBlock must be provided.

SpecificEgress.description_en:
Public network gateway.

* When `Ipv6Isp` is set to `BGP`, the values are:
   * KUL: Malaysia (Kuala Lumpur)
   * MNL: Philippines (Manila)
   * SGN: Vietnam (Ho Chi Minh City)
   * BKK: Thailand (Bangkok)
   * TPE: China (Taipei)
   * LAX: United States (Los Angeles)
   * MEX: Mexico (Mexico City)
   * LON: United Kingdom (London)
   * MAD: Spain (Madrid)
   * FRA: Germany (Frankfurt)
   * MRS: France (Marseille)
   * MIL: Italy (Milan)
   * TYO: Japan (Tokyo)
   * SEL: South Korea (Seoul)
* When `Ipv6Isp` is set to `ChinaMobile_Value` or `ChinaUnicom_Value`, the values are:
   * TJ: Tianjin
   * HNZZ: Zhengzhou
   * HBLF_bytedance: Langfang
   * HBHL_bytedance: Huailai
   * JSNJ: Nanjing
   * GDSZ: Shenzhen
* When `Ipv6Isp` is set to `ChinaTelecom_Value`, the values are:
   * TJ: Tianjin
   * HNZZ: Zhengzhou
   * HBLF_bytedance: Langfang
   * HBHL_bytedance: Huailai
   * JSNJ: Nanjing
   * GDFS: Foshan

> Langfang and Huailai public network gateways are currently in invitation testing. To apply for a trial, please contact your account manager.

Only ASCII characters are supported, with a maximum length of 64 characters. If you do not provide a ClientToken, this API call will not perform idempotency checks.

CidrIp.description_en:
Destination address IPv4 CIDR or IPv6 CIDR
You must provide one of the following parameters: `CidrIp`, `SourceGroupId`, or `PrefixListId`. If you provide more than one, only one will take effect. The priority is: `CidrIp` > `SourceGroupId` > `PrefixListId`.

Description.description_en: Description of the security group rule

LocalCidrIp.description_en: Destination IPv4 address range. Supports CIDR blocks and IPv4 addresses. Default value is empty

Policy.description_en:
Access policy. That is, the network interface in the security group accesses resources corresponding to `CidrIp`, `SourceGroupId`, or `PrefixListId`

* accept: Allow
* drop: Deny

PortEnd.description_en:
End value of the port range

* When `Protocol` is tcp or udp, the valid range is 1~65535
* When `Protocol` is icmp, icmpv6, or all, only -1 is supported, which means no port restriction

PortStart.description_en:
Start value of the port range

* When `Protocol` is tcp or udp, the valid range is 1~65535
* When `Protocol` is icmp, icmpv6, or all, only -1 is supported, which means no port restriction

PrefixListId.description_en:
ID of the destination address prefix list. All CIDRs in the prefix list are destination addresses
You can call the [DescribePrefixLists](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribePrefixLists) API to query the prefix list ID
* The number of outbound security group rules that can be added to the current security group must be no less than the maximum number of entries in the prefix list
* One of the parameters `CidrIp`, `SourceGroupId`, or `PrefixListId` must be provided. If multiple are provided, only one takes effect, with priority: `CidrIp` > `SourceGroupId` > `PrefixListId`

Priority.description_en:
Security group rule priority. The smaller the number, the higher the priority

* Value range: 1 ~ 100
* Default value is 1 if not specified
* If the priority of the rule to be deleted is not 1, this parameter must be provided

Protocol.description_en:
Protocol type. The values are:

* tcp: TCP protocol
* udp: UDP protocol
* icmp: ICMP protocol
* icmpv6: ICMPV6 protocol
* gre: GRE protocol
* all: Supports all protocols

SecurityGroupId.description_en:
Security group ID
You can call the [DescribeSecurityGroups](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeSecurityGroups) API to query the security group ID

SourceGroupId.description_en:
The destination security group ID, meaning all network interface addresses in this group are used as destination addresses.
You must specify one of the following parameters: `CidrIp`, `SourceGroupId`, or `PrefixListId`. If you specify more than one, only one will take effect in the following order of priority: `CidrIp` > `SourceGroupId` > `PrefixListId`.

SourcePortEnd.description_en:
End value of the source port range

* When `Protocol` is `tcp` or `udp`, the valid range is `1` ~ `65535`
* When `Protocol` is `icmp`, `icmpv6`, or `all`, only `-1` is supported, which means no port restriction

SourcePortStart.description_en:
Start value of the source port range, related to the transport layer protocol

* When the `Protocol` parameter is `tcp` or `udp`, the valid range is `1` ~ `65535`
* When the `Protocol` parameter is `icmp` or `all`, only `-1` is supported, which means no port restriction

CidrIp.description_en:
IPv4 CIDR or IPv6 CIDR of the source address
You must provide one of the parameters: `CidrIp`, `SourceGroupId`, or `PrefixListId`. If you provide more than one, only one will take effect. The priority is: `CidrIp` > `SourceGroupId` > `PrefixListId`.

Description.description_en: Description of the security group rule.

LocalCidrIp.description_en: Target IPv4 address range. Supports CIDR blocks and IPv4 addresses. Default value is empty.

Policy.description_en:
Access policy. That is, the network interface in the security group corresponding to `CidrIp`, `SourceGroupId`, or `PrefixListId`. Values:

* accept: Allow
* drop: Deny

PortEnd.description_en:
Port range end value.

* When `Protocol` is tcp or udp, the valid range is 1~65535.
* When `Protocol` is icmp, icmpv6, or all, only -1 is supported, indicating no port restriction.

PortStart.description_en:

* When `Protocol` is icmp, icmpv6, or all, only -1 is supported, indicating no port restriction.

PrefixListId.description_en:

You can call the [DescribePrefixLists](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribePrefixLists) API to query the prefix list ID.
* The number of inbound security group rules that can be added to the current security group must be no less than the maximum number of entries in the prefix list.

Priority.description_en:
Security group rule priority. The smaller the number, the higher the priority.

* Range: 1 ~ 100.

* If the priority of the rule to be deleted is not 1, this parameter must be provided.

Protocol.description_en:

* icmpv6: ICMPV6 protocol
* gre: GRE protocol
* all: Supports all protocols

SecurityGroupId.description_en:
Security group ID.
You can call the [DescribeSecurityGroups](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpc/DescribeSecurityGroups) API to query the security group ID.

SourceGroupId.description_en:
Source security group ID. All network interface addresses in this security group are used as source addresses.
You must specify one of the following parameters: `CidrIp`, `SourceGroupId`, or `PrefixListId`. If you specify more than one, only one takes effect in the following order of priority: `CidrIp` > `SourceGroupId` > `PrefixListId`.

SourcePortEnd.description_en:
Ending value of the source port range.

* When `Protocol` is `tcp` or `udp`, the valid range is `1` ~ `65535`.
* When `Protocol` is `icmp`, `icmpv6`, or `all`, only `-1` is supported, indicating no port restriction.

SourcePortStart.description_en:

* When `Protocol` is `icmp`, `icmpv6`, or `all`, only `-1` is supported, indicating no port restriction.

EgressAclEntries.N.Description.description_en:
Description for egress network ACL rules.

* Length limit: 0–255 characters
* Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number. Can include English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
* If not specified, defaults to an empty string

EgressAclEntries.N.DestinationCidrIp.description_en:
Subnet of the destination address for egress network ACL rules.
When the parameter `UpdateEgressAclEntries` is set to "true", this parameter must be provided.

EgressAclEntries.N.NetworkAclEntryId.description_en:
Outbound rule ID for the Network ACL.
If the current outbound rule ID is provided, the new rule will continue to use this ID.

EgressAclEntries.N.NetworkAclEntryName.description_en:
Name of the outbound rule for the Network ACL.

* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.
* Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number; can include period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-).
* If not specified, defaults to an empty string.

EgressAclEntries.N.Policy.description_en:
Authorization policy for egress network ACL rules. This determines whether resources within the subnet can access external resources. Possible values:

* accept (default): Allow access
* drop: Deny access

EgressAclEntries.N.Port.description_en:
Destination port range for the outbound rule of the Network ACL.

* When `IngressAclEntries.N.Protocol` is set to all, icmp, icmpv6, or gre:
   * This parameter is not required.
   * Default value is -1/-1, which means no port restriction.
* When `IngressAclEntries.N.Protocol` is set to tcp or udp:
   * This parameter is required.
   * Value range is 1–65535.
   * Use a forward slash (/) to separate the start and end ports, such as 1/50, 80/80.

EgressAclEntries.N.Protocol.description_en:
Protocol type for egress network ACL rules. Possible values:

* tcp: TCP protocol
* udp: UDP protocol
* icmp: ICMP protocol
* icmpv6: ICMPV6 protocol
* gre: GRE protocol
* all (default): Supports all protocols

IngressAclEntries.N.Description.description_en:
Description for ingress network ACL rules.

* Length limit: 0–255 characters
* Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number. Can include English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
* If not specified, defaults to an empty string

IngressAclEntries.N.NetworkAclEntryId.description_en:

* Separate multiple tag keys with &. Naming rules are as follows:
* Cannot start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
* Can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, and the following English symbols: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

Tag keys for the same resource must not be duplicated

Tags.N.Value.description_en:
User gateway tag value (Value).

* Parameter - N: indicates the tag value sequence number, valid range: 1–20.
* Multiple tag values are separated by &. Naming rules:
* Can only contain language characters, numbers, spaces, and the following English symbols: '_', '.', ':', '/', '=', '+', '-', '@'.
* Can be empty; length limit is 0–256 characters.
* Case sensitive; cannot start or end with a space.

If you provide `Tags.N.Value`, you must also provide `Tags.N.Key`.

ClientIpPool.description_en:

* Client subnet mask range: `/16`–`/28`.
* The client subnet cannot conflict with the `LocalSubnet` or IPSec connection routes.
* The client subnet cannot overlap with `100.64.0.0/10`, `169.254.0.0/16`, `127.0.0.0/8`, `224.0.0.0/4`, or `240.0.0.0/4`.
* The number of available IPs in the client subnet must be greater than four times the number of SSL connections selected when creating the VPN gateway. For example, if the SSL connection count is 10, the client subnet must have more than 40 available IPs.

DnsServerIpAddresses.N.description_en: DNS server IP. Supports up to two IPv4 addresses.

LocalSubnets.N.description_en:
Local subnet of the SSL server. The local subnet is the address range that the client accesses via the SSL VPN connection.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the SSL server subnet.
* Use `&` to separate multiple subnets.

You can specify up to **5** local subnets, and they must not conflict with the `ClientIpPool` subnet.

LogEnabled.description_en:
Enable SSL VPN connection logs. Possible values:

* true: enabled
* false: disabled

Port.description_en:
Port used by the SSL server. Default: 1194.

* Port range: 1 ~ 65535.
* The following ports are not supported: 22, 68, 179, 323, 500, 4500.

ProjectName.description_en: Project to which the SSL server belongs. If left blank, the default is `default`, meaning the created resource belongs to the default project.

Protocol.description_en:
Protocol used by the SSL server. Values:

* TCP (default): TCP protocol.
* UDP: UDP protocol.

SamlData.description_en:
SAML metadata from the identity provider. Must be provided in XML format and encoded with base64.
Required when SsoAuthEnabled is set to true.

SslVpnServerName.description_en:
Name of the SSL server to be created.

* Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or number, and can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-).
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.
* If left blank, the default is the SSL server ID.

SsoAuthEnabled.description_en:
Enable two-factor authentication. Possible values:

- true: enabled
- false (default): disabled

Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key (Key) for the SSL server tag.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, value range: 1–20.
* Use & to separate multiple tag keys.

Naming rules:

* Cannot start with any case combination of volc: or sys:.
* Can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, and the following English symbols: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@".
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.

> Note: Tag keys for the same resource must not be duplicated.

Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value (Value) for the SSL server.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, value range: 1–20.
* Use & to separate multiple tag values.

Naming rules:

* Only language characters, numbers, spaces, and the following English symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@".
* Can be empty, length must be between 0–256 characters.
* Case sensitive, cannot start or end with a space.

> Note: If you pass Tags.N.Value, you must also pass Tags.N.Key.

VpnGatewayId.description_en: ID of the VPN gateway used to create the SSL server. You can call [DescribeVpnGateways](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpn/DescribeVpnGateways) to query the VPN gateway ID information.

AttachType.description_en:
Resource type associated with the IPsec connection. Available values:

* VpnGateway (Default): VPN Gateway
* TransitRouter: Transit Router

BgpConfig.description_en:
Information about BGP configuration in an IPsec connection

The BgpConfig.EnableBgp parameter is required; all other parameters are optional

BgpConfig.EnableBgp: Enable BGP for the IPsec connection

BgpConfig.TunnelCidr: The subnet used for establishing BGP neighbor connections. This must be a /30 subnet within the 169.254.0.0/16 range

BgpConfig.LocalBgpIp: The local IP address used for BGP neighbor connections. This must be a host IP address within the specified BGP subnet

BgpConfig.EnableBgp.description_en:
Enable dynamic route propagation. Options:

* false (default): No, use static routing mode.
* true: Yes, use BGP routing mode.

BgpConfig.LocalBgpIp.description_en:
Local tunnel IP, which is the BGP address configured on the VPN Gateway

* Defaults to the first host address of `BgpConfig.TunnelCidr`
* This address must be an IP within the IPsec tunnel subnet
* If `BgpConfig.EnableBgp` is set to `true`, this parameter is required

BgpConfig.TunnelCidr.description_en:
Tunnel subnet, which is the CIDR address range where the local and peer IPs of the BGP session are located.

* This address range must be within the `169.254.0.0/16` subnet, with a mask length of `/30`, and must not be within the 169.254.255.0/24 subnet.
* If `BgpConfig.EnableBgp` is set to `true`, this parameter is required.

ClientToken.description_en:
Client token, used to ensure request idempotency.

* The client automatically generates a parameter value to ensure uniqueness across different requests, preventing repeated operations when the API call times out or a server internal error occurs and the client retries multiple times.
* Only ASCII characters are supported, and the length must not exceed 64 characters.
* If ClientToken is not provided, idempotency validation will not be performed for this API call.

CustomerGatewayId.description_en:
ID of the customer gateway associated with the IPsec connection. This parameter is required when creating a single-tunnel IPsec connection
If the IP address of the customer gateway is `0.0.0.0`, then `NegotiateInstantly` can only be set to **false**, `IkeConfig.Version` in `IkeConfig` can only be set to **ikev1**, and `IkeConfig.Mode` can only be set to **aggressive**. You can call [DescribeCustomerGateways](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpn/DescribeCustomerGateways) to query the customer gateway ID information

Description.description_en:
Description for the IPsec connection.

* Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or number; only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), space ( ), underscore (_), hyphen (-), equals sign (=), English comma (,), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。) are allowed
* Length must be between 0 and 255 characters
* If left blank, defaults to an empty string

DpdAction.description_en:
Status of the DPD feature. Options:

* none: Disable DPD
* clear (default): Enable DPD; clears IKE SA after DPD timeout
* hold: Enable DPD; keeps current state after DPD timeout, waits for new traffic to re-establish connection
* restart: Enable DPD; reconnects immediately after DPD timeout

EnableTunnelsBgp.description_en:
Enable BGP feature. Values:

* false (default): No, use static routing mode.
* true: Yes, use BGP routing mode.

ISP.description_en: The ISP of the vpn connection which attach type is TransitRouter.

IkeConfig.description_en:
IKE configuration information for IPsec connections.
The IkeConfig.Psk parameter is required; all other parameters are optional.

> Note: If the user gateway IP address associated with the IPsec connection is `0.0.0.0`, only **ikev1** can be set for `IkeConfig.Version` and only **aggressive** can be set for `IkeConfig.Mode`.

IkeConfig.Psk: Pre-shared key used for authentication between the VPN gateway and the user gateway during phase one. Maximum length is 100 characters. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and the following special characters are allowed: ~`|! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { }  \ , . / : ;

IkeConfig.Version: Version of the IKE key exchange protocol. Valid values:
ikev1 (default)
ikev2

> Note: The `IkeConfig.Mode` parameter is required only when `IkeConfig.Version` is set to **ikev1**.

IkeConfig.Mode: Negotiation mode for phase one. Valid values:
main (default)
aggressive

IkeConfig.EncAlg: Encryption algorithm for phase one negotiation. Valid values:
aes (default)
aes192
aes256
des
3des
sm4

IkeConfig.AuthAlg: Authentication algorithm for phase one. Valid values:
sha1 (default)
md5
sha256
sha384
sha512
sm3

IkeConfig.DhGroup: DH (Diffie-Hellman) key exchange algorithm for phase one negotiation. Valid values:
group1
group2 (default)
group5
group14

IkeConfig.Lifetime: SA lifetime for phase one negotiation. When the lifetime is exceeded, negotiation restarts.
Range: 1–86400 seconds
Default: 86400

IkeConfig.LocalId: Identifier for the VPN gateway used in phase one negotiation. Supports IP address or FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) formats. If not specified, defaults to the current VPN gateway's egress IP address.

If you manually set this to FQDN format, it is recommended to set the negotiation mode to 'aggressive'.

Maximum length is 100 characters. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and the following special characters are allowed: ~`|! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { }  \ , . / : ;

IkeConfig.RemoteId: Identifier for the user gateway used in phase one negotiation. Supports IP address or FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) formats. If not specified, defaults to the current user gateway's public IP address.

If you manually set this to FQDN format, it is recommended to set the negotiation mode to 'aggressive'.

Maximum length is 100 characters. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and the following special characters are allowed: ~`|! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { }  \ , . / : ;

IkeConfig.AuthAlg.description_en:
Authentication algorithm for IKE phase 1 in single-tunnel mode IPsec connections. Possible values:

* sha1 (default)
* md5
* sha256
* sha384
* sha512
* sm3

IkeConfig.DhGroup.description_en:
DH (Diffie-Hellman) key exchange algorithm used in the first phase of IKE negotiation for single-tunnel mode IPsec connections. Available values:

* group1
* group2 (Default)
* group5
* group14

IkeConfig.EncAlg.description_en:
Encryption algorithm used in the first phase of IKE negotiation for single-tunnel mode IPsec connections. Available values:

* aes (Default)
* aes192
* aes256
* des
* 3des
* sm4

IkeConfig.Lifetime.description_en: SA lifetime for IKE phase 1 negotiation in single tunnel mode IPsec connection. When the lifetime is exceeded, negotiation will be re-initiated. Value range: 900–86400, unit: seconds. Default: 86400.

IkeConfig.LocalId.description_en:
Identifier for the VPN gateway in single-tunnel mode IPsec connections, used for IKE phase one negotiation in single-tunnel mode. Supports IP format and FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) format.

* If not specified, defaults to the outbound IP address of the selected VPN gateway
* If you manually set it to FQDN format, it is recommended to set the negotiation mode to "aggressive"
* Maximum length is 100 characters; only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ; and numbers are allowed

IkeConfig.Mode.description_en:
Negotiation mode for IKE phase 1 in single-tunnel mode IPsec connections. This parameter is required only when IkeConfig.Version is **ikev1**. Possible values:

* main (default)
* aggressive

IkeConfig.Psk.description_en:
Pre-shared key for IKE in single-tunnel mode IPsec connections, used for identity authentication between the VPN Gateway and the customer gateway in the first phase

* Maximum length is 100 characters
* Only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ;, and numbers are supported

IkeConfig.RemoteId.description_en:
Identifier for the user gateway in single-tunnel mode IPsec connections, used for IKE phase 1 negotiation in single-tunnel mode IPsec connections. Supports IP format and FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) formats.

* If not specified, defaults to the public IP address of the currently selected user gateway.
* If you manually set it to FQDN format, it is recommended to set the negotiation mode to "aggressive".
* Maximum length is 100 characters; only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ; and numbers are allowed.

IkeConfig.Version.description_en:
IKE key exchange protocol version for single tunnel mode IPsec connections. Available values:

* ikev1
* ikev2 (default)

IpsecConfig.description_en:
IPsec configuration information for an IPsec connection includes the following parameters:

IpsecConfig.EncAlg: Encryption algorithm for phase 2 negotiation. Options:
- aes (default)
- aes192
- aes256
- des
- 3des
- sm4

IpsecConfig.AuthAlg: Authentication algorithm for phase 2 negotiation. Options:
- sha1 (default)
- md5
- sha256
- sha384
- sha512
- sm3

IpsecConfig.DhGroup: DH (Diffie-Hellman) key exchange algorithm used in phase 2. Options:
- group1
- group2 (default)
- group5
- group14
- disable (DH algorithm not configured)

> If you select group1, group2, group5, or group14, Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS) is enabled by default. The corresponding client must also enable PFS. If the client does not support PFS, set this option to 'disable'.

IpsecConfig.Lifetime: SA lifetime for phase 2 negotiation. When the lifetime expires, negotiation restarts.
Range: 1–86400
Unit: seconds
Default: 86400

IpsecConfig.AuthAlg.description_en:
Authentication algorithm negotiated in IKE phase 2 for single tunnel mode IPsec connections. Available values:

* sha1 (default)
* md5
* sha256
* sha384
* sha512
* sm3

IpsecConfig.DhGroup.description_en:
DH (Diffie-Hellman) key exchange algorithm used in IKE phase 2 for single tunnel mode IPsec connections. Available values:

* group1
* group2 (default)
* group5
* group14
* disable (do not configure DH algorithm)

> If you select group1, group2, group5, or group14, PFS (Perfect Forward Secrecy) will be enabled by default. The corresponding client must also enable PFS. If the client does not support PFS, set this option to "disable".

IpsecConfig.EncAlg.description_en:
Encryption algorithm for IKE phase 2 negotiation in single tunnel mode IPsec connections. Options:

* aes (default)
* aes192
* aes256
* des
* 3des
* sm4

IpsecConfig.Lifetime.description_en: Lifetime of the SA negotiated in IKE phase 2 of single tunnel mode IPsec connections. After the lifetime expires, negotiation will restart. Range: 900–86400 seconds. Default: 86400.

LocalSubnet.N.description_en:
Local network segment(s) for the IPsec connection.

* Parameter - N indicates the sequence number of the local network segment
* Up to 5 segments supported
* Separate multiple segments with &

LogEnabled.description_en:
Enable connection logs. After enabling connection logs, you can view and download IPsec connection logs, and troubleshoot IPsec connection issues using the log information. Values:

* true: Enable
* false: Disable

Before enabling connection logs, please ensure your account has activated log service and object storage service, and has authorized VPN connection service to access log service across services.

NatTraversal.description_en:
Whether to enable NAT traversal. Options:

* true: Enable. When NAT traversal (NAT Traversal) is enabled, IKE negotiation does not verify UDP port numbers and can detect NAT gateway devices in the VPN tunnel
* false (default): Disable

NegotiateInstantly.description_en:
Enable immediate negotiation mode. Values:

* true: The system actively initiates negotiation immediately after IPsec connection configuration is completed.
* false (default): The system does not actively initiate negotiation after IPsec connection configuration is completed; negotiation is initiated passively when there is traffic.

If the user gateway IP address entered is 0.0.0.0, only **false** can be entered here.

ProjectName.description_en: Project to which the IPsec connection belongs. If not specified, defaults to "default", meaning the created resource belongs to the default project. You can call [ListProjects](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/6649/1131880) to query project information under your current account.

RemoteSubnet.N.description_en:
Peer subnet of the IPsec connection.

* Parameter - N indicates the sequence number of the peer subnet.
* Up to 5 subnets are supported.
* Separate multiple subnets with &.

Spec.description_en:
IPsec connection instance specifications. Available values:

* default (Default): Default specification, bandwidth limit is 200 Mbps
* large: Large specification, bandwidth limit is 1 Gbps
* xlarge: Extra large specification, bandwidth limit is 3 Gbps

* Large and extra large specifications are currently in invitation-only testing. They can only be used after activation. To request a trial, please contact your account manager
* Only IPsec connections associated with TR instances are effective. IPsec connections associated with VPN Gateway instances are not valid. This parameter takes effect only when AttachType is set to TransitRouter

Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key (Key) for the IPsec connection.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, range: 1–20
* Separate multiple tag keys with &. Naming rules:
* Cannot start with any case combination of volc: or sys:
* Can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, and English symbols "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

Tag keys for the same resource must not be duplicated

Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value (Value) for the IPsec connection.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, range: 1–20
* Separate multiple tag values with &. Naming rules:
* Can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, and English symbols "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
* Can be empty; length must be between 0 and 256 characters
* Case sensitive; cannot start or end with a space

If Tags.N.Value is provided, Tags.N.Key must also be provided

TunnelOptions.N.BGPConfig.LocalBgpIp.description_en:
BGP address on the BytePlus side

- Defaults to the first host address of `TunnelOptions.N.BGPConfig.TunnelCidr`
- This address must be an IP address within the IPsec tunnel subnet
- If `EnableTunnelsBgp` is set to `true`, this parameter is required

TunnelOptions.N.BGPConfig.TunnelCidr.description_en:
CIDR address range containing the local and peer IPs for the BGP session.

* The address range must be within 169.254.0.0/16, with a subnet mask length of 30.
* If EnableTunnelsBgp is set to true, this parameter must be specified.

TunnelOptions.N.CustomerGatewayId.description_en:
ID of the user gateway associated with the tunnel. If the IP address of the user gateway provided is 0.0.0.0, NegotiateInstantly can only be set to **false**, IkeConfig.Version can only be set to **ikev1**, and IkeConfig.Mode can only be set to **aggressive**
This parameter is required when creating a dual-tunnel type IPsec connection

TunnelOptions.N.DpdAction.description_en:
Status of the DPD feature. Options:

* none: Disable DPD
* clear (default): Enable DPD; clears IKE SA after DPD timeout
* hold: Enable DPD; keeps current state after DPD timeout, waits for new traffic to re-establish connection
* restart: Enable DPD; reconnects immediately after DPD timeout

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.AuthAlg.description_en:
Authentication algorithm for IKE phase 2 negotiation in dual tunnel mode IPsec connections. Options:

* sha1 (default)
* md5
* sha256
* sha384
* sha512
* sm3

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.DhGroup.description_en:
DH (Diffie-Hellman) key exchange algorithm used in phase two of IKE for dual-tunnel mode IPsec connection. Options:

* group1
* group2 (default)
* group5
* group14
* disable (do not configure DH algorithm)

> If group1, group2, group5, or group14 is selected, PFS (Perfect Forward Secrecy) is enabled by default, and the corresponding client must also enable PFS. If the client does not support PFS, set this to "disable"

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.EncAlg.description_en:
Encryption algorithm used in the first phase of IKE negotiation for dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections. Available values:

* aes (Default)
* aes192
* aes256
* des
* 3des
* sm4

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.Lifetime.description_en: Lifetime of the SA negotiated in the second phase of IKE for dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections. When the lifetime is exceeded, negotiation will restart. Value range: 900–86400 seconds. Default: 86400

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.LocalId.description_en:
Identifier for the IKE VPN gateway in dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections, used for IKE phase one negotiation in dual-tunnel mode. Supports IP format and FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) format.

* If not specified, defaults to the outbound IP address of the selected VPN gateway
* If you manually set it to FQDN format, it is recommended to set the negotiation mode to "aggressive"
* Maximum length is 100 characters; only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ; and numbers are allowed

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.Mode.description_en:
Negotiation mode for the first phase of IKE in dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections. This parameter is required only when IkeConfig.Version is **ikev1**. Available values:

* main (Default)
* aggressive

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.Psk.description_en:
Pre-shared key for IKE in dual-tunnel mode IPsec connection, used for identity authentication between the VPN gateway and user gateway in phase one.

* Maximum length is 100 characters
* Only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ;, and numbers are supported

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.RemoteId.description_en:
Identifier for the user gateway in dual tunnel mode IPsec connections, used for IKE phase 1 negotiation in dual tunnel mode IPsec connections. Supports IP format and FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) format.

* If not specified, defaults to the public IP address of the currently selected user gateway.
* If you manually set it to FQDN format, it is recommended to set the negotiation mode to "aggressive".
* Maximum length is 100 characters. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ;, and numbers are allowed.

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.Version.description_en:
Version of the IKE key exchange protocol in dual tunnel mode IPsec connections. Options:

* ikev1
* ikev2 (default)

TunnelOptions.N.IpsecConfig.AuthAlg.description_en:
Authentication algorithm for IKE phase 2 negotiation in dual tunnel mode IPsec connections. Options:

* sha1 (default)
* md5
* sha256
* sha384
* sha512
* sm3

TunnelOptions.N.IpsecConfig.DhGroup.description_en:
DH (Diffie-Hellman) key exchange algorithm used in phase two of IKE for dual-tunnel mode IPsec connection. Options:

* group1
* group2 (default)
* group5
* group14
* disable (do not configure DH algorithm)

> If group1, group2, group5, or group14 is selected, PFS (Perfect Forward Secrecy) is enabled by default, and the corresponding client must also enable PFS. If the client does not support PFS, set this to "disable"

TunnelOptions.N.IpsecConfig.EncAlg.description_en:
Encryption algorithm for IKE phase 2 negotiation in dual tunnel mode IPsec connections. Options:

* aes (default)
* aes192
* aes256
* des
* 3des
* sm4

TunnelOptions.N.IpsecConfig.Lifetime.description_en: Lifetime of the SA negotiated in the second phase of IKE for dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections. When the lifetime is exceeded, negotiation will restart. Value range: 900–86400 seconds. Default: 86400

TunnelOptions.N.NatTraversal.description_en:
Whether to enable NAT traversal. Options:

* true: Enable. When NAT traversal (NAT Traversal) is enabled, IKE negotiation does not verify UDP port numbers and can detect NAT gateway devices in the VPN tunnel
* false (default): Disable

TunnelOptions.N.Role.description_en:
Role of the tunnel. Possible values:

* primary: Indicates the current tunnel is the primary tunnel.
* secondary: Indicates the current tunnel is the backup tunnel.

This parameter is required when creating a dual-tunnel IPsec connection.

VpnConnectionName.description_en:
Name of the IPsec connection.

* Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or number, and can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
* If left blank, defaults to the IPsec connection ID

VpnGatewayId.description_en:
ID of the VPN gateway associated with the IPsec connection. You can call [DescribeVpnGateways](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpn/DescribeVpnGateways) to query the VPN gateway ID.
If AttachType is not specified or set to VpnGateway, this parameter is required. If AttachType is set to TransitRouter, this parameter is not required.

ZoneId.description_en: The zone id of the vpn connection which attach type is TransitRouter.

ClientToken.description_en:
Client token, used to ensure request idempotency.

* The client automatically generates a parameter value to ensure uniqueness between different requests, preventing repeated operations when the API call times out or there is a server error and the client retries multiple times.
* Only ASCII characters are supported, and the value cannot exceed 64 characters.
* If ClientToken is not provided, this API call will not perform idempotency validation.

HealthCheckConfigs.N.CheckInterval.description_en:
Interval for performing health checks.

* Parameter - N - Parameter: Indicates the sequence number of the interval in the health check.
* Use `&` to separate multiple intervals.
* Value range: 1 to 300, default: 3, unit: seconds.

HealthCheckConfigs.N.DownTime.description_en:
Unhealthy threshold for health checks.

* Parameter - N - Parameter: Indicates the sequence number of the unhealthy threshold in the health check.
* Use `&` to separate multiple unhealthy thresholds.
* Value range: 1 to 10, default: 3, unit: times.

HealthCheckConfigs.N.LocalIp.description_en:
Source IP for health checks. The source IP refers to the IP address on the local VPC side that can be accessed from the local data center or peer VPC via IPsec connection.

* Parameter - N - Parameter: Indicates the sequence number of the source IP in the health check.
* Use `&` to separate multiple source IPs.
* IPs in the `169.254.0.0/16`, `224.0.0.0/3`, or `127.0.0.0/8` ranges are not supported.
* If multiple IPsec connections under the same VPN gateway need to enable health checks, please use different source IPs to distinguish them.

HealthCheckConfigs.N.RemoteIp.description_en:
Destination IP for health checks. The destination IP is the IP address of the peer data center or peer VPC that can be accessed from the local VPC via IPsec connection.

* Parameter - N - Parameter: Indicates the sequence number of the destination IP in the health check.
* Use `&` to separate multiple destination IPs.
* The destination IP cannot be the same as the source IP, and IPs in the `169.254.0.0/16`, `224.0.0.0/3`, or `127.0.0.0/8` ranges are not supported.

HealthCheckConfigs.N.Timeout.description_en:
Response timeout for health checks.

* Parameter - N - Parameter: Indicates the sequence number of the response timeout in the health check.
* Use `&` to separate multiple response timeouts.
* Value range: 1 to 300, and must be less than the value of `CheckInterval`. Default: 1, unit: seconds.
* Response timeout cannot be greater than the probe interval.

HealthCheckConfigs.N.UpTime.description_en:
Health threshold for health checks.

* Parameter - N - Parameter: Indicates the sequence number of the health threshold in the health check.
* Use `&` to separate multiple health thresholds.
* Value range: 1 to 10, default: 3, unit: times.

Asn.description_en:
VPN gateway ASN.

* Required if BGP functionality is needed
* Valid range for VPN gateway ASN: 64512~65534, 4200000000~4294967294

Bandwidth.description_en:
Outbound bandwidth specification for the VPN gateway, unit: Mbps. Values: 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 1000, 3000.
1000Mbps and 3000Mbps bandwidth specifications for VPN gateways are invite-only features. Only users who have enabled these specifications can use them. If you have not enabled this specification, please avoid passing `Bandwidth`. If needed, contact your account manager.

BillingType.description_en:
VPN gateway billing type. Default is "1".

* 1 (default): Subscription
* 2: Pay-as-you-go (fixed configuration)

ClientToken.description_en:
Client token, used to ensure request idempotency.

* The client automatically generates a parameter value to ensure uniqueness between different requests, preventing repeated operations when the API call times out or there is a server error and the client retries multiple times.
* Only ASCII characters are supported, and the value cannot exceed 64 characters.
* If ClientToken is not provided, this API call will not perform idempotency checks.

Description.description_en:
VPN gateway description.

* Must start with Chinese, letter, or number. Only Chinese, letters, numbers, period (.), space ( ), underscore (_), hyphen (-), equals sign (=), English comma (,), Chinese comma (，), Chinese period (。) are allowed
* Length limit: 0 ~ 255 characters
* If not specified, defaults to an empty string

DualTunnelEnabled.description_en:
Enable dual tunnel mode

* true: enabled
* false (default): disabled

* Dual tunnel mode is in invitation testing. To try, contact your account manager
* DualTunnelEnabled and SslEnabled cannot both be set to true
* If BGP functionality is enabled, this parameter cannot be set to true

ISP.description_en: The ISP of the VPN gateway.

IpStackType.description_en:
Protocol type of the VPN gateway. Possible values are:

* `ipv4_only`: IPv4 protocol type
* `ipv6_only`: IPv6 protocol type
* `ipv4_ipv6`: Dual-stack protocol type

* Length: 0–255 characters
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration

DnsDomain.description_en: DNS resolution domain. Only takes effect when the DnsServerIpAddresses parameter is specified.

DnsServerIpAddresses.N.description_en: DNS server IP. You can specify up to two IPv4 addresses.

LocalSubnets.N.description_en:
Local subnet.

* Recommended local subnet mask: `/8` to `/32`
* The local subnet must not conflict with the client subnet
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration

LogEnabled.description_en:
Whether to enable SSL VPN connection logging. Values:

* true: Enable
* false: Disable

Port.description_en:
Port used by the SSL server. Default: 1194.

* Port range: 1–65535
* The following ports are not supported: 22, 68, 179, 323, 500, 4500
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration

Protocol.description_en:
Protocol used by the SSL server. Valid values:

* **TCP**: TCP protocol
* **UDP**: UDP protocol
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration

SamlData.description_en:
SAML metadata from the identity provider. Must be provided in XML format and encoded with base64.
Required when SsoAuthEnabled is set to true.

SslVpnServerId.description_en: ID of the SSL server to be modified. You can call [DescribeSslVpnServers](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpn/DescribeSslVpnServers) to query the SSL server ID information.

SslVpnServerName.description_en:
Name of the SSL server.

* Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or number; can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-)
* Length: 1–128 characters
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration

SsoAuthEnabled.description_en:
Enable two-factor authentication. Valid values:

- true: Enable
- false (default): Disable

BgpConfig.description_en:
BGP configuration information for IPsec connections

The BgpConfig.EnableBgp parameter is required; all other parameters are optional

BgpConfig.EnableBgp: Specifies whether to enable BGP for the IPsec connection

BgpConfig.TunnelCidr: Subnet address used to establish BGP neighbor relationships. The subnet must be a /30 subnet within 169.254.0.0/16

BgpConfig.LocalBgpIp: Local address used to establish BGP neighbor relationships. This must be a host IP address within the BGP subnet

BgpConfig.EnableBgp.description_en:
Whether to enable dynamic route propagation.

* false (default): No, use static routing mode.
* true: Yes, use BGP routing mode.
* Leave blank to keep the original configuration.

BgpConfig.LocalBgpIp.description_en:
Local tunnel IP, which is the BGP address configured on the VPN gateway

* Defaults to the first host address of `BgpConfig.TunnelCidr`.
* This address must be an IP address within the IPsec tunnel segment.
* If `BgpConfig.EnableBgp` is set to `true`, this parameter is required.
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration.

BgpConfig.TunnelCidr.description_en:
Tunnel subnet, which is the CIDR subnet containing the local and peer IPs for the BGP session.

* The subnet must be within `169.254.0.0/16`, have a subnet mask length of `/30`, and must not be within the `169.254.255.0/24` subnet.
* If `BgpConfig.EnableBgp` is set to `true`, this parameter is required.
* Leave blank to keep the existing configuration.

CustomerGatewayId.description_en: ID of the user gateway associated with the IPsec connection. You can call [DescribeCustomerGateways](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpn/DescribeCustomerGateways) to query the user gateway ID. Leave blank to keep the current configuration

Description.description_en:
Description of the IPsec connection.

* Must start with a Chinese character, English letter, or number; can only contain Chinese characters, English letters, numbers, period (.), space ( ), underscore (_), hyphen (-), equals sign (=), English comma (,), Chinese comma (，), Chinese period (。).
* Length limit: 0 ~ 255 characters.

DpdAction.description_en:
Status of the DPD feature.

* none: Disable DPD
* clear (default): Enable DPD. If DPD times out, clear IKE SA
* hold: Enable DPD. If DPD times out, keep the current state and re-establish the connection when new traffic arrives
* restart: Enable DPD. If DPD times out, reconnect immediately

EnableTunnelsBgp.description_en:
Whether to enable BGP functionality. Available values:

* false: No, use static routing mode.
* true: Yes, use BGP routing mode.

IkeConfig.description_en:
IKE configuration information for the IPsec connection. Parameters left blank will retain their current settings. Includes the following parameters:

> Note: If the user gateway IP address associated with the IPsec connection is `0.0.0.0`, only **ikev1** is allowed for `IkeConfig.Version` and only **aggressive** is allowed for `IkeConfig.Mode`.

IkeConfig.Psk: Pre-shared key used for authentication between the VPN gateway and the user gateway during phase one. Maximum length is 100 characters. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, special characters ~`|! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { }  \ , . / : ;, and numbers are allowed.

IkeConfig.Version: Version of the IKE key exchange protocol. Valid values:
ikev1
ikev2

IkeConfig.Mode: Negotiation mode for phase one. Valid values:
main
aggressive

> This parameter is required only when `IkeConfig.Version` is **ikev1**.

IkeConfig.EncAlg: Encryption algorithm for phase one negotiation. Valid values:
aes
aes192
aes256
des
3des
sm4

IkeConfig.AuthAlg: Authentication algorithm for phase one. Valid values:
sha1
md5
sha256
sha384
sha512
sm3

IkeConfig.DhGroup: DH (Diffie-Hellman) key exchange algorithm for phase one negotiation. Valid values:
group1
group2
group5
group14

IkeConfig.Lifetime: SA lifetime for phase one negotiation. When the lifetime is exceeded, negotiation restarts. Range: 1–86400 seconds.

IkeConfig.AuthAlg.description_en:
Authentication algorithm for IKE phase 1 in single tunnel mode IPsec connection. Options:

* sha1
* md5
* sha256
* sha384
* sha512
* sm3

IkeConfig.DhGroup.description_en:
DH (Diffie-Hellman) key exchange algorithm used for IKE phase 1 negotiation in single-tunnel mode IPsec connection. Options:

* group1
* group2
* group5
* group14

IkeConfig.EncAlg.description_en:
Encryption algorithm for IKE phase 1 negotiation in single-tunnel mode IPsec connections. Available values:

* aes
* aes192
* aes256
* des
* 3des
* sm4

IkeConfig.Lifetime.description_en: SA lifetime for IKE phase 1 negotiation in single-tunnel mode IPsec connection. After the lifetime expires, negotiation will restart. Value range: 900~86400, unit: seconds.

IkeConfig.LocalId.description_en:
VPN gateway identifier in single-tunnel mode IPsec connection, used for phase 1 negotiation. Supports IP format and FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) format.

* If you manually set to FQDN format, it is recommended to set the negotiation mode to 'aggressive'.
* Maximum length is 100 characters. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ;, and numbers are allowed.

IkeConfig.Mode.description_en:
Negotiation mode for phase one of IKE in single-tunnel mode IPsec connections. This parameter is required only when `IkeConfig.Version` is **ikev1**. Available values:

* main
* aggressive

If the user gateway IP address is `0.0.0.0`, only `aggressive` can be set for `IkeConfig.Mode`.

IkeConfig.Psk.description_en:
Pre-shared key for IKE in single tunnel mode IPsec connection, used for identity authentication between the VPN gateway and user gateway during the first phase.

* Maximum length: 100 characters.
* Only supports uppercase and lowercase English letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ; and numbers.

IkeConfig.RemoteId.description_en:
User gateway identifier in single-tunnel mode IPsec connection, used for phase 1 negotiation. Supports IP format and FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) format.

* If you manually set to FQDN format, it is recommended to set the negotiation mode to 'aggressive'.
* Maximum length is 100 characters. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ;, and numbers are allowed.

IkeConfig.Version.description_en:
Version of the IKE key exchange protocol in single-tunnel mode IPsec connection. Options:

* ikev1
* ikev2

If the user gateway IP address is `0.0.0.0`, only **`ikev1`** can be set for `IkeConfig.Version`.

IpsecConfig.description_en:
IPsec configuration settings for the IPsec connection. Parameters left blank will keep their current values. Includes the following parameters:

IpsecConfig.EncAlg: Encryption algorithm for phase 2 negotiation. Options:
aes
aes192
aes256
des
3des
sm4

IpsecConfig.AuthAlg: Authentication algorithm for phase 2 negotiation. Options:
sha1
md5
sha256
sha384
sha512
sm3

IpsecConfig.DhGroup: DH (Diffie-Hellman) key exchange algorithm for phase 2. Options:
group1
group2
group5
group14
disable (do not configure DH algorithm)

> If you select group1, group2, group5, or group14, Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS) is enabled by default. The client must also enable PFS. If the client does not support PFS, set this parameter to 'disable'.

IpsecConfig.Lifetime: SA lifetime for phase 2 negotiation. After this period, negotiation restarts.
Range: 1–86400
Unit: seconds

IpsecConfig.AuthAlg.description_en:
Authentication algorithm for IKE phase 2 negotiation in single tunnel mode IPsec connection. Available values:

* sha1
* md5
* sha256
* sha384
* sha512
* sm3

IpsecConfig.DhGroup.description_en:
DH (Diffie-Hellman) key exchange algorithm used in the second phase of IKE for single-tunnel mode IPsec connections. Available values:

* group1
* group2
* group5
* group14
* disable (do not configure DH algorithm)

> If you select group1, group2, group5, or group14, PFS (Perfect Forward Secrecy) will be enabled by default. The corresponding client must also enable PFS. If the client does not support PFS, set this option to "disable".

IpsecConfig.EncAlg.description_en:
Encryption algorithm for IKE phase 2 negotiation in single-tunnel mode IPsec connection. Options:

* aes
* aes192
* aes256
* des
* 3des
* sm4

IpsecConfig.Lifetime.description_en:
Lifetime of the SA for IKE phase 2 negotiation in single tunnel mode IPsec connection. When the lifetime is exceeded, the system will re-initiate negotiation.

* Value range: 900~86400
* Unit: seconds.

LocalSubnet.N.description_en:
Local subnet of the IPsec connection.

* Parameter - N indicates the sequence number of the local subnet.
* Up to 5 subnets are supported.
* Separate multiple subnets with &.
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration

LogEnabled.description_en:
Enable connection logs. After enabling connection logs, you can view and download IPsec connection logs, and use the log information to troubleshoot IPsec connection issues on your own.

* true: Enable
* false: Disable
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration

Before enabling connection logs, make sure your account has activated the log service and object storage service, and has authorized VPN connection service to access the log service across services.

NatTraversal.description_en:
Enable NAT traversal.

* true: Enable
* false: Disable
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration

NegotiateInstantly.description_en:
Whether to immediately initiate negotiation mode.

* true: The system will actively initiate negotiation as soon as the IPsec connection configuration is completed.
* false: The system will not actively initiate negotiation after the IPsec connection configuration is completed; negotiation will be initiated passively when traffic passes through.
* Leave blank to keep the original configuration.

If the user gateway IP address associated with the IPsec connection is `0.0.0.0`, only **false** can be entered here.

RemoteSubnet.N.description_en:
Peer network segment of the IPsec connection.

* Parameter - N indicates the sequence number of the peer network segment.
* Supports up to 5 network segments.
* Separate multiple segments with &.

Spec.description_en:
IPsec connection instance specification. Only IPsec associated with TR instances takes effect; IPsec associated with VPN gateway instances is invalid. Leave blank to keep the default configuration.

* default: Default specification, bandwidth up to 200 Mbps.
* large: Large specification, bandwidth up to 1 Gbps.
* xlarge: Extra large specification, bandwidth up to 3 Gbps.

Large and extra large specifications are currently in invitation-only testing. They are available only after activation. To request a trial, contact your account manager.

TunnelOptions.N.BGPConfig.LocalBgpIP.description_en:
BGP address on the BytePlus side.

* This address must be an IP address within the IPsec tunnel subnet.
* If EnableTunnelsBgp is set to true, this parameter is required.

TunnelOptions.N.BGPConfig.LocalBgpIp.description_en:
BGP address on the BytePlus side
- Defaults to the first host address of TunnelOptions.N.BGPConfig.TunnelCidr
- This address must be an IP within the IPsec tunnel subnet
- If EnableTunnelsBgp is set to true, this parameter is required

TunnelOptions.N.BGPConfig.TunnelCidr.description_en:
CIDR subnet containing the local and peer IPs for the BGP session.

* The subnet must be within 169.254.0.0/16 with a subnet mask length of 30.
* If EnableTunnelsBgp is set to true, this parameter is required.

TunnelOptions.N.CustomerGatewayId.description_en:
ID of the user gateway associated with the dual tunnel. If the user gateway IP address is 0.0.0.0, only **false** can be set for NegotiateInstantly, only **ikev1** can be set for IkeConfig.Version, and only **aggressive** can be set for IkeConfig.Mode.
This parameter is required when creating a dual tunnel type IPsec connection.

TunnelOptions.N.DpdAction.description_en:
DPD function status.

* none: DPD function disabled.
* clear: DPD function enabled; clears IKE SA after DPD timeout.
* hold: DPD function enabled; keeps current state after DPD timeout and re-establishes connection when new traffic arrives.
* restart: DPD function enabled; reconnects immediately after DPD timeout.

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.AuthAlg.description_en:
Authentication algorithm for IKE phase 1 in dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections. Available values:

* sha1
* md5
* sha256
* sha384
* sha512
* sm3

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.DhGroup.description_en:
DH (Diffie-Hellman) key exchange algorithm used in IKE phase 1 negotiation for dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections. Available values:

* group1
* group2
* group5
* group14

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.EncAlg.description_en:
Encryption algorithm for IKE phase 1 negotiation in dual tunnel mode IPsec connection. Options:

* aes
* aes192
* aes256
* des
* 3des
* sm4

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.Lifetime.description_en: Lifetime of the SA negotiated in IKE phase 1 for dual tunnel mode IPsec connection. After the lifetime expires, negotiation will restart. Value range: 900~86400, unit: seconds.

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.LocalId.description_en:
Identifier of the VPN gateway in dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections, used for phase 1 negotiation. Supports IP format and FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) format.

* If you manually set FQDN format, it is recommended to set the negotiation mode to "aggressive"
* Maximum length is 100 characters; only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ;, and numbers are allowed.

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.Mode.description_en:
Negotiation mode for IKE phase 1 in dual tunnel mode IPsec connection. This parameter is required only when `IkeConfig.Version` is **ikev1**. Options:

* main
* aggressive

If the user gateway IP address is `0.0.0.0`, only `aggressive` can be set for `IkeConfig.Mode`.

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.Psk.description_en: Pre-shared key for IKE in dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections, used for identity authentication between the VPN gateway and the user gateway in phase 1. Maximum length is 100 characters; only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ;, and numbers are allowed.

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.RemoteId.description_en:
User gateway identifier in dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections, used for phase one negotiation. Supports IP format and FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) format.

* If you manually set it to FQDN format, it is recommended to set the negotiation mode to "aggressive".
* Maximum length is 100 characters. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ;, and numbers are allowed.

TunnelOptions.N.IkeConfig.Version.description_en:
Version of the IKE key exchange protocol in dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections. Available values:

* ikev1
* ikev2

If the user gateway IP address is `0.0.0.0`, only **`ikev1`** can be set for `IkeConfig.Version`.

TunnelOptions.N.IpsecConfig.AuthAlg.description_en:
Authentication algorithm for IKE phase 2 negotiation in dual-tunnel mode IPsec connection. Options:

* sha1
* md5
* sha256
* sha384
* sha512
* sm3

TunnelOptions.N.IpsecConfig.DhGroup.description_en:
DH (Diffie-Hellman) key exchange algorithm used in the second phase of IKE for dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections. Available values:

* group1
* group2
* group5
* group14
* disable (do not configure DH algorithm)

> If you select group1, group2, group5, or group14, PFS (Perfect Forward Secrecy) will be enabled by default. The corresponding client must also enable PFS. If the client does not support PFS, set this option to "disable".

TunnelOptions.N.IpsecConfig.EncAlg.description_en:
Encryption algorithm for IKE phase 2 negotiation in dual-tunnel mode IPsec connection. Options:

* aes
* aes192
* aes256
* des
* 3des
* sm4

TunnelOptions.N.IpsecConfig.Lifetime.description_en: Lifetime of the SA negotiated in IKE phase 2 for dual-tunnel mode IPsec connections. After the lifetime expires, negotiation will restart. Value range: 900–86400 seconds. Default: 86400.

TunnelOptions.N.NatTraversal.description_en:
Enable NAT traversal.

* true: Enable. When NAT Traversal is enabled, IKE negotiation does not verify UDP port numbers and can detect NAT gateway devices in the VPN tunnel.
* false: Disable.

TunnelOptions.N.TunnelId.description_en: ID of the dual tunnel connection.

VpnConnectionId.description_en: ID of the IPsec connection. You can call [DescribeVpnConnections](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpn/DescribeVpnConnections) to query the connection ID.

VpnConnectionName.description_en:
Name of the IPsec connection.

* Must start with a Chinese character, Latin letter, or number; can only contain Chinese characters, Latin letters, numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
* Length: 1–128 characters

CheckInterval.description_en:
Interval for performing health checks

* Value range: 1 to 300, unit: seconds
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration

CheckerId.description_en: ID of the IPsec connection health check. You can call [DescribeVpnConnections](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpn/DescribeVpnConnections) to query the ID of the IPsec connection health check

ClientToken.description_en:
Client token, used to ensure request idempotency

* The client automatically generates a parameter value to ensure uniqueness between different requests, avoiding repeated operations caused by multiple retries when the API call times out or a server error occurs
* Only ASCII characters are supported, and cannot exceed 64 characters
* If ClientToken is not provided, this API call will not perform idempotency verification

DownTime.description_en:
Unhealthy threshold for health check

* Value range: 1 to 10, unit: times
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration

HealthCheckConfigs.N.CheckInterval.description_en: Health check interval; range: 3–300 seconds; default: 3 seconds

HealthCheckConfigs.N.DownTime.description_en: Unhealthy threshold for health checks. If a target IP returns 'abnormal' for all of the specified number of consecutive health checks, it will be considered to have a health check abnormality. Range: 1 to 10; default: 3; unit: occurrences

HealthCheckConfigs.N.Timeout.description_en: Health check response timeout. If the target IP does not respond correctly within the specified time, the health check is marked as abnormal. Valid range: 1–300 seconds, must be less than CheckInterval. Default: 1 second.

HealthCheckConfigs.N.UpTime.description_en: Health check threshold. If a target IP receives 'normal' status for the specified number of consecutive health checks, it is considered normal in the health check. Range: 1–10; default: 3; unit: checks

LocalIp.description_en:
Source IP for health check

* IPs in the `169.254.0.0/16`, `224.0.0.0/3`, or `127.0.0.0/8` ranges are not supported
* If multiple IPsec connections under the same VPN gateway require health checks, use different source IPs to distinguish them
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration

RemoteIp.description_en:
Destination IP for health check

* The destination IP cannot be the same as the source IP. IPs in the `169.254.0.0/16`, `224.0.0.0/3`, or `127.0.0.0/8` ranges are not supported
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration

Timeout.description_en:
Response timeout for health check. If the IPsec connection does not respond correctly within the specified time, the health check is considered "abnormal"

* Value range: 1 to 300, must be less than the value of `CheckInterval`. Unit: seconds
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration

UpTime.description_en:
Healthy threshold for health check

* Value range: 1 to 10, unit: times
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration

VpnConnectionId.description_en: ID of the IPsec connection to which the health check to be modified belongs. You can call [DescribeVpnConnections](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/vpn/DescribeVpnConnections) to query the ID of the IPsec connection

BGPConfig.LocalBgpIP.description_en:
BGP address on the BytePlus side.

* This address must be an IP address within the IPsec tunnel subnet.
* If EnableTunnelsBgp is set to true, this parameter is required.

BGPConfig.LocalBgpIp.description_en:
BGP address on the BytePlus side
- Defaults to the first host address in TunnelOptions.N.BGPConfig.TunnelCidr
- The address must be an IP address within the IPsec tunnel subnet

BGPConfig.TunnelCidr.description_en:
CIDR block containing the local and remote IPs of the BGP session.

* The CIDR block must be within 169.254.0.0/16 and have a subnet mask length of 30.
* If EnableTunnelsBgp is set to true, this parameter is required.

CustomerGatewayId.description_en:
ID of the customer gateway associated with the tunnel. If the IP address of the customer gateway is 0.0.0.0, NegotiateInstantly can only be set to **false**, IkeConfig.Version can only be **ikev1**, and IkeConfig.Mode can only be **aggressive**.
This parameter is required when creating a dual-tunnel IPsec connection.

DpdAction.description_en:
Status of the DPD feature.

* none: DPD is disabled
* clear: DPD is enabled; IKE SA is cleared after DPD timeout
* hold: DPD is enabled; current state is maintained after DPD timeout, and connection is re-established when new traffic arrives
* restart: DPD is enabled; reconnect immediately after DPD timeout

IkeConfig.AuthAlg.description_en:
Authentication algorithm for phase 1. Available values:

* sha1
* md5
* sha256
* sha384
* sha512
* sm3

IkeConfig.DhGroup.description_en:
DH (Diffie-Hellman) key exchange algorithm used in phase 1 negotiation. Options:

* group1
* group2
* group5
* group14

IkeConfig.EncAlg.description_en:
Encryption algorithm for phase 1 negotiation. Options:

* aes
* aes192
* aes256
* des
* 3des
* sm4

IkeConfig.Lifetime.description_en:
SA lifetime for phase 1 negotiation. When the lifetime is exceeded, negotiation restarts.

* Range: 900–86400 seconds
* Default: 86400

IkeConfig.LocalId.description_en:
Identifier for the VPN gateway, used in phase 1 negotiation. Supports IP format and FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) format.

* If not specified, defaults to the egress IP address of the selected VPN gateway.
* If you manually set to FQDN format, it is recommended to set the negotiation mode to "aggressive".
* Maximum length is 100 characters. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ;, and numbers are allowed.

IkeConfig.Mode.description_en:
Negotiation mode for phase 1. This parameter is required only when IkeConfig.Version is **ikev1**. Options:

* main
* aggressive

IkeConfig.Psk.description_en: Pre-shared key used for identity authentication between the VPN gateway and user gateway in phase one. Maximum length is 100 characters. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, special characters ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ;, and numbers are allowed.

IkeConfig.RemoteId.description_en:
Identifier for the customer gateway, used in phase 1 negotiation. Supports IP format and FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) format.

* If not specified, defaults to the public IP address of the selected customer gateway.
* If you manually set to FQDN format, it is recommended to set the negotiation mode to "aggressive".
* Maximum length is 100 characters. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, special symbols ~ ` | ! @ # $ % ^ ( ) - _ + = [ ] { } \ , . / : ;, and numbers are allowed.

IkeConfig.Version.description_en:
Version of the IKE key exchange protocol. Options:

* ikev1
* ikev2

IpsecConfig.AuthAlg.description_en:
Authentication algorithm for phase 2 negotiation. Options:

* sha1
* md5
* sha256
* sha384
* sha512
* sm3

IpsecConfig.DhGroup.description_en:
DH (Diffie-Hellman) key exchange algorithm used in phase 2. Available values:

* group1
* group2
* group5
* group14
* disable (do not configure DH algorithm)

> If you select group1, group2, group5, or group14, PFS (Perfect Forward Secrecy) will be enabled by default. The corresponding client must also enable PFS. If the client does not support PFS, set this option to "disable".

IpsecConfig.EncAlg.description_en:
Encryption algorithm negotiated in phase 2. Available values:

* aes
* aes192
* aes256
* des
* 3des
* sm4

IpsecConfig.Lifetime.description_en:
SA lifetime for phase 2 negotiation. When the lifetime is exceeded, negotiation restarts.

* Range: 900–86400
* Unit: seconds
* Default: 86400

NatTraversal.description_en:
Enable NAT traversal.

* true: Enable. When NAT traversal is enabled, IKE negotiation does not verify UDP port numbers and can detect NAT gateway devices in the VPN tunnel.
* false: Disable

Asn.description_en:
ASN of the VPN gateway. Only supports initial configuration of ASN. If the VPN gateway has not been configured with an ASN, you can set the ASN using this parameter. If the VPN gateway already has an ASN configured, modification is not allowed.

* Valid range for VPN gateway ASN: 64512–65534, 4200000000–4294967294
* If left blank, the original configuration will be retained

Bandwidth.description_en:
Bandwidth specification of the VPN gateway instance, unit: Mbps.

* Leave blank to keep the current configuration.
* Valid values: 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 1000, 3000.

VPN gateways with 1000 Mbps and 3000 Mbps bandwidth specifications are available by invitation only. Only users who have enabled these specifications can use them. If you have not enabled these specifications, please avoid specifying `Bandwidth`. If needed, contact your account manager to apply for a trial.

Description.description_en:
Description of the VPN gateway instance.

* Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or number, and can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), space ( ), underscore (_), hyphen (-), equals sign (=), English comma (,), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。).
* Length limit: 0 to 255 characters.
* Leave blank to keep the current configuration.

IpsecEnabled.description_en:
Enable IPSec feature?

* true: Enable
* false: Disable

`IpsecEnabled` and `SslEnabled` cannot both be set to `false` at the same time.

SslEnabled.description_en:
Enable SSL VPN feature?

* true: Enable
* false: Disable

`IpsecEnabled` and `SslEnabled` cannot both be set to `false` at the same time.

SslMaxConnections.description_en:
Maximum number of connections for SSL VPN specification. This parameter can only be specified when `SslEnabled` is set to `true`.

* 5
* 10
* 20
* 50
* 100
* 200

VpnGatewayName.description_en:
